Information from individual income tax returns submitted to the ATO, including income, losses, deductions, expenses, offsets, tax withheld and debts.

*Describes annual individual tax-return information, coverage, timing and non-lodgement limitations.*

A zero in a retiree's record is therefore ordinary, and reading it as no pension will misclassify most people over 60.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0910 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0910_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"AASIS_TXBLCMPNT_UTAXDELMNT_AMT","d":"Pension income the fund never paid tax on, usually from an unfunded public sector scheme, plus annuities net of their purchase price.","full":"Pension income the fund never paid tax on, usually from an unfunded public sector scheme, plus annuities net of their purchase price. The ATO does not take this straight off the payment summary: \"Work out the untaxed element amount for label N using the worksheet\", which adds the untaxed elements and then the annuity amount after subtracting \"the deductible amount of the annuity's UPP\". Unlike the taxed element beside it, an untaxed element stays declarable after 60, so this column keeps working at ages where the taxed element column goes quiet.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuities and superannuation income streams","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Australian annuities and superannuation income streams taxable component untaxed element","k":"Dollar amount reported at item 7 label N of the individual tax return","def":"A dollar amount for the year, gross of tax withheld, combining untaxed elements of super income streams with the assessable part of Australian annuities. The ATO keeps them apart from ordinary pension income: \"Add up the untaxed element amounts under the heading 'Lump sum in arrears - taxable component' on all your PAYG payment summary - superannuation income stream\" and write the total at label Z. The reason for the separate box is relief - a recipient \"may be eligible for lump sum payment in arrears tax offsets\" - and to claim it they must attach a schedule splitting the amount by the year it relates to, which the return itself does not capture.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuities and superannuation income streams","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Australian annuities and superannuation income streams lump sum in arrears taxable component untaxed element","k":"Dollar amount reported at item 7 label Z of the individual tax return","def":"A dollar amount for the year, reported by the fund as arrears of an untaxed element. The ATO's step is the mirror of the untaxed one: \"Add up the taxed element amounts under the heading 'Lump sum in arrears - taxable component' on all your PAYG payment summary - superannuation income stream\" and write the total at label Y. It carries the same age rule as the ordinary taxed element, so a recipient over 60 drawing from a taxed source generally has nothing to report, and where a capped defined benefit income stream is involved the ATO instructs the taxpayer to leave label Y out and use label M instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuities and superannuation income streams","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Australian annuities and superannuation income streams lump sum in arrears taxable component taxed element","k":"Dollar amount reported at item 7 label Y of the individual tax return","def":"A dollar amount for the year, reported by the fund as arrears of a taxed element. It is separate from the ordinary taxed element at label J and from the untaxed arrears at label Z.","p":"2007-2008 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuities and superannuation income streams","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","lim":"The amount relates to earlier income years, so a person's income series built from this table will show a spike in the year of payment that never happened in the year of entitlement. Under a capped defined benefit income stream the figure is redirected to a different label by instruction, so a zero here can coexist with substantial arrears having been received.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0910 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0910_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"ABN_HASH_TRUNC","d":"The payer on the wages and salaries record: the entity that withheld tax and reported the payment to the ATO.","full":"The payer on the wages and salaries record: the entity that withheld tax and reported the payment to the ATO. On the income tax return context tables it is what ties a taxpayer's reported income back to who paid it, so an employment history can be reconstructed from tax records alone. The same employer carries the same value here as in the payment summaries and in BUSOWN.","dsrc":"Australian Business Register, ABN format","durl":"https://abr.business.gov.au/Help/AbnFormat","dp":"ai","vp":"official","od":"Payer's Hashed encrypted Australian business number (ABN)","k":"Australian Business Number (hashed and truncated)","def":"A hash of the Australian Business Number, truncated. The Australian Business Register defines the ABN as \"a unique 11 digit identifier issued to all entities registered in the Australian Business Register\", structured as \"a 9 digit identifier with two leading check digits\" that validate on a modulus 89 calculation. Hashing replaces it with a code carrying none of those digits, so the value cannot be decoded, cannot be checked against the public register, and is useful only for matching one record to another.","p":"2018-2019 to 2021-2022","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Business Register, ABN format","url":"https://abr.business.gov.au/Help/AbnFormat","lim":"The identifier stands for a registered entity, not for a workplace or a job. A large employer commonly holds several ABNs across its subsidiaries, so one job can look like several employers. An entity that restructures takes a new ABN, which breaks a continuous employment relationship in two. Truncating the hash also admits rare collisions.","where":["madipge-ato-d-wages-salaries-fy1819 / ato_wages_salaries_1819_16m","madipge-ato-d-wages-salaries-fy1920 / ato_wages_salaries_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-wages-salaries-fy2021 / ato_wages_salaries_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-ws-fy2021-22 / ato_ws_2122_12m"]},{"n":"ABSTUDY_SSL_DEBT_OUTSTG_RPYBL","d":"What is still owed on an ABSTUDY Student Start-up Loan after the year's compulsory repayment has been taken out.","full":"What is still owed on an ABSTUDY Student Start-up Loan after the year's compulsory repayment has been taken out. The loan itself is narrow: the ATO says the scheme \"started on 1 January 2016 and replaced the Student Start-up Scholarship payment\" and is available to higher education students receiving Youth Allowance, Austudy or ABSTUDY Living Allowance. Because the balance is indexed each year and does not fall unless a repayment is made, a rising figure across years is ordinary rather than a sign of new borrowing.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Types of loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"ABSTUDY Student Start-Up Loan Outstanding Repayable Debt","k":"Outstanding ABSTUDY Student Start-up Loan balance (dollars)","def":"A dollar balance at the end of the assessment, sitting with the repayable debt and the compulsory repayment for the same loan on the same row. Balances for HELP, VSL, SFSS, SSL and the apprenticeship loan are separate columns.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Types of loans","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","lim":"The column cannot exist before 2015-16, so an empty value in an earlier year says nothing about a person's study debts. It is a balance owed to the Commonwealth, not a measure of study costs or of how much a person borrowed, since indexation and earlier repayments have both moved it.","where":["madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"ABSTUDY_SSL_RPYBL_AMT","d":"The ABSTUDY Student Start-up Loan balance the ATO had on hand when it assessed the year, before working out any compulsory repayment.","full":"The ABSTUDY Student Start-up Loan balance the ATO had on hand when it assessed the year, before working out any compulsory repayment. The loan is voluntary and small by design, paid to Indigenous higher education students on ABSTUDY Living Allowance and their Youth Allowance and Austudy counterparts, and administered by Services Australia rather than by an education provider. Read with the compulsory repayment and the outstanding balance on the same row, it gives the opening position for the year.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Types of loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"ABSTUDY Student Start-Up Loan Repayable Debt","k":"Repayable ABSTUDY Student Start-up Loan debt at assessment (dollars)","def":"A dollar balance at the point of assessment, after the year's indexation. It relates to one loan type only, so a person's whole study debt is the sum of this and the HELP, VSL, SFSS, SSL and apprenticeship loan columns.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Types of loans","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","lim":"A balance is not a borrowing history: it cannot show how many instalments were taken or when, and voluntary repayments made during the year have already reduced it. It is also silent on whether the person is still studying, since repayment obligations run whether or not study has finished.","where":["madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"ABSTUDYSSLCMPLSRYRPMTDUEAMT","d":"How much of an ABSTUDY Student Start-up Loan the ATO required the person to repay out of this year's assessment.","full":"How much of an ABSTUDY Student Start-up Loan the ATO required the person to repay out of this year's assessment. Nothing is due until a threshold is crossed: \"You must start making compulsory repayments against your study or training support loan when your repayment income exceeds the minimum repayment threshold\", and repayment income is wider than taxable income, adding back reportable fringe benefits, net investment losses, reportable superannuation contributions and exempt foreign employment income. A zero therefore usually means income below the threshold rather than no debt.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans, When you must repay your loan","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/when-must-you-repay-your-loan","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"ABSTUDY SSL compulsory repayment due","k":"Compulsory ABSTUDY Student Start-up Loan repayment raised on the assessment (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount raised on the notice of assessment for the year, distinct from the balances on either side of it. It sits in the context table with occupation, spouse details and dependant counts, which is the set of characteristics used to interpret the money columns in the other tables, and it is the age most tax thresholds are read against. Anyone with a birthday during the year is a year older by 30 June, so an age-based cut applied to this column and to a mid-year event will not agree.","dsrc":"ABS, Person Level Integrated Data Asset (PLIDA)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/about/data-services/data-integration/integrated-data/person-level-integrated-data-asset-plida","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Age at the beginning of the given financial year","k":"Age in completed years at 1 July","def":"A whole number of years with no fractional part, one value per person per income year. The ATO lists the payments that belong there, with the Age Pension first, alongside Carer Payment, Disability Support Pension for people of pension age, Parenting Payment (single) and the veterans' service pensions. The figure comes from the paying agency's payment summary or letter rather than from the person's own records, so it is third-party reported income that the taxpayer transcribes.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 6 Australian Government pensions and allowances","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/6-australian-government-pensions-and-allowances-2025","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Age Pension Amount","k":"Dollar amount of Age Pension declared as assessable income","def":"A dollar amount for the income year, gross of any tax withheld, which is carried in its own column. AGE_FY_START and TAXPAYER_AGE sit beside it in the same context table and give age in single years at different reference points.","dsrc":"ATO, Taxation statistics 2023-24, Individuals Table 3, column 'Age range'","durl":"https://data.gov.au/data/dataset/faea4485-f407-457d-97f8-3f0822ccd654/resource/fa246a26-1317-443d-8f6e-6d7521453861/download/ts24individual03sextaxablestatusagerangetaxableincomerange.xlsx","dp":"ai","vp":"official","od":"AGE RANGE","k":"ato_age_range","def":"Thirteen ordered text bands running from 'Under 18' through five-year groups to '75 and over', with an open band at each end.","p":"2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"guessed","src":"ATO Taxation statistics 2023-24, Individuals Table 3, column 'Age range' (note 3: age as at 30 June at the end of the income year, from the birth date on the return)","lim":"The bands hide the ages that matter for tax. The word 'best' in the custodian's description is the point: more than one source can supply a date of birth for a taxpayer, and this column carries the one the compilers preferred. Paired with the start-of-year age on the same row it also identifies who had a birthday during the year, which is the group any age-based threshold will treat inconsistently.","dsrc":"ABS, Person Level Integrated Data Asset (PLIDA)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/about/data-services/data-integration/integrated-data/person-level-integrated-data-asset-plida","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Derived 'best' age at end of financial year","k":"Age in completed years at 30 June 2010, best available source","def":"A whole number of years measured at 30 June 2010, one value per person, on a sixteen-month extract of the 2009-10 year. It is the column to use when an age has to be fixed before anything in the year happened, for instance when classifying people into age bands for an outcome measured over the year. That placement is what makes it useful: a payment summary row has a payment date, a period start and a period end, so this column lets earnings be put into an age band even for people who never lodged a return. The ABS Address Register is the ABS's list of every known physical address in Australia, built from Geoscape's Geocoded National Address File and extended with each address's use and its dwelling structure. Hashing replaces the identifier with a code carrying none of the address, so the value has no internal structure and cannot be decoded. There is no finite list to publish.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ABS Address Register Information Guide","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/research/abs-address-register-information-guide","lim":"The identifier stands for an address, not for a person or a household, so a shared value shows co-residence rather than a relationship. An administrative address is only as current as the taxpayer's last dealing with the ATO, so it can lag a move by a year or more. Truncating the hash also admits rare collisions, so a shared value is strong evidence of a shared address rather than proof of one.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy2324 / ato_itr_context_2324_12m","madipge-ato-d-pay-sum-fy2324 / plida_ps_2324_12m_bn"]},{"n":"ASMT_ISSD_AMT","d":"The amount the ATO assessed when it issued the notice of assessment for this return.","full":"The amount the ATO assessed when it issued the notice of assessment for this return. It also cannot be compared with published programme spending, because only assessable assistance is in scope and the amount is attributed to the individual rather than to a business entity.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"ASSOCD_PRSNS_PMTS_AMT","d":"What the business paid relatives, or partnerships in which relatives are partners, as a business expense.","full":"What the business paid relatives, or partnerships in which relatives are partners, as a business expense. The ATO defines the item as \"amounts, including salary, wages, commissions or allowances, paid to your relatives\", and adds that it \"also include super contributions paid for the benefit of your relatives\". It is a disclosure item, asked so the ATO can test whether family payments are reasonable.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule instructions 2025, P16 Payments to associated persons","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/payments-to-associated-persons-p16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Payments to associated persons","k":"Dollar amount reported at P16 label H of the business and professional items schedule","def":"A whole-dollar amount, no cents, added up across every business the individual carried on. It covers remuneration and superannuation paid to relatives and related partnerships.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule instructions 2025, P16 Payments to associated persons","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/payments-to-associated-persons-p16","lim":"It is not an extra deduction: the salary and wage part is also inside the total salary and wage expenses column, so adding the two overstates expenses. It also records the claim, not the outcome, since the ATO can deny excessive or unreasonable family payments and the personal services income rules cap deductions for payments to associates.","where":["madip-ge-020102d-ato-atoitrcontext1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_context_1011","madip-ge-020107d-ato-atoitrcontext1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_context_1112","madip-ge-020112d-ato-atoitrcontext1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_context_1213","madip-ge-020117d-ato-atoitrcontext1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_context_1314","madip-ge-020122d-ato-atoitrcontext1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_context_1415","madip-ge-020127d-ato-atoitrcontext1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_context_1516","madip-ge-020132d-ato-atoitrcontext1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_context_1617","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_context_1718","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_context_1819","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0607 / ato_itr_context_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0708 / ato_itr_context_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0809 / ato_itr_context_0809_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"ATO_CHRGD_INTST_AMT","d":"Interest the ATO charged the taxpayer, claimed as a deduction at question D10 label N.","full":"Interest the ATO charged the taxpayer, claimed as a deduction at question D10 label N. The ATO allows the claim for \"the late payment of taxes and penalties\", for increases in tax from an amended assessment and for increases in other liabilities such as GST or PAYG amounts. D10 is split three ways, so this column sits beside litigation costs at label L and other tax-management expenses at label M.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question D10 Cost of managing tax affairs","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/tax-return/deduction-questions-d1-d10/d10-cost-of-managing-tax-affairs-2024","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Cost of managing tax affairs - interest charged by the ato","k":"Dollar amount claimed at question D10 label N","def":"A whole-dollar deduction for interest charges incurred in the income year, whether or not paid by 30 June, provided a bill was received or the charge was made and paid.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question D10 Cost of managing tax affairs","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/tax-return/deduction-questions-d1-d10/d10-cost-of-managing-tax-affairs-2024","lim":"It is the deductible interest claimed, not the taxpayer's debt or their arrears through the year. Penalties for failing to meet obligations are not deductible and are excluded, so the column cannot stand in for ATO compliance action, and D10 carried a single undivided figure before the three-label split, which breaks a long series at the change.","where":["madip-ge-020128d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1516","madip-ge-020133d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1617","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1718","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1819","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy1920 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1920","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy1920 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2223 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2324 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2324_12m"]},{"n":"AUS_HELP_CMPLSRY_RPMT_AMT","d":"The compulsory HELP repayment the ATO raised on this assessment, not an amount the taxpayer wrote on the return.","full":"The compulsory HELP repayment the ATO raised on this assessment, not an amount the taxpayer wrote on the return. The ATO says \"you don't have to provide loan information in your tax return\" and that \"if you have a loan when you lodge your tax return and your repayment income is above the minimum repayment threshold, we will work out your compulsory repayment and include it on your notice of assessment\". It is based on the person's own repayment income, not household income.","dsrc":"ATO, Compulsory repayments (study and training support loans)","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/compulsory-repayments","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Australian HELP assessment debt","k":"Dollar amount of compulsory study and training loan repayment raised on the assessment","def":"A dollar amount raised as a debt on the notice of assessment. It is nil below the minimum repayment threshold and nil for a person entitled to a Medicare levy reduction or exemption on family income grounds.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Compulsory repayments (study and training support loans)","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/compulsory-repayments","lim":"It is neither the loan balance nor the money withheld from pay during the year. Employers withhold an extra amount against an expected repayment, and the ATO applies that money to the loan only after the return is assessed, so pay-cycle withholding and this column do not line up in any year.","where":["madip-ge-020130d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1516","madip-ge-020135d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1617","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1718","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1819","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"AUSN_CMPLSRY_RPMT_DUE_AMT","d":"The compulsory repayment due on a VET Student Loan for the year, worked out by the ATO at assessment rather than reported by the taxpayer.","full":"The compulsory repayment due on a VET Student Loan for the year, worked out by the ATO at assessment rather than reported by the taxpayer. The ATO describes the scheme as one that \"offers income contingent loan support to eligible students studying certain diploma level and above vocational education and training qualifications\", and it replaced VET FEE-HELP, which the ATO says \"operated between 2008 and 2016\". The column appears in only a handful of table vintages, so early years carry no VSL repayment at all.","dsrc":"ATO, Compulsory repayments (study and training support loans) and Types of loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"VET Support Loan Australian Compulsory Repayment Due","k":"Dollar amount of compulsory VET Student Loan repayment due on the assessment","def":"A dollar amount raised as a debt on the notice of assessment, driven by repayment income against the same threshold used for other study and training loans.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Compulsory repayments (study and training support loans) and Types of loans","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","lim":"A person can hold several study loans at once, and this column carries only the VET Student Loan share, so it is not the taxpayer's total study loan repayment. They arise under trans-Tasman imputation, where a New Zealand company that has paid Australian tax can attach Australian credits to its dividends. The ATO tells taxpayers not to include \"New Zealand imputation credits\" or \"Australian franking credits you received from an Australian company\", which belong at questions 11 and 13.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question 20 Foreign source income and foreign assets or property, Part G","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/20-foreign-source-income-and-foreign-assets-or-property-2024","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Foreign source income australian franking credits from a nz company","k":"Dollar amount reported at item 20 label F of the supplementary return","def":"A dollar amount of Australian franking credits the taxpayer is entitled to, received directly as franked dividends or indirectly through a trust or partnership. It is reduced where a supplementary dividend was paid and a foreign income tax offset is claimed on the same dividend.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question 20 Foreign source income and foreign assets or property, Part G","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/20-foreign-source-income-and-foreign-assets-or-property-2024","lim":"It says nothing about tax paid in New Zealand: New Zealand imputation credits cannot be claimed on an Australian return and are excluded by instruction. It is also an entitlement claimed, so credits denied under the holding period or related payments rules never appear.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","and 8 more"]},{"n":"AUSN_FILM_INDY_INCNTVS_AMT","d":"The amount claimed under the Australian film industry incentives, the concession for investing in a certified Australian film.","full":"The amount claimed under the Australian film industry incentives, the concession for investing in a certified Australian film. The ATO explains that \"under Division 10BA a deduction is generally allowable for capital moneys spent to produce a film or contributed to the cost of producing it\", and that the deduction falls in the year the money is spent. The column belongs to the early schema of this asset, when these incentives were still open to individual investors.","dsrc":"ATO, Australian film industry incentives, Deductions for expenditure or contributions","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/australian-film-industry-incentives-2002/deductions-for-expenditure-or-contributions","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Australian film industry incentives","k":"Dollar amount claimed under the Australian film industry incentives","def":"A dollar amount of capital contribution to film production, limited to the part of the contribution spent directly on production costs. Related expenses such as interest on borrowed contribution money are capped at the film income of the year and are not part of this figure.","p":"2006-2007 to 2009-2010","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Australian film industry incentives, Deductions for expenditure or contributions","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/australian-film-industry-incentives-2002/deductions-for-expenditure-or-contributions","lim":"The claim can be unwound years later. The ATO says the deduction \"will be later disallowed\" if the film misses certification or commercial exhibition, and it can amend at any time, so the column records what an investor claimed rather than a deduction that stood.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0607 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0708 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0809 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0809_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0910 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0910_16m"]},{"n":"AUSN_GOVTALWNC_AND_PMTS_TW_AMT","d":"Tax withheld from Australian Government allowances such as JobSeeker, youth allowance, Austudy and parenting payment (partnered).","full":"Tax withheld from Australian Government allowances such as JobSeeker, youth allowance, Austudy and parenting payment (partnered). The ATO's step is to \"add up the tax withheld shown on each of your payment summaries and letters\" and \"write the total under Tax withheld at the left of question 5 - label A\". It is a credit against the year's tax, and the income it was taken from sits in AUSNGOVTALWNC_AND_PMTS_AMT on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question 5 Australian Government allowances and payments","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/tax-return/income-questions-1-12/5-australian-government-allowances-and-payments-2024","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax withheld on australian government allowances and payments like newstart youth allowance and austudy payment","k":"Dollar amount of tax withheld reported at question 5","def":"A dollar amount, summed across every payment summary and agency letter the taxpayer received for allowance-type payments. It is third-party reported in substance, since the figures come from the paying agency's summaries.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question 5 Australian Government allowances and payments","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/tax-return/income-questions-1-12/5-australian-government-allowances-and-payments-2024","lim":"It is a credit, not money received, and it cannot be divided back to a particular benefit or agency. The ATO's step is to \"add up the tax withheld shown on each of your payment summaries and letters\" and \"write the total under Tax withheld at the left of question 6 - label B\". Accounting provisions for doubtful debts are excluded and are handled through the expense reconciliation instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule instructions 2025, P8 Bad debts","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/expenses-p8","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Bad debts - total","k":"Dollar total of the primary and non-primary production bad debts columns at P8","def":"A whole-dollar amount, no cents, equal to the primary production and non-primary production bad debt columns of P8 added together. The ATO describes the notice as showing \"tax you owe on your taxable income\", \"credit you have for tax already paid during the income year\" and \"tax you need to pay or your refund\", and this column is that last figure. It is calculated by the ATO from the lodged return, not written by the taxpayer.","dsrc":"ATO, Your notice of assessment","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/your-notice-of-assessment","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax payable or refundable","k":"Dollar balance of the assessment, payable or refundable","def":"A dollar amount, the residual after income tax, the Medicare levy and any surcharge are reduced by offsets and by credits such as tax withheld and franking credits.","p":"2010-2011 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Your notice of assessment","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/your-notice-of-assessment","lim":"It is the assessment result, not the taxpayer's account position. It carries the same quantity as BAL_OF_THIS_ASMT_CALCD_AMT in the later withholding and debt tables, so a series spanning both has to be spliced across the two column names. Like its successor it is an ATO calculation, produced when the return is processed.","dsrc":"ATO, Your notice of assessment","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/your-notice-of-assessment","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Balance Payable Or Refundable Amount","k":"Dollar balance payable or refundable, earliest table schema","def":"A dollar amount for the early income years of the asset, being income tax and levies less offsets and credits for tax already paid.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Your notice of assessment","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/your-notice-of-assessment","lim":"The two schemas are not guaranteed to share a sign convention or the same set of levies and credits, so joining this column to its later twin needs a check at the join year rather than an assumption that the definitions match.","where":["madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0001 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0001","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0102 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0102","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0203 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0203","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0304 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0304","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0405 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0405","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0506 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0506","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy9900 / ato_itr_whld_debt_9900"]},{"n":"BBI_ELGBL_AST_BBI_CD","d":"Whether the taxpayer chose to opt out of backing business investment accelerated depreciation for some of their eligible assets, or for all of them.","full":"Whether the taxpayer chose to opt out of backing business investment accelerated depreciation for some of their eligible assets, or for all of them. The ATO says \"you use your tax return to claim the deduction or to opt out of backing business investment for an asset\". Backing business investment applied to the 2019-20 and 2020-21 income years only, and this column appears in a single table vintage.","dsrc":"ATO, Backing business investment - accelerated depreciation","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/backing-business-investment-accelerated-depreciation","dp":"official","vp":"official","od":"Backing business investment - Are you making a choice to opt out of backing business investment for some or all of your eligible assets?","t":"categorical","k":"Opt-out choice code for backing business investment accelerated depreciation","def":"A single character choice code separating an opt-out for some eligible assets from an opt-out for all of them, blank where no opt-out choice was made. The company return instructions use A and B for that pair, but the characters used on the individual schedule are not confirmed. It qualifies the count and value of opted-out assets on the same row.","p":"2020-2021","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Backing business investment - accelerated depreciation","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/backing-business-investment-accelerated-depreciation","lim":"It records a choice, not a dollar effect: the deduction forgone by opting out is nowhere in these three columns. A blank cannot be read as opting in either, since small businesses using the simplified depreciation rules could not opt out at all.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_16m"],"dom":2},{"n":"BBI_ELGBL_AST_OPT_OUT_NUM","d":"How many eligible assets the taxpayer opted out of backing business investment accelerated depreciation for.","full":"How many eligible assets the taxpayer opted out of backing business investment accelerated depreciation for. The ATO's instruction for the matching field on the company return is to \"show at W the number of assets for which you are opting out of Backing business investment - accelerated depreciation\", and the choice is made asset by asset. The label letter on the individual schedule is not confirmed. The count pairs with the total cost of those assets in BBI_ELGBL_AST_OPT_OUT_VAL_AMT on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Company tax return instructions 2021, 9 Capital allowances","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/company-tax-return-2021-instructions/9-capital-allowances","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Backing business investment - Number of assets you are opting out for","k":"Count of assets opted out of backing business investment","def":"A whole number of assets. It counts opted-out assets only, not the taxpayer's eligible assets or their depreciating asset holdings generally.","p":"2020-2021","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Company tax return instructions 2021, 9 Capital allowances","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/company-tax-return-2021-instructions/9-capital-allowances","lim":"The count is explicitly forgiving. The ATO says a taxpayer \"will not be penalised for specifying an incorrect amount\" where a best attempt was made, so it is an estimate offered under a relaxed standard and should not be treated as an asset register.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2021_16m"]},{"n":"BBI_ELGBL_AST_OPT_OUT_VAL_AMT","d":"The total cost of the assets the taxpayer opted out of backing business investment accelerated depreciation for.","full":"The total cost of the assets the taxpayer opted out of backing business investment accelerated depreciation for. The ATO's instruction for the matching field on the company return is to \"show at X the total cost of the assets for which you are opting out of Backing business investment - accelerated depreciation\", so it is cost rather than written-down value; the label letter on the individual schedule is not confirmed. It sits beside the count of those assets and the some-or-all choice code.","dsrc":"ATO, Company tax return instructions 2021, 9 Capital allowances","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/company-tax-return-2021-instructions/9-capital-allowances","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Backing business investment - Value of assets you are opting out for","k":"Dollar cost of assets opted out of backing business investment","def":"A dollar amount, the summed cost of the opted-out assets in the year the choice was made. The tax effect of opting out depends on each asset's effective life and depreciation method, so this amount cannot be converted into forgone deductions or into a revenue estimate.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2021_16m"]},{"n":"BN","d":"The de-identified business identifier for the paying entity on this payment summary row, the same key that identifies a business across BLADE.","full":"The de-identified business identifier for the paying entity on this payment summary row, the same key that identifies a business across BLADE. It stands for the employer or payer, not for the individual, so it is the join that lets a person's pay be attached to firm characteristics. The ABS describes BLADE as \"an economic data tool combining tax, trade and intellectual property data with information from ABS surveys\", and this column is the key those business tables are built on.","dsrc":"ABS, Business Longitudinal Analysis Data Environment (BLADE)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/about/data-services/data-integration/integrated-data/business-longitudinal-analysis-data-environment-blade","dp":"official","vp":"ai","k":"De-identified business identifier shared with BLADE","def":"An opaque numeric identifier standing for one registered business, stable within the asset and shared with the business data environment. It carries no name, address or industry of its own.","p":"2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Business Longitudinal Analysis Data Environment (BLADE)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/about/data-services/data-integration/integrated-data/business-longitudinal-analysis-data-environment-blade","lim":"A business identifier is not a firm over time and not a workplace. The ATO states that \"the Medicare levy is 2% of your taxable income\" and that \"we calculate your Medicare levy when you lodge your tax return\", so it is an ATO figure rather than a taxpayer entry. The taxpayer's part is the reduction or exemption claim at question M1, which lowers the amount in this column.","dsrc":"ATO, What is the Medicare levy?","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy/what-is-the-medicare-levy","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Medicare levy","k":"Dollar amount of Medicare levy calculated on the assessment","def":"A dollar amount, two per cent of taxable income, reduced where family income puts the taxpayer in the reduction range and nil where a full exemption applies.","p":"1999-2000, 2000-2001, 2001-2002, 2002-2003, 2003-2004, 2004-2005, 2005-2006, 2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, What is the Medicare levy?","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy/what-is-the-medicare-levy","lim":"A zero is not a low income signal. The ATO says \"Your basic taxable income is your taxable income excluding: net capital gains\", along with certain superannuation lump sums and death benefit termination payments, above-average income of a special professional, and deductions excluded under the non-commercial loss provisions. This is the year the entry test looks at, because averaging does not start until basic taxable income is at least as high as the year before.","dsrc":"ATO, Income averaging (primary producers, managing varying income)","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/primary-producers/managing-varying-income/tax-averaging","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Averaging income - 1st year amount (calculated)","k":"Dollar basic taxable income for the year before the current one","def":"A dollar amount computed by the ATO for the prior income year on the averaging definition, not on the ordinary taxable income definition.","p":"2010-2011 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Income averaging (primary producers, managing varying income)","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/primary-producers/managing-varying-income/tax-averaging","lim":"It will not match the taxable income assessed for that earlier year. It sits beside NET_TAX_AMT and GRS_TAX_AMT in the same withholding and debt table, which are the totals it is carved out of.","dsrc":"ATO, Taxation statistics 2014-15, Definitions and calculations","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/about-ato/research-and-statistics/in-detail/taxation-statistics/taxation-statistics-previous-editions/taxation-statistics-2014-15/reference-material/definitions-and-calculations","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Business net tax","k":"Derived dollar amount, estimated net tax attributable to business income","def":"A dollar amount derived by pro-rating net tax by the proportion of taxable income that comes from net business income at items 15B and 15C, with the proportion set to one where it would exceed one.","p":"2010-2011 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Taxation statistics 2014-15, Definitions and calculations","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/about-ato/research-and-statistics/in-detail/taxation-statistics/taxation-statistics-previous-editions/taxation-statistics-2014-15/reference-material/definitions-and-calculations","lim":"It is an apportionment, not a tax actually assessed on business income, so it cannot be used to say what a person paid on their business. them. The ATO says \"You don't have to provide loan information in your tax return\" and that \"we will work out your compulsory repayment and include it on your notice of assessment\". Trade support loans went to apprentices, and the programme has since been renamed the Australian Apprenticeship Support Loan.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Compulsory repayments","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/compulsory-repayments","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Trade support loan (tsl) compulsory repayment due","k":"Dollar amount, compulsory trade support loan repayment raised on assessment","def":"A dollar amount calculated at assessment, sitting beside the equivalent repayment fields for HELP, SFSS, SSL and ABSTUDY SSL in the same withholding and debt table.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Compulsory repayments","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/compulsory-repayments","lim":"It is not what the person paid during the year. The ATO says \"If you exceed your concessional contributions cap, the excess concessional contributions (ECC) are included in your assessable income\" and are \"taxed at your marginal tax rate less a 15% tax offset\". The ATO works the figure out from fund reporting, not from the return, and will \"amend your tax return and send you an amended NOA\" when a fund reports late.","dsrc":"ATO, Concessional contributions cap","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/super/growing-and-keeping-track-of-your-super/caps-limits-and-tax-on-super-contributions/concessional-contributions-cap","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Excess concessional contributions amount","k":"Dollar amount, excess concessional contributions for the year","def":"A dollar amount determined by the ATO from super fund reporting and tax return data, after any unused cap carried forward from the previous five years has been applied.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Concessional contributions cap","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/super/growing-and-keeping-track-of-your-super/caps-limits-and-tax-on-super-contributions/concessional-contributions-cap","lim":"It is not a measure of contribution generosity or of a mistake by the taxpayer, since it can be created by an employer's payment timing or a late fund report, and it appears on the record only after the ATO determination, which can arrive after the original assessment. It applies only to capped defined benefit income streams, so it separates old public sector and similar pensions from ordinary account-based pensions reported at labels J and N on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuity and superannuation income streams","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Assessable amount from capped defined benefit income stream","k":"Dollar amount at question 7 label M","def":"A whole-dollar assessable amount calculated from the tax-free component, taxed element and untaxed element of every capped defined benefit income stream the person received, including lump sums in arrears.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuity and superannuation income streams","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","lim":"It is not the pension paid: most of a capped defined benefit pension sits under the cap and never reaches this label, so the column measures the excess above a threshold and cannot be used as a retirement income amount. The ATO defines it as \"amounts you pay or benefits you provide to another person other than your partner for the maintenance of your natural or adopted child\", and it is subtractive rather than additive: \"we deduct this amount from the total of the other components that make up your adjusted taxable income\". The ATO makes the deduction conditional: the person's \"taxable non-primary production income for 2024–25 is $100,000 or less\", individual deposits are at least $1,000 and no more than $800,000 in total, and the money is held for at least twelve months unless a natural disaster or drought exception applies. Repayments come back as income at labels N and R on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 17 Net farm management deposits or repayments","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/17-net-farm-management-deposits-or-repayments-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net farm management deposits or repayments deductable deposits","k":"Dollar amount at question 17 label D, deductible farm management deposits","def":"A whole-dollar total of deductible deposits made in the year, before the netting against repayments that produces the net amount at label E.","p":"2011-2012 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 17 Net farm management deposits or repayments","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/17-net-farm-management-deposits-or-repayments-2025","lim":"It is a gross deposit figure, so it cannot be read as savings accumulated: the same person can deposit and withdraw in the one year and the account balance is nowhere on the return. The ATO allows \"an immediate deduction for expenditure for the sole or dominant purpose of carrying on environmental protection activities (EPAs)\", which it describes as \"activities undertaken to prevent, fight and remedy pollution, and to treat, clean up, remove and store waste\". The deduction had its own line on the older business and professional items schedule; on the current schedule it reaches the return through the expense reconciliation adjustment instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Other capital asset and expense deductions, Environmental protection activities","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/other-capital-asset-and-expense-deductions","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Deduction for environmental protection expenses - total","k":"Dollar amount, deduction for environmental protection activities","def":"A whole-dollar deduction claimed in the year the expenditure was incurred, covering a person's own site and a site leased to another party whose pollution the person remedies.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Other capital asset and expense deductions, Environmental protection activities","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/other-capital-asset-and-expense-deductions","lim":"It is not a measure of environmental spending by a business, since the ATO excludes expenditure that forms part of the cost of a depreciating asset and excludes the cost of an environmental assessment of a project, both of which are the larger items in practice. The label also moved between schedule versions, so a break in the series is a form change.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0607 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0708 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0809 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0809_16m"]},{"n":"DDCTN_SKILL_TRNG_AMT","d":"The extra 20 per cent deduction a small business claimed for training its employees through an outside registered provider.","full":"The extra 20 per cent deduction a small business claimed for training its employees through an outside registered provider. The ATO allowed \"an additional 20% tax deduction for external training courses delivered to employees by registered training providers\" for businesses under $50 million turnover, and the measure ran \"from 7:30 pm AEDT on 29 March 2022 until 30 June 2024\". The amount here is the bonus alone, on top of the ordinary deduction for the same spending.","dsrc":"ATO, Small business skills and training boost","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/income-and-deductions-for-business/deductions/small-business-skills-and-training-boost","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business boost - small business skills and training boost","k":"Dollar amount, small business skills and training bonus deduction","def":"A whole-dollar bonus deduction equal to 20 per cent of eligible external training expenditure, calculated on the GST-exclusive amount for a business registered for GST.","p":"2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Small business skills and training boost","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/income-and-deductions-for-business/deductions/small-business-skills-and-training-boost","lim":"It is not training spending: multiplying by five recovers only eligible external expenditure, and the ATO excludes training of the business owner, of partners and of contractors, along with any intermediary's commission. The ATO capped it hard: the boost \"is capped at $100,000 of expenditure per income year\" with \"a maximum bonus deduction of $20,000 per income year\", and it applied only to spending between 7:30 pm on 29 March 2022 and 30 June 2023. It is the shorter-lived twin of the skills and training boost reported beside it.","dsrc":"ATO, Small business technology investment boost","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/income-and-deductions-for-business/deductions/small-business-technology-investment-boost","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business boost - small business technology investment boost","k":"Dollar amount, small business technology investment bonus deduction","def":"A whole-dollar bonus deduction of 20 per cent of eligible digital expenditure, restricted to the business share where an item is partly private, and calculated GST exclusive for a business registered for GST.","p":"2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Small business technology investment boost","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/income-and-deductions-for-business/deductions/small-business-technology-investment-boost","lim":"The cap makes it a censored measure of digital investment, since every business spending more than $100,000 records the same $20,000 bonus, and depreciating assets only count if they were in use by 30 June 2023. The ATO instructs the taxpayer to \"Add up the total amount of payments made to associates for principal work. Write the total at P1 Personal services income (PSI) – label K\", and defines principal work as \"the main work that generates the PSI\", which \"doesn't usually include support work, such as secretarial duties\". The table carries the same pair of fields for each loan type, so this unprefixed one is the vocational loan counterpart of the ABSTUDY and student start-up loan columns beside it.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Types of loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"VET Support Loan Repayable Debt","k":"Dollar amount, VET Student Loan repayable debt at assessment","def":"A dollar balance held against the assessment, distinct from the compulsory repayment raised in the year, which sits in its own column in the same table.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Types of loans","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","lim":"It is not the person's total study debt: HELP, SFSS, student start-up and apprenticeship loans are all held separately, so a vocational figure read alone understates what a former student owes. The ATO says of these loans that \"The debt will be indexed annually to keep up with changes in the cost of living\" and that \"Your loan may grow over time if no compulsory or voluntary repayments are made\", so this balance can rise between years without any new borrowing. It is the closing counterpart to the repayable debt column on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans, How study and training support loans work","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/how-study-and-training-support-loans-work","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"VET Support Loan Outstanding Repayable Debt","k":"Dollar amount, VET Student Loan repayable debt still outstanding","def":"A dollar balance outstanding at the point of assessment, after compulsory and voluntary repayments and after indexation have been taken into account.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans, How study and training support loans work","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/how-study-and-training-support-loans-work","lim":"A year-on-year fall in this balance cannot be read as repayment alone, because indexation pushes it the other way in the same period, and a rise does not mean new study. On the current return these are D1 work-related car expenses, D2 travel, D3 \"clothing, laundry and dry-cleaning\", D4 self-education and D5 \"other work-related expenses\", each of which the ATO frames as \"a deduction for expenses you incur as an employee\". It is narrower than total deductions, which also takes in investment deductions, gifts and the cost of managing tax affairs.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Deduction questions D1 to D10","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d1-d10-individual-tax-return-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Declared Total Work Related Deduction Amount","k":"Dollar amount, total work-related deductions claimed","def":"A whole-dollar total of the work expense questions on the main return, excluding the low-value pool, interest and dividend deductions that follow them.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Deduction questions D1 to D10","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d1-d10-individual-tax-return-2025","lim":"It is a self-assessed claim rather than a verified expense, and it is only meaningful for employees: a sole trader's equivalent costs are deducted inside business income on the schedule and never enter this total, so comparing employees with the self-employed on this column is misleading.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0001 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0001","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0102 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0102","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0203 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0203","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0304 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0304","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0405 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0405","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0506 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0506","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy9900 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_9900"]},{"n":"DED_UPP_AUST_PNSN_ANTY_AMT","d":"The part of an Australian pension or annuity payment that is a return of the person's own after-tax capital and so is not taxed again.","full":"The part of an Australian pension or annuity payment that is a return of the person's own after-tax capital and so is not taxed again. The ATO tells the taxpayer they will need payment summaries \"that show the amount of your annuity and its undeducted purchase price (UPP)\", and to \"subtract the deductible amount of the annuity’s UPP from the gross amount showing on the payment summary\". The figure is worked out by the payer over the expected term of the pension, so it is an actuarial split rather than a taxpayer's estimate.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuity and superannuation income streams","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Deductable amount of undeducted purchase price of pension or annuity","k":"Dollar amount, deductible amount of the undeducted purchase price","def":"A whole-dollar amount for the year, being the annual slice of the purchase price the person contributed from already-taxed money, spread across the life of the pension or annuity.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuity and superannuation income streams","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","lim":"It is not income and not a deduction in the ordinary sense: subtracting it from the gross pension gives the assessable part, and the ATO directs a negative result to be written as zero, so the column cannot be used to reconstruct gross pension payments. It is self-assessed and activity specific: the loss can only be revived against the same or a similar business activity, and it may be cut down by any net exempt income earned in the current year.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule instructions 2025, P8 Reconciliation items","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/reconciliation-items","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Deferred non-commercial business losses from a prior year - non-primary production","k":"Dollar amount, P8 Reconciliation items, deferred non-commercial losses from a prior year, non-primary production column","def":"Whole dollars, no cents, summed across all of the taxpayer's non-primary production business activities. The total therefore adds the unfranked amount at label S, the franked amount at label T and the franking credits at label U.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 11 Dividends","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/11-dividends-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total dividends","k":"Dollar amount, total of item 11 dividend labels S, T and U","def":"Whole dollars, the arithmetic total of the three item 11 income labels. The ATO puts it as \"Franking credits are amounts of tax paid by the company that are allocated to your dividend or distribution.\" For an individual the credit is refundable, so a retiree on a low rate can end up with cash back rather than merely a smaller bill.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 11 Dividends, label U","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/11-dividends-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Dividends franking credit","k":"Dollar amount reported at item 11 label U of the individual tax return","def":"Whole dollars written at item 11 label U, taken from the dividend statement but entered by the taxpayer. Then add any amount at label C and subtract the amounts at labels J and Y.\" It is a share of the entity's taxable net income rather than the cash distributed, and the ATO warns those two can differ.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 13 Partnerships and trusts","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net non primary production amount","k":"Dollar amount, Net non-primary production amount at item 13 of the supplementary tax return","def":"Whole dollars, no cents. The ATO builds it as \"Add the income amounts or loss amounts at labels N and L, and subtract the amounts at labels I and X.\" Keeping farm income separate is not cosmetic: the split is what feeds primary production income averaging and the chosen beneficiary rules for discretionary trusts that make a farming loss.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 13 Partnerships and trusts","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net primary production amount","k":"Dollar amount, Net primary production amount at item 13 of the supplementary tax return","def":"Whole dollars, no cents. The label text is the transferor trust question at item 19 label W, which the ATO asks as \"Do you, at any time, directly or indirectly transfer or cause the transfer of money, property or services to a non-resident trust?\" The column name expands to a death benefits deceased dependant indicator, and that fact lives at item 4, where the ATO's question 4 instructions define code D as \"If you receive a death benefit ETP and you're a death benefits dependant.\" Both are yes or no facts on the same return, which is how the mismatch survives.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 19 Foreign entities, label W; and question 4 Employment termination payments, ETP code D","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/19-foreign-entities-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Have you directly or indirectly caused transfer of property/services to a non-resident trust estate?","k":"Yes or no indicator on the individual tax return","def":"A two-state indicator. Under the label reading it is the X-in-a-box answer to the item 19 transferor trust question; under the name reading it is a dependency status attached to a death benefit employment termination payment.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 19 Foreign entities, label W; and question 4 Employment termination payments, ETP code D","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/19-foreign-entities-2025","lim":"Because the two readings are incompatible, the column cannot support either measure on the strength of the registry alone: counting yes values as transferor trust exposure and counting them as bereaved dependants give completely different populations. The ATO describes it as \"The education tax refund (ETR) helps eligible families and independent students meet the cost of primary and secondary school education\", paid as 50% of eligible expenses up to a per-child cap, which for 2010-11 was a refund of $397 per primary child and $794 per secondary child. Entitlement ran through Family Tax Benefit Part A, so it reached families receiving that payment and independent students, not all parents.","dsrc":"ATO, Education tax refund - what you need to know","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-c3c8eab2-f29d-4f41-a80b-3ce3c4febe7f","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Education tax refund","k":"Dollar amount claimed as the education tax refund, 2008-09 to 2010-11","def":"Whole dollars claimed on the individual return. It is half of the eligible expenses the taxpayer incurred, capped per child by school level, and it is refundable rather than a reduction in tax payable.","p":"2008-2009, 2009-2010","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Education tax refund - what you need to know","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-c3c8eab2-f29d-4f41-a80b-3ce3c4febe7f","lim":"A zero cannot be read as no school spending, because a family outside Family Tax Benefit Part A was ineligible however much they spent. The column also ends rather than falls: the ATO states \"You cannot claim the ETR for expenses incurred in 2011-12\", the scheme being replaced by a direct payment, so any trend through 2012 is a legislative event and not a change in family behaviour.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0809 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0809_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0910 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0910_16m"]},{"n":"ELGBL_TAX_EXMPTN_SPS_FBT_TOTL","d":"The taxpayer's report of their partner's salary packaged benefits from an employer that pays no fringe benefits tax, such as a public hospital or charity.","full":"The taxpayer's report of their partner's salary packaged benefits from an employer that pays no fringe benefits tax, such as a public hospital or charity. The ATO instruction is \"At label R, write the amount your spouse shows at question IT1 – label N in their tax return\", so the number is copied across from the spouse's own return rather than derived independently. It is kept apart from the spouse's non-exempt benefits at label S because several offsets treat the two categories differently.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Spouse details - married or de facto, label R","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/spouse-details-married-or-de-facto-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Your spouse's total reportable fringe benefits amounts - Employers exempt from FBT under section 57A of the FBTAA 1986","k":"Dollar amount reported in Spouse details, reportable fringe benefits from FBT-exempt employers","def":"Whole dollars at the spouse details label R. It is the grossed-up taxable value of benefits reported by the spouse's employer, and only benefits at or above the reporting threshold are ever included.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Spouse details - married or de facto, label R","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/spouse-details-married-or-de-facto-2025","lim":"It is one person's account of another person's tax return and can disagree with what the spouse actually lodged, particularly where the spouse lodges late or not at all. It is also not interchangeable with the spouse's non-exempt figure: the ATO does not adjust the exempt amount when calculating the invalid carer, zone, seniors and low income super offsets.","where":["madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2223 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2324 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2324_12m"]},{"n":"ELGBLTXEXMPTN_FBT_TTLRPRTBLAMT","d":"The taxpayer's own salary packaged benefits from an employer exempt from fringe benefits tax under section 57A, mostly hospital and charity employment.","full":"The taxpayer's own salary packaged benefits from an employer exempt from fringe benefits tax under section 57A, mostly hospital and charity employment. The amount comes off the employer's income statement or payment summary rather than being estimated by the taxpayer, and small benefits never appear: \"Don't show any benefit less than $3,773.\" It is not taxable income, but it counts in the income tests that decide the Medicare levy surcharge, family assistance and several offsets.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question IT1 Total reportable fringe benefits amounts, label N","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-test-it1-it8-individual-tax-return-2025/it1-total-reportable-fringe-benefits-amounts-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total reportable fringe benefits amounts - employers exempt from fbt under section 57a of the fbtaa 1986","k":"Dollar amount reported at question IT1 label N of the individual tax return","def":"Whole dollars at question IT1 label N, being the grossed-up taxable value of the benefits. Zero is written explicitly rather than left blank, and the non-exempt equivalent is reported separately at label W.","p":"2015-2016 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question IT1 Total reportable fringe benefits amounts, label N","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-test-it1-it8-individual-tax-return-2025/it1-total-reportable-fringe-benefits-amounts-2025","lim":"A zero does not mean the person received no fringe benefits, because anything under the reporting threshold is invisible and an employer aggregating below it reports nothing at all.
