How much counts depends on when it is taken: the whole bonus in the first eight years, \"two-thirds of the bonus amount you receive in 2024-25 if you receive it during the 9th year of the policy\", and one-third in the tenth year. Bonuses after the tenth year, and bonuses paid because the insured person died or surrendered the policy through illness or hardship, are not declared at all.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 22 Life insurance companies and friendly societies bonuses","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/22-life-insurance-companies-and-friendly-societies-bonuses-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Bonuses from life insurance companies and friendly societies","k":"Life insurance and friendly society bonuses at question 22 label W (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount already reduced to the assessable fraction for the policy year, so it is smaller than the bonus the person received in years nine and ten.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 22 Life insurance companies and friendly societies bonuses","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/22-life-insurance-companies-and-friendly-societies-bonuses-2025","lim":"It is not the investment return on the policy and not the amount received: the two-thirds and one-third steps mean the same cash bonus produces different figures depending on timing. LGA boundaries are reissued each year as councils change, and unincorporated areas have no council.","p":"2015-2016 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard Edition 3, Non ABS Structures, Local Government Areas","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/non-abs-structures/local-government-areas","lim":"It is a place, not a jurisdiction the taxpayer dealt with, and the ABS warns that these approximations \"should only be used for statistical purposes\", so it must not be used to allocate rates or council entitlements. Unlike the SA codes beside it this is an administrative boundary rather than a statistical one: it is drawn by state legislation and changes when councils amalgamate or split, so it is the right column for anything involving council rates, local government policy or a comparison with council-published data.","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard, Local Government Areas","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/non-abs-structures/local-government-areas","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","k":"ASGS Local Government Area code","def":"A five-digit ABS-assigned code for the LGA, whose leading digit is the state. The ABS approximates LGA boundaries from mesh blocks, so the coded area is a close fit to the gazetted boundary rather than the boundary itself.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard, Local Government Areas","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/non-abs-structures/local-government-areas","lim":"LGAs vary enormously in size and population, from a few hundred people to more than a million, so a per-LGA average is not comparable across them the way an SA3 average is. The pool held the slow-depreciating end of the asset base: \"a long-life small business pool for depreciating assets with an effective life of 25 years or more\", and the ATO's formula is \"Long-life small business pool deduction = opening pool balance ($) X 5%\", with half that rate in an asset's first year. Assets carried over from a general or long-life pool under the earlier simplified tax system kept the same treatment.","dsrc":"ATO, Partnership tax return instructions 2010, item 5 Business income and expenses","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/partnership-tax-return-2010-instructions/income-excluding-foreign-income/5-business-income-and-expenses","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Deduction for long life pool","k":"Deduction for the long-life small business pool (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount, 5% of the opening pool balance plus 2.5% of assets first used during the year. The ATO's own channels are myTax for self-preparers, a registered tax agent - \"they are the only people that can charge a fee\" - and the paper return lodged by mail, for which the ATO says most refunds issue within 50 business days. The channel matters for reading the rest of the row, because agent-lodged returns follow a later due date and pre-filled online returns carry fewer keying errors.","dsrc":"ATO, How to lodge your tax return","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/how-to-lodge-your-tax-return","dp":"ai","vp":"official","od":"Lodgment source","t":"categorical","k":"Lodgment channel for the return","def":"A code for the lodgment channel. The ATO's public channels are self-prepared online, registered tax agent and paper, with older years including the retired e-tax software; the stored code list is not published.","p":"2010-2011 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, How to lodge your tax return","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/how-to-lodge-your-tax-return","lim":"It records the path the form took, not who did the work, so a taxpayer who pays an accountant to prepare a return they then lodge themselves is counted as a self-preparer. The offset was never claimed on the return: \"You don't need to do anything to claim this tax offset, except lodge your tax return for the relevant year. We work out the offset after you lodge.\" It ran for four years only, and \"The 2021-22 income year was the last year for the LMITO - it isn't available for 2023 onwards.\"","dsrc":"ATO, Low and middle income earner tax offsets","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/low-and-middle-income-earner-tax-offsets","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Low and middle income tax offset used","k":"Low and middle income tax offset applied against tax (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount, the part of the entitlement absorbed by tax payable. Nothing is claimed for it: \"We will work out your offset and reduce your tax payable by this amount\", and it appears on the notice of assessment under non-refundable offsets. The current scale gives $700 up to a taxable income of $37,500 and tapers to nothing at $66,667; earlier years had different amounts and a separate low income offset for seniors.","dsrc":"ATO, Low income tax offset","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/tax-offsets/low-income-tax-offset","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Low income tax offset","k":"Low income tax offset (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount derived by the ATO from taxable income alone. The offset exists because back pay is taxed in the year it lands: \"Lump sum payments in arrears (LSPIA) are assessable in the income year you receive the payment\", which can push someone into a higher bracket for income they earned years earlier. The ATO calculates the entitlement from the year-by-year breakdown the payer supplies.","dsrc":"ATO, Lump sum payment in arrears","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/lump-sum-payment-in-arrears","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Lump sum payment in arrears offset available","k":"Lump sum payment in arrears tax offset available (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount produced by comparing tax on the arrears in the year received against tax had it been taxed in the years it accrued. It arises only where the arrears are at least 10% of threshold test income.","p":"2008-2009","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Lump sum payment in arrears","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/lump-sum-payment-in-arrears","lim":"An available amount is an entitlement, not a benefit received, so it overstates what the person gained wherever their tax payable was smaller. It is the applied twin of the available column on the same row, and the difference between them is entitlement that went unused because there was not enough tax to offset. The ATO does not publish the working: \"As the calculations are complex and relate to each individuals' personal circumstances, there currently is no online calculator or detail we provide to explain the outcome.\"","dsrc":"ATO, Lump sum payment in arrears","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/lump-sum-payment-in-arrears","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Lump sum payment arrears offset used","k":"Lump sum payment in arrears tax offset applied against tax (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount, at most equal to the available offset on the same row and at most the tax otherwise payable.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Lump sum payment in arrears","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/lump-sum-payment-in-arrears","lim":"A zero here is ambiguous: it can mean no arrears were received, or that an entitlement existed but no tax was payable to apply it against. Qualifying is a threshold test rather than a claim: \"The eligible LSPIA amount must be 10% or more of your threshold test income in the income year you receive it\" once earlier-year accruals and leave paid on termination are taken out. From 1 July 2024 the same arrears can also carry a Medicare levy exemption and a surcharge offset, which are separate amounts again.","dsrc":"ATO, Lump sum payment in arrears","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/lump-sum-payment-in-arrears","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Lump sum payment in arrears offset available","k":"Lump sum payment in arrears tax offset entitlement, later table (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of entitlement for the income year, sitting on the same row as the used amount so that the two can be differenced.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Lump sum payment in arrears","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/lump-sum-payment-in-arrears","lim":"It repeats a quantity the registry also holds under an older name in an earlier table, so summing the two across years counts one entitlement twice. The ATO defines lump sum A as unused long service leave \"that accrued after 15 August 1978, but before 18 August 1993\", unused holiday pay accrued before 18 August 1993, and any post-1993 unused leave paid with a genuine redundancy, early retirement or invalidity payment. Ordinary unused leave outside those cases is inside gross payments instead, not here.","dsrc":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: Payment details","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Lump sum a","k":"Lump sum A on the payment summary (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount the payer shows in the lump sum A field for the income year, never inside gross payments. The accrual dates mean two people with identical payouts can report very different amounts here purely because of when their leave built up.","where":["madipge-ato-d-pay-sum-fy2324 / plida_ps_2324_12m_bn"]},{"n":"LSPA_TYP","d":"Why the lump sum A on this record was paid, which decides how it is taxed.","full":"Why the lump sum A on this record was paid, which decides how it is taxed. Lump sum A is unused leave paid out when someone leaves a job, and the ATO splits it in two: code R covers unused annual leave, leave loading and post-1978 long service leave paid out for genuine redundancy, invalidity or an early retirement scheme, and code T covers the same kinds of leave paid out for any other reason. R is concessionally taxed and T is not, so the code separates a redundancy from a resignation.","dsrc":"ATO, Single Touch Payroll Phase 2 employer reporting guidelines: when an employee transfers or leaves","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/in-detail/single-touch-payroll-phase-2-employer-reporting-guidelines/when-an-employee-transfers-or-leaves","dp":"ai","vp":"official","od":"Lump sum a type","k":"ATO lump sum A type code","def":"The ATO's lump sum type code, reported alongside the lump sum A amount. Only R and T apply to lump sum A; the other lump sum boxes carry their own separate amounts rather than sharing this code.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Single Touch Payroll Phase 2 employer reporting guidelines: when an employee transfers or leaves","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/in-detail/single-touch-payroll-phase-2-employer-reporting-guidelines/when-an-employee-transfers-or-leaves","lim":"The code describes the reason the employer gave for the payment, not the circumstances of the departure. The ATO defines lump sum B for payers as \"Amounts you paid for unused long service leave that accrued before 16 August 1978\", and it is the whole payment as the employer reported it, even though only 5% of it is ever assessable. The return records the 5% rather than the whole, so this column and the return's lump sum B figure differ by a factor of twenty.","dsrc":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: Payment details","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Lump sum b","k":"Lump sum B on the payment summary (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount, the full lump sum B payment reported by the employer for the income year, kept out of gross payments.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: Payment details","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","lim":"It is now a rare and shrinking amount because it depends on service before August 1978, so a zero says nothing about a person's long service leave. The ATO defines lump sum D as \"The tax-free component of a genuine redundancy payment or an early retirement scheme payment\", and the individual return instructions tell taxpayers not to include it anywhere on their return. It is the best single marker in this table of an involuntary job loss on redundancy terms.","dsrc":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: Payment details","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Lump sum d","k":"Lump sum D on the payment summary (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount for the income year, set by a base amount plus a per-year-of-service amount that the ATO indexes each year, so the same redundancy yields different tax-free amounts in different years.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: Payment details","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","lim":"It is only the tax-free slice: the rest of the redundancy payout is an employment termination payment reported on a separate summary, so this column understates what the person received. The ATO defines lump sum E as \"Amounts you paid for back payment of salary or wages that accrued more than 12 months ago or any return to work payments.\" Separating it is what lets the ATO work out the lump sum payment in arrears offset, since the whole amount is taxed in the year it is paid.","dsrc":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: Payment details","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Lump sum e","k":"Lump sum E on the payment summary (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount reported by the employer for the income year, kept out of gross payments and declared by the taxpayer at the other income question.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: Payment details","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","lim":"The years the pay relates to are not in this column, so the arrears cannot be reassigned to the years they were earned without the payer's separate breakdown. The custodian's description names the ASGS 2016 edition, and the LGA, SA1 and SA2 columns on the same row are that one address coded to coarser units of the same standard.","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Mesh Blocks","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/mesh-blocks","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Asgs 2016 meshblock","k":"ASGS mesh block code","def":"A mesh block identifier from the ASGS, assigned by geocoding a single address; ASGS Edition 3 has 368,286 of them including 114 non-spatial special purpose codes.","p":"2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Mesh Blocks","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/mesh-blocks","lim":"A mesh block marks land use, not a household or a population, and the ABS notes that SA1 is generally the smallest unit at which Census data is released, so counts at mesh block level can be unstable or suppressed. The 2008 supplementary return carried the entitlement as item T9, printed as the \"20% tax offset on net medical expenses over the threshold amount\", so only the excess above the threshold attracted relief and only at twenty cents in the dollar. The figure is therefore third-hand, written by one partner about the other, and it feeds the family-income test that reduces or removes the levy.","dsrc":"ATO, Tax return for individuals 2001 (NAT 2541), Spouse details - married or de facto","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=2541-6.2001","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Medicare Spouse Income Amount","k":"Dollar amount of spouse's taxable income reported for the Medicare levy tests","def":"A whole-dollar figure of the spouse's taxable income for the same income year, reported on the taxpayer's return rather than taken from the spouse's own assessment.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Tax return for individuals 2001 (NAT 2541), Spouse details - married or de facto","url":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=2541-6.2001","lim":"A blank does not mean the person had no spouse or that the spouse had no income, only that no item on the return triggered the requirement to report it. The column appears only from the 2020-21 tables, and it is a calculated result, not anything the taxpayer wrote on the return.","dsrc":"ATO, Taxation statistics 2023-24, Reference material, Calculating net tax","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/about-ato/research-and-statistics/in-detail/taxation-statistics/taxation-statistics-2023-24/reference-material-for-taxation-statistics-2023-24","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total Medicare levy liability","k":"Dollar amount of assessed Medicare levy","def":"A dollar amount computed by the ATO from taxable income at the year's levy rate, then adjusted for the low-income reduction and for any full or half exemption days claimed at M1.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Taxation statistics 2023-24, Reference material, Calculating net tax","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/about-ato/research-and-statistics/in-detail/taxation-statistics/taxation-statistics-2023-24/reference-material-for-taxation-statistics-2023-24","lim":"A zero cannot be read as an exemption, because a low income, a family-income reduction or no taxable income all produce the same result, and the M1 day counts are needed to tell them apart. The ATO explains what it bites on: \"The MLS rate of 1%, 1.25% or 1.5% is levied on: your taxable income, total reportable fringe benefits, and any amount on which family trust distribution tax has been paid.\" It is calculated by the ATO, prorated by the days the person reported as not liable at M2 label A, and it sits on top of the ordinary Medicare levy.","dsrc":"ATO, Paying the Medicare levy surcharge","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy-surcharge/paying-the-medicare-levy-surcharge","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Medicare levy surcharge","k":"Dollar amount of assessed Medicare levy surcharge","def":"A dollar amount equal to the applicable surcharge rate applied to the surcharge base, scaled to the part of the year for which the person was liable.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Paying the Medicare levy surcharge","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy-surcharge/paying-the-medicare-levy-surcharge","lim":"A zero does not identify people with hospital cover, since income below the threshold, an exemption or no taxable income all give zero, and cover has to be read from the private health insurance columns instead. The rate depends on combined family income, so the amount reflects a spouse's circumstances as well as the taxpayer's.","where":["madip-ge-020105d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1011","madip-ge-020110d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1112","madip-ge-020115d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1213","madip-ge-020120d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1314","madip-ge-020125d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1415","madip-ge-020130d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1516","madip-ge-020135d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1617","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1718","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1819","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0607 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0708 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0809 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0809_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"MLS_NOT_PYBL_DAYS_CNT","d":"The number of days a person declared they were not liable for the Medicare levy surcharge.","full":"The number of days a person declared they were not liable for the Medicare levy surcharge. The ATO instruction is: \"Write at question M2 - label A the number of days for which you don't have to pay MLS\", and a person with no liability for the whole year writes 366. The question is compulsory for every taxpayer, so the column is populated even for people far below the surcharge threshold.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question M2 Medicare levy surcharge","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/tax-return/medicare-levy-questions-m1-m2/m2-medicare-levy-surcharge-2024","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Medicare levy surcharge - number of days not liable for surcharge","k":"Count of days, 0 to 366, at M2 label A","def":"A whole number of days from 0 to 366, entered by the taxpayer, that scales the surcharge the ATO then calculates.","p":"1999-2000, 2000-2001, 2001-2002, 2002-2003, 2003-2004, 2004-2005, 2005-2006, 2009-2010, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question M2 Medicare levy surcharge","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/tax-return/medicare-levy-questions-m1-m2/m2-medicare-levy-surcharge-2024","lim":"A full-year value cannot be read as holding private hospital cover, because everyone under the income threshold also writes the full year, and the two reasons are not distinguished. The ATO describes that base as \"your taxable income, total reportable fringe benefits, and any amount on which family trust distribution tax has been paid\", which is narrower than income for surcharge purposes. Income for surcharge purposes decides whether the surcharge applies and at which rate, and it also folds in net investment losses, reportable super contributions and a spouse's income.","dsrc":"ATO, Paying the Medicare levy surcharge, and Medicare levy surcharge income, thresholds and rates","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy-surcharge/paying-the-medicare-levy-surcharge","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Amount subjected to medicare levy surcharge","k":"Dollar amount of the base the surcharge rate was applied to","def":"A dollar amount equal to taxable income plus reportable fringe benefits plus any family trust distribution tax amount, before the 1%, 1.25% or 1.5% rate is applied.","p":"2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Paying the Medicare levy surcharge, and Medicare levy surcharge income, thresholds and rates","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy-surcharge/paying-the-medicare-levy-surcharge","lim":"It is not the income test that decides liability, so using it as a threshold measure will misclassify people whose investment losses or super contributions push their surcharge income higher. It is an individual base even though the rate that hits it was set by combined family income.","where":["madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"MLS_TAX_OFST_AMT","d":"Relief the ATO grants where a surcharge liability arose only because a back-payment covering earlier years landed in this year's income.","full":"Relief the ATO grants where a surcharge liability arose only because a back-payment covering earlier years landed in this year's income. The ATO sets out the spouse case at M2: \"If you are liable for MLS only because your spouse has shown a lump sum payment in arrears at question 20 ... or question 24 ... you may be entitled to a tax offset up to the amount of MLS you have to pay. We will calculate the tax offset for you.\" The column runs from the 2015-16 tables onward and is worked out by the ATO, not claimed at a label.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question M2 Medicare levy surcharge","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/tax-return/medicare-levy-questions-m1-m2/m2-medicare-levy-surcharge-2024","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Medicare Levy Surcharge Tax Lump Sum Payment in Arrears Offset","k":"Dollar amount of the Medicare levy surcharge lump sum in arrears tax offset","def":"A dollar offset capped at the surcharge otherwise payable, granted where arrears income rather than ordinary income took the household over the surcharge threshold.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question M2 Medicare levy surcharge","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/tax-return/medicare-levy-questions-m1-m2/m2-medicare-levy-surcharge-2024","lim":"It cannot be used to find everyone who received arrears, because it appears only where the arrears actually created a surcharge liability and the taxpayer supplied the supporting schedule. It runs from the 2010-11 to the 2019-20 tables. The address comes from the Business and professional items schedule, where the taxpayer writes the street address of the main business, so it locates the enterprise rather than the person. The ABS says SA4 \"boundaries represent labour markets and the functional area of Australian capital cities\".","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Statistical Area Level 4","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-area-level-4","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Business address of main business - SA4","k":"ASGS 2016 Statistical Area Level 4 code","def":"An SA4 identifier from the ASGS main structure, the largest sub-state region in that structure, geocoded from a single reported business address.","p":"2010-2011 to 2019-2020","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Statistical Area Level 4","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-area-level-4","lim":"It shows only the main business where a person ran several, and for a mobile or home-based trade the registered address can be an accountant's or a home office far from where work was done. The taxpayer's own residential geography is in different columns and the two should not be conflated.","where":["madip-ge-020102d-ato-atoitrcontext1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_context_1011","madip-ge-020107d-ato-atoitrcontext1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_context_1112","madip-ge-020112d-ato-atoitrcontext1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_context_1213","madip-ge-020117d-ato-atoitrcontext1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_context_1314","madip-ge-020122d-ato-atoitrcontext1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_context_1415","madip-ge-020127d-ato-atoitrcontext1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_context_1516","madip-ge-020132d-ato-atoitrcontext1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_context_1617","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_context_1718","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_context_1819","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920"]},{"n":"MN_BUS_ADDR_SA4_2021","d":"The main business SA4 as recoded to the ASGS 2021 boundaries, present only in the 2020-21 context table.","full":"The main business SA4 as recoded to the ASGS 2021 boundaries, present only in the 2020-21 context table. It replaces the 2016-edition column of the same content at the point where the ABS moved to Edition 3, so a business that did not move can still change code between the two columns. The ABS counts \"108 SA4s covering the whole of Australia without gaps or overlaps\", including 19 non-spatial special purpose codes such as no usual address.","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Statistical Area Level 4","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-area-level-4","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Business address of main business - sa4","k":"ASGS Statistical Area Level 4 code, 2021 edition","def":"An SA4 identifier under ASGS Edition 3 boundaries, geocoded from the business address reported on the Business and professional items schedule.","p":"2020-2021","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Statistical Area Level 4","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-area-level-4","lim":"Because only one table carries it, this column supports no trend on its own and joining it to the 2016-edition column will attribute boundary changes to business relocation. The special purpose codes mean a valid value can represent no locatable address at all.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_16m"]},{"n":"MN_BUS_ADDR_SA4_2122","d":"The main business SA4 in the 2021-22 context table, where the column suffix follows the financial year rather than any ASGS edition.","full":"The main business SA4 in the 2021-22 context table, where the column suffix follows the financial year rather than any ASGS edition. No edition of the standard is numbered 2122, so the boundary vintage cannot be read off the name and has to be taken from the year's ABS release, Edition 3. The ABS designs SA4s \"with an emphasis on stability over time to support the time series of statistical releases such as the Quarterly Labour Force publication\".","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Statistical Area Level 4","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-area-level-4","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"BUSINESS ADDRESS OF MAIN BUSINESS -SA4","k":"ASGS Statistical Area Level 4 code, 2021-22 table","def":"An SA4 identifier from the ASGS main structure, geocoded from the reported business address of the taxpayer's main business for 2021-22.","p":"2021-2022","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Statistical Area Level 4","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-area-level-4","lim":"The suffix in the column name is a year label, not a classification version, so treating it as an ASGS edition will produce a nonexistent vintage. Only one table carries the column, so it cannot be differenced against a neighbouring year without first confirming the boundaries match.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_context_2122_12m"]},{"n":"MN_BUS_TAX_OFC_ANZSIC_CD","d":"The industry of the taxpayer's main business or professional activity, as coded on the return.","full":"The industry of the taxpayer's main business or professional activity, as coded on the return. The ATO says: \"A business industry code (BIC) is a five-digit code you include on relevant tax returns and schedules that describes your main business activity\" and that \"BICs are derived from the Australian and New Zealand Standard Industrial Classification (ANZSIC) codes and have been simplified for tax return reporting purposes\". The paper schedule asks at P2 only for a written description of the main business or professional activity and carries no code box, so the five-digit code reaches the record through electronic lodgment or through ATO coding of that description.","dsrc":"ATO, Business industry code tool","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/calculators-and-tools/business-industry-code-tool","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Industry code of main business or professional activity - industry code","k":"ATO business industry code (five digits, derived from ANZSIC)","def":"A five-digit code from the ATO's simplified derivative of ANZSIC, describing one activity only.","p":"1999-2000, 2000-2001, 2001-2002, 2002-2003, 2003-2004, 2004-2005, 2005-2006, 2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Business industry code tool","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/calculators-and-tools/business-industry-code-tool","lim":"A BIC does not map one to one onto an ANZSIC class, so joining it to ABS industry statistics requires a concordance rather than a direct match. Someone with more than one business is told to code the activity with the highest gross income, and the code changes only when a new one is entered, so it can sit stale for years after the work changed.","where":["madip-ge-020102d-ato-atoitrcontext1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_context_1011","madip-ge-020107d-ato-atoitrcontext1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_context_1112","madip-ge-020112d-ato-atoitrcontext1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_context_1213","madip-ge-020117d-ato-atoitrcontext1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_context_1314","madip-ge-020122d-ato-atoitrcontext1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_context_1415","madip-ge-020127d-ato-atoitrcontext1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_context_1516","madip-ge-020132d-ato-atoitrcontext1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_context_1617","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_context_1718","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_context_1819","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0001 / ato_itr_context_0001","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0102 / ato_itr_context_0102","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0203 / ato_itr_context_0203","and 14 more"]},{"n":"MRTL_STS_CD","d":"A coded marital status carried against the 2009-10 return record, and against no other year.","full":"A coded marital status carried against the 2009-10 return record, and against no other year. The individual return does not ask for marital status directly; it asks whether the person had a spouse and for how long, and for the spouse's date of birth and sex, and those fields sit beside this one in the same table. The code is therefore either drawn from ATO client registration or derived from the spouse questions, and its code list is not published.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, Spouse details - married or de facto","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/tax-return/spouse-details-married-or-de-facto-2024","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Marital Status","k":"Marital status code held against the tax return record","def":"A short code standing for a marital status category, with no published value list and no matching label on the return.","p":"2009-2010","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, Spouse details - married or de facto","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/tax-return/spouse-details-married-or-de-facto-2024","lim":"Because it exists in one table only, it cannot support any change over time, and it cannot be checked against the spouse questions without knowing which code means what. Tax-record marital status also lags real relationship changes, since it only moves when a person tells the ATO.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy0910 / ato_itr_context_0910_16m"]},{"n":"MTR_AGE_WRKER_OFST_USED_AMT","d":"The mature age worker tax offset actually applied against a person's tax, held only for the 2006-07 to 2008-09 tables.","full":"The mature age worker tax offset actually applied against a person's tax, held only for the 2006-07 to 2008-09 tables. There was no claim box for it: the taxpayer supplied their net income from working and, as the 2008 supplementary return says, \"we use this amount to work out your mature age worker tax offset entitlement\". The offset was targeted at workers aged 55 and over and was later abolished, which is why no later table carries the column.","dsrc":"ATO, Tax return for individuals (supplementary section) 2008 (NAT 2679), item T12","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=2679-6.2008","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Mature age worker tax offset","k":"Dollar amount of mature age worker tax offset applied","def":"A whole-dollar non-refundable offset computed by the ATO from the taxpayer's net income from working and their age.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Tax return for individuals (supplementary section) 2008 (NAT 2679), item T12","url":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=2679-6.2008","lim":"Because the offset is non-refundable, the amount used is capped by the tax otherwise payable and so understates entitlement for people with little tax to pay. It may not be the amount of tax payable or refundable on a notice of assessment.\" For individuals it is tax on taxable income plus extra income tax, less non-refundable offsets, plus the Medicare levy and surcharge, less any remaining foreign income tax offset. The column runs across every year of the withholding and debt tables except 2009-10.","dsrc":"ATO, Taxation statistics 2023-24, Reference material, Calculating net tax","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/about-ato/research-and-statistics/in-detail/taxation-statistics/taxation-statistics-2023-24/reference-material-for-taxation-statistics-2023-24","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net tax","k":"Dollar amount of net tax","def":"A whole-dollar calculated amount built from the individual formula published by the ATO, floored at zero for the purpose of classifying taxable and non-taxable entities.","p":"1999-2000, 2000-2001, 2001-2002, 2002-2003, 2003-2004, 2004-2005, 2005-2006, 2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Taxation statistics 2023-24, Reference material, Calculating net tax","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/about-ato/research-and-statistics/in-detail/taxation-statistics/taxation-statistics-2023-24/reference-material-for-taxation-statistics-2023-24","lim":"It is not what the person paid or got back, because PAYG withholding, franking credits and other refundable credits have not been taken off, so a refund and a bill can sit behind the same net tax figure. An undeducted purchase price is the part of the pension bought with contributions that were never deducted, and the ATO handles it as a separate deduction rather than a reduction here: \"If your foreign pension or annuity has a deductible amount of a UPP, you claim a deduction for this amount at question D11.\" Foreign tax withheld overseas has to be added back before the figure is reported.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question 20 Foreign source income and foreign assets or property","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/20-foreign-source-income-and-foreign-assets-or-property-2024","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Foreign source income net foreign pension or annuity with upp","k":"Dollar amount at item 20 label D","def":"A whole-dollar net amount, grossed up for foreign tax, covering only those foreign pensions and annuities that carry an undeducted purchase price.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2024, question 20 Foreign source income and foreign assets or property","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2024/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/20-foreign-source-income-and-foreign-assets-or-property-2024","lim":"It is not the taxable amount, because the deductible part of the purchase price is subtracted at a different question, so this label overstates what is actually taxed. It is the same concept as the 2022-23 column but spelled differently in the data item list, EXMPTN here against EXPTN there, so the series has to be joined by hand. The amount is grossed up and is not taxable income, though it counts toward the income tests behind the Medicare levy surcharge, family assistance and child support.","dsrc":"ATO, Reportable fringe benefits for employees","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/working-as-an-employee/tax-and-fringe-benefits/reportable-fringe-benefits-for-employees","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","k":"Reportable fringe benefits total, employer not exempt under section 57A (dollars)","def":"A grossed-up dollar amount for the fringe benefits tax year, which runs to 31 March rather than 30 June. The section 57A split matters because exempt employers - public hospitals, charities, ambulance services - have their own column, and only the non-exempt amount is treated this way in some of those tests.","dsrc":"ATO, Reportable fringe benefits for employees","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/working-as-an-employee/tax-and-fringe-benefits/reportable-fringe-benefits-for-employees","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","k":"Reportable fringe benefits total, employer not exempt under section 57A (dollars)","def":"A grossed-up dollar amount for the fringe benefits tax year, which runs to 31 March rather than 30 June. Leaving the country does not suspend the debt: \"You must repay your HELP (previously known as HECS), AASL (previously known as TSL) and VSL if you live overseas and are not an Australian resident for tax purposes.\" The Trade Support Loan has since been renamed the Australian Apprenticeship Support Loan, so the column and the current ATO wording use different names for the same debt.","dsrc":"ATO, Overseas obligations when repaying loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/overseas-repayments","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Overseas TSL compulsory repayment due","k":"Dollar compulsory study and training loan repayment raised on an overseas resident","def":"A whole-dollar obligation raised at assessment, calculated from repayment income plus non-resident foreign sourced income against the published minimum repayment thresholds.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Overseas obligations when repaying loans","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/overseas-repayments","lim":"It only exists where the person reported worldwide income, so a zero mixes a genuine below-threshold year with a year of non-reporting. It is an amount raised, not an amount collected, and voluntary payments made from overseas do not reduce it.","where":["madip-ge-020130d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1516","madip-ge-020135d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1617","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1718","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1819","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"OS_HELP_RPMT_AMT","d":"The Higher Education Loan Program repayment obligation raised on a person who lived overseas and reported their worldwide income.","full":"The Higher Education Loan Program repayment obligation raised on a person who lived overseas and reported their worldwide income. The obligation is not always the same instrument: \"Repayments may be a compulsory repayment or an overseas levy depending on how your worldwide income is made up\", so this column and the overseas levy column beside it describe two routes to the same debt. The Trade Support Loan and VET Student Loan columns on the same row carry the equivalent amounts for those loan types.","dsrc":"ATO, Overseas obligations when repaying loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/overseas-repayments","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Overseas HELP repayment","k":"Dollar HELP repayment obligation raised on an overseas resident","def":"Whole dollars raised against a HELP account at assessment, worked out from repayment income plus non-resident foreign sourced income converted to Australian dollars.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Overseas obligations when repaying loans","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/overseas-repayments","lim":"It says nothing about the loan balance behind it, which keeps being indexed whether or not a repayment is raised. A person with a HELP debt who never lodged a worldwide income report simply has no row, so absence is not evidence of no debt.","where":["madip-ge-020130d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1516","madip-ge-020135d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1617","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1718","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1819","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"OS_LVY_RPMT_DUE_AMT","d":"The VET Student Loan repayment obligation raised on a person living overseas, charged as an overseas levy where the income behind it was foreign sourced.","full":"The VET Student Loan repayment obligation raised on a person living overseas, charged as an overseas levy where the income behind it was foreign sourced. The ATO explains the split: \"Repayments may be a compulsory repayment or an overseas levy depending on how your worldwide income is made up.\" A levy is worked out on net non-resident foreign sourced income after a standard deduction under the simple self-assessment method, which is why it can differ from an ordinary compulsory repayment on the same income.","dsrc":"ATO, Overseas obligations when repaying loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/overseas-repayments","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"VET Support Loan Overseas Compulsory Repayable Due","k":"Dollar VET Student Loan overseas repayment obligation","def":"Whole dollars raised against a VET Student Loan account, derived from worldwide income converted to Australian dollars under one of the three published income assessment methods.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Overseas obligations when repaying loans","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/overseas-repayments","lim":"The column cannot show which assessment method produced the figure, and the three methods give different answers on the same underlying income. It also covers only the VET loan, so a person with several study debts has their obligation spread across the neighbouring loan columns.","where":["madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"OTH_AUST_PNSN_ANTY_AMT","d":"The assessable amount of Australian pensions and annuities other than government pensions and allowances, which are reported at their own item.","full":"The assessable amount of Australian pensions and annuities other than government pensions and allowances, which are reported at their own item. The ATO describes the private side of this income as follows: \"Australian annuities (or non-super annuities) are a series of regular payments you receive from a life insurance company or friendly society in return for a lump sum payment.\" The amount is net of the deductible part of any undeducted purchase price, so it is smaller than the gross pension shown on the payer's payment summary.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuities and superannuation income streams","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other Australian pensions or annuities","k":"Dollar amount of assessable Australian pension and annuity income","def":"Whole dollars of assessable pension or annuity income, taken from a payment summary issued by a super fund, retirement savings account provider or life office, and reduced by the deductible amount of the undeducted purchase price.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuities and superannuation income streams","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","lim":"It is not a measure of retirement income across time. From 1 July 2007 superannuation income streams from a taxed source stopped being assessable for people aged 60 and over, so the same person with the same pension can drop out of this column entirely without any change in what they receive.","where":["madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m"]},{"n":"OTHR_BUS_INCM_NPP_AMT","d":"Business income from non-primary production activities that none of the named payment labels picked up, which for most sole traders is the bulk of their turnover.","full":"Business income from non-primary production activities that none of the named payment labels picked up, which for most sole traders is the bulk of their turnover. It is defined by exclusion: \"Your 'other business income' excludes amounts shown at labels C, D, B, E, F, N, O, G and H in your schedule.\" What is left includes gross sales of trading stock, gross earnings from services, recouped expenses, bad debts recovered, profit on sale of depreciating assets, royalties, insurance recoveries, subsidies and foreign exchange gains.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P8 Income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/income-p8","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other business income - non-primary production","k":"Dollar amount reported at P8 Income label J","def":"Whole dollars of gross income, before expenses, and able to be a loss; the primary production equivalent is label I on the same row.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P8 Income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/income-p8","lim":"Because it is a residual, its meaning shifts with the labels around it: a change in withholding or reporting arrangements moves money between labels without anything changing in the business. It is turnover, not profit, so it cannot be compared with the net business income figures on the return.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"OTHR_BUS_INCM_NPP_CD","d":"The one-character box beside non-primary production other business income, which marks the amount as a loss rather than income.","full":"The one-character box beside non-primary production other business income, which marks the amount as a loss rather than income. The instruction for the label reads: \"If you make a loss, print L in the box at the right of the amount at label J.\" Its counterpart beside the primary production label works the same way, so the two code columns carry the sign for the two amount columns.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P8 Income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/income-p8","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other business income - non-primary production code","k":"Loss indicator beside P8 Income label J","def":"A single character, L where the label J amount is a loss and blank otherwise, with the amount column itself stored unsigned.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P8 Income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/income-p8","lim":"Ignoring it turns every loss into income of the same size, so a total built from the amount column alone is biased upwards. It carries no information about the kind of business or the source of the income.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy0607 / ato_itr_context_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0708 / ato_itr_context_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0809 / ato_itr_context_0809_16m"]},{"n":"OTHR_BUS_INCM_PP_AMT","d":"Farm business income that none of the named payment labels picked up, reported at P8 Income label I.","full":"Farm business income that none of the named payment labels picked up, reported at P8 Income label I. For a primary producer the amount is built from a separate worksheet: the instruction is to \"add the amounts shown at PP1, PP2, PP6, PP7 and PP10 on your Gross income from primary production worksheet\" and add any other primary production business income to that total. Livestock killed for rations and livestock exchanged for goods or services are counted at value here, so the label reaches beyond cash sales.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P8 Income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/income-p8","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other business income - primary production","k":"Dollar amount reported at P8 Income label I","def":"Whole dollars of gross primary production business income, before expenses and able to be a loss, with the non-primary production equivalent at label J.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P8 Income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/income-p8","lim":"It cannot identify the farm activity behind the money, and it will not agree with farm cash receipts because non-cash items such as rations and barter are included at valuation. A person running a farm and a shop has both split across this label and label J by their own judgement.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"OTHR_BUS_INCM_PP_CD","d":"The one-character box beside primary production other business income, marking that amount as a loss.","full":"The one-character box beside primary production other business income, marking that amount as a loss. The instruction is: \"If you make a loss, print L in the box at the right of the amount at label I.\" Because primary producers can swing between a strong year and a loss year, this flag decides whether the farm income column on the same row adds to or subtracts from total business income.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P8 Income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/income-p8","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other business income - primary production code","k":"Loss indicator beside P8 Income label I","def":"A single character, L where the label I amount is a loss and blank otherwise; the paired amount is stored without a sign.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P8 Income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/income-p8","lim":"It flags the sign of one label only, not the overall farm result, which also depends on the expense side of P8. A blank is not evidence of a profit: it is equally consistent with the label being unused.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy0607 / ato_itr_context_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0708 / ato_itr_context_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0809 / ato_itr_context_0809_16m"]},{"n":"OTHR_BUS_INCM_TOTL_AMT","d":"The combined other business income of a sole trader, taking the primary and non-primary production labels together.","full":"The combined other business income of a sole trader, taking the primary and non-primary production labels together. The instruction is to \"Add up your 'other' primary production and non-primary production business income or loss and write the total in the adjacent Totals box\", with an L printed beside it where the combined figure is a loss. It is the widest of the three other-income columns on the row and the one that feeds total business income.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P8 Income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/income-p8","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other business income - total","k":"Dollar total of P8 Income labels I and J","def":"Whole dollars, the arithmetic sum of P8 Income labels I and J, and able to be a loss.","p":"1999-2000, 2000-2001, 2001-2002, 2002-2003, 2003-2004, 2004-2005, 2005-2006, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P8 Income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/income-p8","lim":"It nets a farm loss against shop income, so a person can show a modest total while running one profitable and one loss-making business. Using it alongside the two component columns in the same model counts the same dollars twice.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0001 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0001","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0102 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0102","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0203 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0203","and 11 more"]},{"n":"OTHR_DDCTNS_ELCTN_EXPNSS_AMT","d":"What a candidate spent contesting an election, claimed as a deduction on their own tax return.","full":"What a candidate spent contesting an election, claimed as a deduction on their own tax return. The ATO says \"Election expenses include a candidate's costs of contesting an election at a local, territory, state or federal level of government\", and caps the local government version: \"A deduction for local government election expenses can't exceed $1,000 for each election you contest, even if you incur the expenditure in more than one income year.\" It has its own label so that it is separated from the general other deductions total beside it.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question D15 Other deductions","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d11-d15-supplementary-tax-return-2025/d15-other-deductions-not-claimable-elsewhere-in-your-tax-return-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other deduction election expenses","k":"Dollar amount reported at D15 label E","def":"Whole dollars, self-assessed by the candidate, with local government claims capped at $1,000 per election and entertainment costs deductible only in narrow circumstances.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question D15 Other deductions","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d11-d15-supplementary-tax-return-2025/d15-other-deductions-not-claimable-elsewhere-in-your-tax-return-2025","lim":"It counts candidates who lodged a claim, not everyone who stood for office, so it is a poor census of candidacy. A reimbursement of the expenses is taxed as income at the other income item rather than netted off here, so the column overstates what the candidate finally bore.","where":["madip-ge-020103d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1011","madip-ge-020108d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1112","madip-ge-020113d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1213","madip-ge-020118d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1314","madip-ge-020123d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1415","madip-ge-020128d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1516","madip-ge-020133d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1617","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1718","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1819","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0607 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0708 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0809 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0809_16m","and 8 more"]},{"n":"OTHR_DDCTNS_TOTL_AMT","d":"Deductions the taxpayer could not claim at any other question, totalled into one figure.","full":"Deductions the taxpayer could not claim at any other question, totalled into one figure. The instruction is to \"Add up all the other expenses that you're claiming at this question (excluding election expenses)\" and write the result at D15 label J, so the election expenses column beside it is deliberately kept out. It is the catch-all of the deduction section, and debt deductions attributable to a rental property are among the items pushed into it.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question D15 Other deductions","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d11-d15-supplementary-tax-return-2025/d15-other-deductions-not-claimable-elsewhere-in-your-tax-return-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other deduction other deductions","k":"Dollar amount reported at D15 label J","def":"Whole dollars, a total of unlike residual deductions with no category attached, and separate from the election expenses total at label E on the same item.","p":"1999-2000, 2000-2001, 2001-2002, 2002-2003, 2003-2004, 2004-2005, 2005-2006, 2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question D15 Other deductions","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d11-d15-supplementary-tax-return-2025/d15-other-deductions-not-claimable-elsewhere-in-your-tax-return-2025","lim":"The column names nothing, so it cannot support a claim about what people deduct. The ATO allows it for \"Certain capital expenditure you incur after 30 June 2001, which directly connects with a project that you carry on (or propose to carry on) for a taxable purpose\", which the taxpayer allocates to a pool and writes off over the project life. Feasibility studies, site preparation and community infrastructure are typical inclusions, and the deduction normally runs from the year the project starts to operate, with a separate claim available in the year a project is abandoned, sold or otherwise disposed of.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question D13 Deduction for project pool","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d11-d15-supplementary-tax-return-2025/d13-deduction-for-project-pool-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Deduction for project pool","k":"Dollar amount deducted for a project pool (question D13)","def":"A whole-dollar deduction for one income year, worked out as the pool value at a rate of 150 or 200 per cent divided by the taxpayer's own estimate of project life in years. TaxPack 2000 records both the change and the credit: \"On 1 July 2000 the pay as you go (PAYG) instalments system replaced the provisional tax system. The taxpayer did not write it on the return; TaxPack took the figure \"from your assessment notice\" when estimating the refund.","dsrc":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), Pay as you go instalments (replacing provisional tax)","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Provisional Tax Credit","k":"Dollar amount of provisional tax credited on assessment","def":"A whole-dollar credit for tax already paid, applied against the year's liability at assessment. Provisional tax was charged to people with business and investment income, so the credit only ever existed for that group.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), Pay as you go instalments (replacing provisional tax)","url":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","lim":"It measures tax prepaid under a system that ended, not income or liability, so it cannot be used as an income marker. The ATO sets out the mechanism: \"Personal services income (PSI) is income that is mainly a reward for your personal efforts or skills. It is generally paid either to you or to a personal services entity (a company, partnership or trust)\", and where the entity neither runs a personal services business nor pays it out promptly as salary, the income is attributed to the individual. Sole traders never use this label; their PSI goes to question 14 instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 9 Attributed personal services income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/9-attributed-personal-services-income-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Attributed personal services income","k":"Dollar amount of attributed personal services income (question 9, label O)","def":"A whole-dollar income amount, net of certain deductions the entity incurred in producing it, taken from a PAYG payment summary showing personal services attributed income or from the person's own attribution calculation.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 9 Attributed personal services income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/9-attributed-personal-services-income-2025","lim":"It captures only the interposed-entity case, so it is not a measure of contracting income: the same person as a sole trader would show nothing here. It is a credit against the person's assessment, not a deduction, and it belongs to the amount at PRSNL_SRVCS_ATRBD_INCM_AMT on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 9 Attributed personal services income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/9-attributed-personal-services-income-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax withheld on attributed personal services income","k":"Dollar amount of tax withheld from attributed personal services income (question 9)","def":"A whole-dollar withholding credit reported by the personal services entity on a PAYG payment summary, so it is third-party reported rather than estimated by the taxpayer.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 9 Attributed personal services income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/9-attributed-personal-services-income-2025","lim":"It is not a tax liability and not a tax rate: an entity that withheld nothing leaves this blank while the attributed income still has to be declared, so a zero here beside a positive income figure is normal rather than an error. The instruction is a single step: \"Write the date you became, or stop being, an Australian resident for tax purposes in the Date box at question A2\". The ATO uses it with the months count at label N to work out a reduced tax-free threshold for the year.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question A2 Part-year tax-free threshold","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/adjustment-questions-a1-a4-individual-tax-return-2025/a2-part-year-tax-free-threshold-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Part-year tax-free threshold date","k":"Date of becoming or ceasing to be an Australian resident (question A2)","def":"A calendar date within the income year, self-assessed by the taxpayer against the residency tests. The counting rule rounds up: \"Write the number of months that you were an Australian resident for tax purposes in 2024–25, counting the month during which you became, or stop being, a resident for tax purposes\". The ATO uses the count to scale the tax-free threshold, so it is an entitlement input rather than a demographic measure.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question A2 Part-year tax-free threshold","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/adjustment-questions-a1-a4-individual-tax-return-2025/a2-part-year-tax-free-threshold-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Part-year tax-free threshold - months eligible","k":"Count of months of Australian tax residency, 1 to 12 (question A2, label N)","def":"A whole number of months, in practice 1 to 12, stored as a code. The ATO defines the boundary: \"Write the total of your share of non-primary production partnership income or loss (excluding any attributed foreign income or other foreign source income) at question 13 – label O\", and adds that a franked distribution belongs here grossed up: \"The amount you include at label O should include the amount of any attached franking credits\". Foreign amounts go to the foreign income questions instead, which is why the label carries the qualifier.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 13 Partnerships and trusts","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Distribution from partnerships less foreign income non primary production","k":"Dollar amount of non-primary production partnership distribution (item 13, label O)","def":"A whole-dollar share of the partnership's net income worked out for tax purposes, which can be negative and is then flagged with an L in the loss box.
