The instruction is direct: \"Write the total of your share of primary production partnership income or loss at question 13 – label N Distribution from partnerships\". The activity split matters because primary production amounts feed the income averaging calculation, and the trust equivalent sits separately at label L.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 13 Partnerships and trusts","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Distribution from partnerships primary production","k":"Dollar amount of primary production partnership distribution (item 13, label N)","def":"A whole-dollar share of the partnership's net income for tax purposes, positive or negative, with a loss marked by printing L in the box at the right of label N.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 13 Partnerships and trusts","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2025","lim":"It is a share of taxable net income, not drawings, so it cannot be read as farm household cash. The answer decides who may self-assess: \"If you don’t satisfy the results test and 80% or more of your PSI in 2024–25 comes from one client and its associates (that is, from one source), you can't self-assess whether you satisfy the other personal services business tests\". The claim ran off the insurer's statement rather than off the premiums paid: \"If the amounts at G on your statements are $0, you have already received your full entitlement and you do not need to complete this item\".","dsrc":"ATO, Tax return for individuals instructions 2011, question T5 Private health insurance","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t1-t5/t5-private-health-insurance-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Private health insurance tax offset","k":"Dollar amount of private health insurance tax offset claimed in the return","def":"A whole-dollar tax offset, worked out from the insurer's annual statement as the rebatable share of premiums paid less any reduction already received. The ATO describes the settling up plainly: \"When you lodge your tax return, the PAYG instalments you have paid during the year are offset against your tax, leaving you with little or no tax to pay\". Entry to the system is largely automatic: an individual enters on all three of instalment income of $4,000 or more on the latest return, tax payable of $1,000 or more on the latest notice of assessment, and notional tax of $500 or more, so the credit marks people with substantial income outside wages.","dsrc":"ATO, Starting PAYG instalments","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/payg-instalments/starting-payg-instalments","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Credit for PAYG income tax instalments","k":"Dollar amount credited for PAYG income tax instalments","def":"A whole-dollar credit applied at assessment, sourced from the ATO's own instalment records rather than written on the return by the taxpayer.","p":"2010-2011 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Starting PAYG instalments","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/payg-instalments/starting-payg-instalments","lim":"It is a prepayment of tax, not income and not a liability, so it cannot be added to withholding credits as though it measured earnings. The notice of assessment is the statement that carries the same quantities, showing the tax owed on taxable income and the \"credit you have for tax already paid during the income year\". The word rebate is an older name for what the return now calls a tax offset, which is why the column label reads oddly against the modern form.","dsrc":"ATO, Your notice of assessment","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/your-notice-of-assessment","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Total rebates and credits calculated amount","k":"Dollar total of rebates and credits allowed on assessment, 2010-11 to 2014-15","def":"A whole-dollar total computed at assessment rather than written on the return. The column also stops after the 2014-15 tables, and RBTS_AND_CRS_TOTL_AMT carries the same custodian wording for the earlier and later years, so a continuous series needs both and still has no value for 2009-10.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415"]},{"n":"RBTS_AND_CRS_TOTL_AMT","d":"The assessment's combined total of tax offsets and credits, under the column name used for 1999-2000 to 2008-09 and again from 2015-16 onwards.","full":"The assessment's combined total of tax offsets and credits, under the column name used for 1999-2000 to 2008-09 and again from 2015-16 onwards. It is administrative bookkeeping rather than a fact about the taxpayer.","dsrc":"ABS, Person Level Integrated Data Asset (PLIDA)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/about/data-services/data-integration/integrated-data/person-level-integrated-data-asset-plida","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Record id","k":"Row identifier within the salary and wage table","def":"An opaque record number scoped to this table and this extract. Repair is a documented stage of the ABS process: \"Prior to address coding it may be advisable to examine the address records and repair the content of these records to facilitate the automatic address coding processes.\" The typical repairs are formatting fixes, adding a state derived from the postcode and stripping stray characters, rather than substituting a different address. Together with GEOCODE_INDEX it describes how the SA1 and mesh block codes on the row were produced.","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, SSF Guidance Material - Geocoding Unit Record Data Using Address and Location, section 'Address repair'","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/statistical-geography/statistical-spatial-framework-ssf/statistical-spatial-framework-guidance-material/ssf-guidance-material-geocoding-unit-record-data-using-address-and-location","dp":"official","vp":"official","od":"Repair result","k":"abs_address_repair_result","def":"A small set of outcome values separating an address the repair step changed, one it examined and left unchanged, and one that needed no repair. The figure is grossed up to the pre-tax salary the employee would have needed to buy the benefit themselves, so it is larger than the benefit's cash value.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question IT1 Total reportable fringe benefits amounts","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-test-it1-it8-individual-tax-return-2025/it1-total-reportable-fringe-benefits-amounts-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total reportable fringe benefits amount","k":"Grossed-up dollar amount of reportable fringe benefits (question IT1)","def":"A whole-dollar grossed-up total across all employers, transcribed from income statements and payment summaries, so it is third-party reported. The ATO counts it broadly: \"Rental income is the full amount of money you earn when you rent out your property (including renting out a room through the sharing economy)\", with retained bond money, insurance payouts for lost rent and cancellation fees all included. The taxpayer writes \"your share of the interest expenses that you can claim as a deduction\", which is the deductible part only: \"If you have redrawn funds or increased your rental property loan for personal use, you can claim interest only on the part of the loan related to the rental property\". Read against gross rent on the same row, it is what makes a property negatively geared.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 21 Rent","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/21-rent-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Rent interest deductions","k":"Dollar amount of rental interest deduction (question 21, label Q)","def":"A whole-dollar deduction for the taxpayer's ownership share, self-assessed by apportioning loan interest to the rental use. The arithmetic is fixed: \"Add up the amounts at question 21 – labels Q , F and U . Subtract the total from the amount at question 21 – label P . This is your net rent\". A negative result, the usual sign of negative gearing, is not written with a minus: \"If your expenses are greater than your gross rent, you have made a rental loss. Print L in the Loss box at Net rent\".","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 21 Rent","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/21-rent-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Rent net rent","k":"Dollar amount of net rent or rental loss (question 21)","def":"A whole-dollar derived amount, fully determined by gross rent and the three rental deduction columns on the same row, with the sign carried in a separate loss flag.","p":"1999-2000 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 21 Rent","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/21-rent-2025","lim":"The sign is the trap: a stored magnitude without the loss flag makes a heavily geared landlord look like a profitable one, and aggregating without it will overstate rental income. The instruction names the single carve-out: write \"your share of the other rental expenses that you can claim as a deduction (except any low-value pool deduction)\". Rates, insurance, agent commission, repairs, and decline in value of assets all sit inside it, which is why it is the second largest rental column after interest.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 21 Rent","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/21-rent-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Rent other rental deductions","k":"Dollar amount of other rental deductions (question 21, label U)","def":"A whole-dollar residual deduction for the taxpayer's ownership share, self-assessed. The ATO defines it as \"expenditure shown in your accounts for repairs and maintenance of premises, plant, machinery, implements, utensils, rolling stock or articles associated with the production of income\", and adds that any capital or private portion in that figure has to be added back at the expense reconciliation adjustment. The value on this row is the sum of the primary production and non-primary production columns.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule instructions 2025, P8 Expenses","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/expenses-p8","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Repairs and maintenance - total","k":"Dollar amount of business repairs and maintenance (schedule label P8 O)","def":"A whole-dollar accounting expense taken from the taxpayer's books, not a tax-adjusted deduction. The ATO defines the class: \"Reportable employer superannuation (super) contributions are additional to the compulsory contributions your employer must make. An example of a reportable employer super contribution is a contribution made on your behalf under a salary sacrifice arrangement\". This row is per payer, so the question IT2 figure on the return is the sum across an employee's payment summaries.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question IT2 Reportable employer superannuation contributions","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-test-it1-it8-individual-tax-return-2025/it2-reportable-employer-superannuation-contributions-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Reportable employer superannuation contributions","k":"Dollar amount of reportable employer superannuation contributions on a payment summary","def":"A whole-dollar amount reported by the employer alongside the gross payment, tax withheld and reportable fringe benefits on the same payment summary record.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question IT2 Reportable employer superannuation contributions","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-test-it1-it8-individual-tax-return-2025/it2-reportable-employer-superannuation-contributions-2025","lim":"It is not total employer superannuation, because compulsory contributions are excluded by definition, so it cannot be used to measure superannuation coverage or the guarantee. The ATO explains the inflation built into the number: \"Your RFBA is 'grossed-up' to reflect the pre-tax income you would have had to earn, at the highest marginal tax rate (plus the Medicare levy), to buy the benefits yourself\". Reporting is triggered only where benefits exceed a total taxable value of $2,000 in the fringe benefits tax year of 1 April to 31 March.","dsrc":"ATO, Reportable fringe benefits for employees","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/working-as-an-employee/reportable-fringe-benefits-for-employees","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Reportable fringe benefits amount","k":"Grossed-up dollar amount of reportable fringe benefits on a payment summary","def":"A whole-dollar grossed-up amount from a single payer's payment summary, sitting beside the gross payment, tax withheld and reportable employer superannuation contributions for that payer.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Reportable fringe benefits for employees","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/working-as-an-employee/reportable-fringe-benefits-for-employees","lim":"It is not taxed and not received in cash, so adding it to the gross payment on the same row invents income the person never got. Its reference period is the FBT year, which is three months out of step with the income year the rest of the row covers, and benefits below the $2,000 threshold never appear at all.","where":["madipge-ato-d-pay-sum-fy2324 / plida_ps_2324_12m_bn"]},{"n":"RPRTBLEMPLR_SPNTN_CNTRBTNS_AMT","d":"Employer super contributions the taxpayer influenced, most often salary sacrifice, totalled across every employer for the year.","full":"Employer super contributions the taxpayer influenced, most often salary sacrifice, totalled across every employer for the year. The taxpayer copies the figure from income statements and payment summaries, which makes it employer reported rather than self-assessed, and it is an income test input rather than assessable income.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question IT2 Reportable employer superannuation contributions","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-test-it1-it8-individual-tax-return-2025/it2-reportable-employer-superannuation-contributions-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Reportable employer superannuation contributions","k":"Dollar amount reported at item IT2 label T","def":"A whole-dollar amount, summed over all income statements and payment summaries for the year. Zero is written when there are no reportable contributions, so a blank and a nil are meant to differ.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question IT2 Reportable employer superannuation contributions","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-test-it1-it8-individual-tax-return-2025/it2-reportable-employer-superannuation-contributions-2025","lim":"It is not the person's total super contribution. Super guarantee, personal deductible contributions claimed at D12 and any contribution the employee could not influence are all outside it, so this column understates flows into a fund and cannot be used to reconstruct a contribution history.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0910 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0910_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920_16m","and 5 more"]},{"n":"RPYBL_DEBT_AMT","d":"Trade support loan debt the assessment worked out as repayable for the income year, for an apprentice who drew loan instalments during training.","full":"Trade support loan debt the assessment worked out as repayable for the income year, for an apprentice who drew loan instalments during training. The ATO describes the scheme, since renamed, as one where \"eligible Australian apprentices are offered loans over a 4-year period\". The amount is calculated by the ATO from repayment income rather than entered by the taxpayer, and it only appears from 2020-21 in this asset.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Types of loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Trade Support Loan Repayable Debt","k":"Dollar amount of trade support loan debt due for repayment","def":"A whole-dollar amount of compulsory repayment raised on the notice of assessment for the trade support loan component. A person with a trade support loan below the repayment threshold shows nothing here, so a zero is compatible with a substantial debt that is simply not yet repayable.","where":["madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"RSLTS_TST_IND","d":"Whether a sole trader claims to pass the results test, the first of the four personal services business tests.","full":"Whether a sole trader claims to pass the results test, the first of the four personal services business tests. Passing it lifts the deduction restrictions the personal services income rules otherwise impose. The ATO sets the bar at three conditions over most of the income: \"you satisfy the results test for 2024-25 if, in respect of at least 75% of your PSI, you can answer yes to all of the following 3 questions\". The answer is self-assessed on the business and professional items schedule, alongside PSI_BUS_DTMNTN_IND, PSI_80_PCT_ONE_SRC_IND and the three other test flags on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P1 Personal services income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/personal-services-income-p1","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Psi did you satisfy the results test","k":"Yes or no answer at P1 label P of the business and professional items schedule","def":"A yes or no indicator, printed as an X in one of two boxes at P1 label P. A no does not mean the PSI rules applied either, because the person may hold a personal services business determination or pass one of the other three tests recorded in the neighbouring flags.","where":["madip-ge-020102d-ato-atoitrcontext1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_context_1011","madip-ge-020107d-ato-atoitrcontext1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_context_1112","madip-ge-020112d-ato-atoitrcontext1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_context_1213","madip-ge-020117d-ato-atoitrcontext1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_context_1314","madip-ge-020122d-ato-atoitrcontext1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_context_1415","madip-ge-020127d-ato-atoitrcontext1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_context_1516","madip-ge-020132d-ato-atoitrcontext1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_context_1617","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_context_1718","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_context_1819","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_12m","and 4 more"]},{"n":"SA1","d":"The smallest ABS statistical area the lodger's address falls in, attached to the return by the ABS rather than reported by the taxpayer.","full":"The smallest ABS statistical area the lodger's address falls in, attached to the return by the ABS rather than reported by the taxpayer. SA1s are small: \"SA1s generally have a population of 200 to 800 people, and an average population of about 400 people.\" It sits with SA2 and LGA in the context table, so the three describe one address at three scales.","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Statistical Area Level 1","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-area-level-1","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Statistical Area Level 1 (SA1) 2011","k":"ASGS Statistical Area Level 1 code","def":"An ASGS statistical area code. The edition varies by table: the custodian's own label says the 2011 boundaries while the table named itr_geo2021_1516 carries the 2021 boundaries for the same reference year.","p":"2015-2016 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Statistical Area Level 1","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-area-level-1","lim":"It is the address the ATO held when the return was processed, not a residence at 30 June, and a person who moved mid-year is placed at one point only. Boundaries are also not stable across editions, so an SA1 series spanning the 2011, 2016 and 2021 standards is not a series for one place.","where":["madip-ge-020127d-ato-atoitrcontext1516-fy2015-16 / itr_geo2021_1516","madip-ge-020132d-ato-atoitrcontext1617-fy2016-17 / itr_geo2021_1617","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1718-fy2017-18 / itr_geo2021_1718","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_context_1819","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / itr_geo2021_1819","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_context_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2223 / ato_itr_context_2223_12m"]},{"n":"SA1_CODE_2021","d":"The finest ASGS area the taxpayer's address geocodes to on the return, at the 2021 boundaries.","full":"The finest ASGS area the taxpayer's address geocodes to on the return, at the 2021 boundaries. SA1s hold a few hundred people each, so this is the level at which a tax record says something about a neighbourhood rather than a suburb, and it is what SA2, SA3, SA4 and the state code on the same row roll up from. Because it is derived from the address, it inherits whatever the address is: a postal address or an agent's office puts the taxpayer in the wrong SA1 entirely.","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard Edition 3, Statistical Areas Level 1","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-areas-level-1","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","k":"ASGS 2021 Statistical Area Level 1 code","def":"An eleven-digit ASGS 2021 code whose leading digit is the state. There are 61,845 SA1s, of which 34 are special purpose codes for migratory, offshore and no-usual-address records.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard Edition 3, Statistical Areas Level 1","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-areas-level-1","lim":"SA1 counts are small enough that a cell can identify people, which is why tax analysis at this level is normally aggregated before release. Boundaries changed between the 2016 and 2021 editions, so an SA1 series across the change needs a correspondence rather than a join.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy2324 / ato_itr_context_2324_12m","madipge-ato-d-pay-sum-fy2324 / plida_ps_2324_12m_bn"]},{"n":"SA2","d":"The suburb-scale statistical area for the lodger's address, one level above the SA1 on the same row.","full":"The suburb-scale statistical area for the lodger's address, one level above the SA1 on the same row. The ABS designs SA2s to be meaningful places rather than convenient blocks: their \"purpose is to represent a community that interacts together socially and economically\", with populations \"between 3,000 and 25,000\". Most published small-area tax statistics are built at this level, so it is the practical unit for joining PIT to ABS estimates.","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Statistical Area Level 2","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-area-level-2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"SA2","k":"ASGS Statistical Area Level 2 code","def":"An ASGS statistical area code aggregating whole SA1s. As with SA1, the boundary edition differs between the geo2021 tables and the yearly context tables.","p":"2015-2016 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, Statistical Area Level 2","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-area-level-2","lim":"It cannot separate people within a suburb, and it carries no information on where income was earned, only where the lodger's recorded address was. Non-spatial codes such as No Usual Address are valid SA2 values, so an unmatched or itinerant lodger appears as a real area code rather than as missing.","where":["madip-ge-020127d-ato-atoitrcontext1516-fy2015-16 / itr_geo2021_1516","madip-ge-020132d-ato-atoitrcontext1617-fy2016-17 / itr_geo2021_1617","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1718-fy2017-18 / itr_geo2021_1718","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_context_1819","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / itr_geo2021_1819","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_context_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2223 / ato_itr_context_2223_12m"]},{"n":"SA2_CODE_2021","d":"The taxpayer's SA2 at the 2021 boundaries, which is the ASGS level most tax analysis is published at.","full":"The taxpayer's SA2 at the 2021 boundaries, which is the ASGS level most tax analysis is published at. SA2s are built to represent communities that interact socially and economically, so they answer questions about a suburb or town where the SA1 below them is too small to release and the SA3 above them is too coarse to recognise. It is derived from the same geocoded address as the other geography columns on the row.","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard Edition 3, Statistical Areas Level 2","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-areas-level-2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","k":"ASGS 2021 Statistical Area Level 2 code","def":"A nine-digit ASGS 2021 code whose leading digit is the state. SA3s are designed around labour markets and regional service catchments, which makes this the natural level for questions about where people work and what a regional economy looks like, rather than where a particular street is. It is derived from the same geocoded address as the finer geography on the row.","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard Edition 3, Statistical Areas Level 3","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-areas-level-3","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","k":"ASGS 2021 Statistical Area Level 3 code","def":"A five-digit ASGS 2021 code whose leading digit is the state. SA3s generally hold between 30,000 and 130,000 people.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard Edition 3, Statistical Areas Level 3","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-areas-level-3","lim":"An SA3 aggregates communities that differ from one another, so a median or a rate at this level hides variation the SA2 column would show. SA4s are built to be big enough for the Labour Force Survey to publish at, which is why labour market comparisons are made here and why an SA4 is the level at which a tax measure can be set beside an unemployment rate. It is derived from the same geocoded address as the finer geography on the row.","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard Edition 3, Statistical Areas Level 4","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-areas-level-4","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","k":"ASGS 2021 Statistical Area Level 4 code","def":"A three-digit ASGS 2021 code whose leading digit is the state. There are 108 SA4s, of which 19 are special purpose codes, generally holding 100,000 to 500,000 people.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard Edition 3, Statistical Areas Level 4","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/statistical-areas-level-4","lim":"An SA4 covers a whole city sector or a large slice of a state, so it cannot answer anything local; the SA2 column is the one for that. The code table runs from A, for a person who is \"single, separated or widowed\", through B and C for couples living apart through illness or a nursing home, to D and E for couples living together, split by whether the spouse is also eligible. The ATO describes it as \"a bonus 20% tax deduction for the cost of eligible assets and improvements that support more efficient use of energy\", capped by \"Up to $100,000 of total expenditure ... with the maximum bonus tax deduction being $20,000\". The incentive ran for one year only, so this column exists for 2023-24 and no other.","dsrc":"ATO, Small business energy incentive","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/income-and-deductions-for-business/deductions/small-business-energy-incentive","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business energy incentive","k":"Dollar amount of bonus deduction claimed under the small business energy incentive","def":"A whole-dollar bonus deduction, self-assessed, bounded above by $20,000 for the year. A zero in any other year is not a fall in energy spending, because the column has no other year.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2324 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2324_12m"]},{"n":"SB_TO_AVLBL_AMT","d":"The small business income tax offset the ATO worked out as available to the taxpayer before it was applied against tax payable.","full":"The small business income tax offset the ATO worked out as available to the taxpayer before it was applied against tax payable. The amount is calculated by the ATO from the net small business income figures on the return, not entered by the lodger, and the rate rose over time from 5 per cent in 2015-16 to 16 per cent from 2021-22.","dsrc":"ATO, Small business income tax offset","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/income-and-deductions-for-business/in-detail/small-business-income-tax-offset","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business income tax offset available","k":"Dollar amount of small business income tax offset available","def":"A whole-dollar offset amount, capped at $1,000 for the year, derived by the ATO. The offset is non-refundable, so a lodger with little or no tax payable can show an available amount and receive nothing, which is what SB_TO_USED_AMT on the same row records. The ATO works it out as a share of liability: \"The offset is worked out on the proportion of tax payable on your business income.\" The used amount is the one that costs revenue and reaches the taxpayer, so it is the right column for measuring benefit received.","dsrc":"ATO, Small business income tax offset","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/income-and-deductions-for-business/in-detail/small-business-income-tax-offset","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business tax offset amount used","k":"Dollar amount of small business income tax offset applied against tax payable","def":"A whole-dollar amount, never greater than the available amount on the same row and never greater than basic income tax liability. The ATO uses it to work out the small business income tax offset and defines it as \"your assessable income from carrying on your business less your deductions to the extent that they're attributable to that assessable income\". A net loss does not carry through, because it is treated as zero and no offset follows. Like its components it treats a loss as zero.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Small business income tax offset","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/income-and-deductions-for-business/in-detail/small-business-income-tax-offset","lim":"It is a wider figure than SBI_NET_AMT on the same row, so treating the two as alternative measures of the same thing double counts or undercounts depending on which is used. Because each component is floored at zero, a person with a large sole trader loss and a modest trust share shows the trust share alone rather than a net position.","where":["madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2223 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2324 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2324_12m"]},{"n":"SCNDRY_SCHL_STDNTS_CNT","d":"How many secondary school children the taxpayer claimed the education tax refund for, which set the ceiling on their claim.","full":"How many secondary school children the taxpayer claimed the education tax refund for, which set the ceiling on their claim. The limit was per child and higher for secondary than primary; for 1 July 2010 to 30 June 2011 the ATO set it at \"$1,588 for each eligible child in secondary school - that is, a refund of $794.\" The limits were set year by year, and in this asset the count exists for 2008-09 and 2009-10 only, before the refund was abolished.","dsrc":"ATO, Education tax refund - what you need to know, How much you can claim","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supporting-information/education-tax-refund-what-you-need-to-know/how-much-you-can-claim","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Education tax refund- no. of secondary school students","k":"Count of eligible secondary school children claimed for the education tax refund","def":"A small non-negative integer, self-assessed on the return. Its sibling column counts primary school children on the same basis.","p":"2008-2009, 2009-2010","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Education tax refund - what you need to know, How much you can claim","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supporting-information/education-tax-refund-what-you-need-to-know/how-much-you-can-claim","lim":"It counts children a claim was made for, not children in the household or even children in secondary school, so it misses families who were not receiving family tax benefit part A and those who lodged no claim. The column stops after 2009-10, so its absence in later years is the end of the measure rather than a change in school enrolment.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy0809 / ato_itr_context_0809_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0910 / ato_itr_context_0910_16m"]},{"n":"SEC_40_880_DDCTN_TOTL_AMT","d":"Business capital costs the taxpayer wrote off under section 40-880, the provision that catches start-up and wind-up expenditure no other deduction reaches.","full":"Business capital costs the taxpayer wrote off under section 40-880, the provision that catches start-up and wind-up expenditure no other deduction reaches. The ATO gives two routes: an immediate deduction for eligible start-up costs, and otherwise a spread, since the section \"allows you to deduct in equal proportions over a 5-year period certain capital expenditure you incur if the expenditure isn't already taken into account or not denied a deduction by another provision\". The figure is the primary production and non-primary production columns added together.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, Reconciliation items","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/reconciliation-items","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Section 40-880 deduction - total","k":"Dollar amount of section 40-880 deduction at P8 reconciliation items","def":"A whole-dollar deduction, self-assessed, that is the sum of the two production columns on the schedule. For the five-year route it is one fifth of the underlying spend in each of five years.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, Reconciliation items","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/business-income-and-expenses-p8/reconciliation-items","lim":"It cannot tell you when the money was spent. A small business claiming immediately and a larger one claiming a fifth of a five-year write-off appear identically here, so the column is not a measure of current-year capital outlay. Deductions deferred under the non-commercial loss rules also do not appear in the year the expense was incurred.","where":["madip-ge-020103d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1011","madip-ge-020108d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1112","madip-ge-020113d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1213","madip-ge-020118d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1314","madip-ge-020123d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1415","madip-ge-020128d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1516","madip-ge-020133d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1617","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1718","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1819","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0607 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0708 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0809 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0809_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"SEC_98A_2_DDCTN_AMT","d":"A credit a non-resident beneficiary claims for tax the trustee already paid on their share of a trust's net income.","full":"A credit a non-resident beneficiary claims for tax the trustee already paid on their share of a trust's net income. The ATO explains the sequence: tax assessed to the trustee \"is generally not a final tax\", and \"when the non-resident beneficiary prepares their Australian tax return, they can claim a credit for the tax paid by the trustee (under subsection 98A(2))\". Its presence is a strong marker that the lodger was a foreign resident with trust income, which is worth reading against CLNT_RSDNT_IND in the same context table.","dsrc":"ATO, Tax on trust distributions to non-resident beneficiaries","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/business-partnership-and-trust-income/tax-on-trust-distributions-to-non-resident-beneficiaries","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Section 98a amount","k":"Dollar amount of credit for trustee tax under subsection 98A(2)","def":"A whole-dollar credit against tax payable, not a deduction from income despite the DIL label, and reported only by beneficiaries assessed under section 98A.","p":"2010-2011 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Tax on trust distributions to non-resident beneficiaries","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/business-partnership-and-trust-income/tax-on-trust-distributions-to-non-resident-beneficiaries","lim":"It is not a measure of trust income received; a large credit can sit against a modest distribution taxed at the non-resident trustee rate. It also does not identify the trust, so it cannot be joined to a trust return, and it says nothing about credits claimed under the neighbouring section 98B route for chains of trusts.","where":["madip-ge-020102d-ato-atoitrcontext1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_context_1011","madip-ge-020107d-ato-atoitrcontext1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_context_1112","madip-ge-020112d-ato-atoitrcontext1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_context_1213","madip-ge-020117d-ato-atoitrcontext1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_context_1314","madip-ge-020122d-ato-atoitrcontext1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_context_1415","madip-ge-020127d-ato-atoitrcontext1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_context_1516","madip-ge-020132d-ato-atoitrcontext1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_context_1617","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_context_1718","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_context_1819","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_12m","and 4 more"]},{"n":"SEX","d":"The lodger's sex as the ATO holds it on its client record, carried onto the return rather than answered on the form.","full":"The lodger's sex as the ATO holds it on its client record, carried onto the return rather than answered on the form. It comes from what was supplied at tax file number registration and later updates, so it is an administrative attribute of a tax record and not a question the taxpayer answers each year. IDV_SPSS_SEX_CD in the same context table records the spouse's, and the two are collected the same way.","dsrc":"ABS, Person Level Integrated Data Asset (PLIDA) data and legislation, Australian Taxation Office data","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/integrated-data/person-level-integrated-data-asset-plida/plida-data-and-legislation","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Sex","k":"Sex recorded on the ATO client record for the lodger","def":"A short sex code with no published category list. Whether it carries anything beyond male and female, and how an unstated value is represented, cannot be read from the metadata.","p":"2018-2019 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Person Level Integrated Data Asset (PLIDA) data and legislation, Australian Taxation Office data","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/integrated-data/person-level-integrated-data-asset-plida/plida-data-and-legislation","lim":"It is not collected to an ABS statistical standard, so it should not be pooled with Census or vital statistics sex without first checking that the categories agree. Where it disagrees with a linked Census or birth record, the tax record is the weaker source, and a change between years reflects a register update rather than a measured event.","where":["madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_context_1819","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_context_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2223 / ato_itr_context_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2324 / ato_itr_context_2324_12m"]},{"n":"SF_16PC_IND","d":"A flag marking whether this return was drawn into a 16 per cent sample file of individual tax returns.","full":"A flag marking whether this return was drawn into a 16 per cent sample file of individual tax returns. The ATO publishes sample files of individual return information for modelling and research, noting that \"For income years 2003-04 to 2010-11, the files contain a 1% sample of records. From 2011-12 onwards, the files contain a 2% sample of records\", so the 16 per cent frame named here is a larger internal sample rather than one of the published files. It first appears for 2018-19 and sits with SA1, SA2 and LGA in the context table.","dsrc":"ATO, Taxation statistics, Individuals sample files","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/about-ato/research-and-statistics/in-detail/taxation-statistics/taxation-statistics-previous-editions/taxation-statistics-2017-18/statistics/individuals/individuals-sample-files","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"16% sample file indicator","k":"Flag marking inclusion in an ATO 16 per cent sample file of individual returns","def":"A record-level indicator, present from 2018-19 onwards. The sampling frame, the stratification and whether the flag is stable for a person across years are all unpublished.","p":"2018-2019 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Taxation statistics, Individuals sample files","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/about-ato/research-and-statistics/in-detail/taxation-statistics/taxation-statistics-previous-editions/taxation-statistics-2017-18/statistics/individuals/individuals-sample-files","lim":"It is not a survey weight and carries no expansion factor, so selecting on it produces a sample that cannot be grossed to the lodger population without design information the asset does not carry. Because the frame is undocumented, a comparison of flagged and unflagged records could reflect the sample design rather than any real difference.","where":["madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_context_1819","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_context_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2223 / ato_itr_context_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2324 / ato_itr_context_2324_12m"]},{"n":"SFSS_CLCTBL_DEBT_OUTSTG_AMT","d":"The accumulated student financial supplement scheme debt still outstanding for this taxpayer at assessment.","full":"The accumulated student financial supplement scheme debt still outstanding for this taxpayer at assessment. The scheme is closed to new borrowing, so the population can only shrink: it \"was a voluntary loan scheme to help tertiary students cover their expenses while they studied\" and \"closed on 31 December 2003. However, all existing SFSS loans continue to be collected through the tax system.\" The balance is held by the ATO, not reported by the lodger.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Types of loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Supplementary loan accum amount","k":"Dollar balance of student financial supplement scheme debt","def":"A whole-dollar accumulated balance, indexed annually and reduced by compulsory and voluntary repayments. It is one of several loan types that share a single repayment threshold.","p":"2010-2011 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Types of loans","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","lim":"It is not evidence of current or recent study, and after 2003 it cannot be, so treating it as an education indicator dates the person to a cohort that borrowed twenty years earlier. It is also only one loan type: a person with a large HELP debt and no SFSS shows zero here.","where":["madip-ge-020105d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1011","madip-ge-020110d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1112","madip-ge-020115d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1213","madip-ge-020120d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1314","madip-ge-020125d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1415","madip-ge-020130d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1516","madip-ge-020135d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1617","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1718","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1819","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_12m","and 4 more"]},{"n":"SFSS_RPMT_CALCD_DUE_AMT","d":"The compulsory student financial supplement scheme repayment the ATO raised for the year, taken out of the assessment rather than paid separately.","full":"The compulsory student financial supplement scheme repayment the ATO raised for the year, taken out of the assessment rather than paid separately. The ATO does the calculation without any entry on the return: \"If you have a loan when you lodge your tax return and your repayment income is above the minimum repayment threshold, we will work out your compulsory repayment and include it on your notice of assessment.\" It exists only above the repayment threshold, so most people with a balance in a given year show nothing.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Compulsory repayments","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/compulsory-repayments","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Supplementary loan assessment debt","k":"Dollar amount of compulsory SFSS repayment raised on assessment","def":"A whole-dollar compulsory repayment for the income year, worked out from repayment income against published thresholds. It reduces the balance carried in SFSS_CLCTBL_DEBT_OUTSTG_AMT on the same row.","p":"2010-2011 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Compulsory repayments","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/compulsory-repayments","lim":"It is not the amount the person paid off in the year, because voluntary repayments and employer withholding are not in it, and indexation can raise the balance by more than the repayment reduces it. A zero can mean no debt, income below the threshold, or a Medicare levy reduction that removes the obligation, and the column cannot separate the three.","where":["madip-ge-020105d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1011","madip-ge-020110d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1112","madip-ge-020115d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1213","madip-ge-020120d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1314","madip-ge-020125d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1415","madip-ge-020130d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1516","madip-ge-020135d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1617","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1718","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1819","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_12m","and 4 more"]},{"n":"SHARE_OF_NRAS_TAX_OFST_AMT","d":"The taxpayer's share of the national rental affordability scheme tax offset, passed through from a partnership or trust that held NRAS rental property.","full":"The taxpayer's share of the national rental affordability scheme tax offset, passed through from a partnership or trust that held NRAS rental property. It is reported alongside the partnership and trust income it belongs to: the ATO directs a lodger with \"national rental affordability scheme (NRAS) rent\" to \"write your share of the NRAS tax offset at question 13 - label B (show cents)\". The offset is refundable, unlike most of the offsets recorded elsewhere in this table.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 13 Partnerships and trusts","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Share of national rental affordability scheme tax offset","k":"Dollar amount at item 13 label B, share of NRAS tax offset","def":"A dollars and cents amount, reported to the cent rather than rounded, and claimed only by investors holding NRAS property through a partnership or trust.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 13 Partnerships and trusts","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2025","lim":"It is a share of an offset, not a share of rent, so it measures the subsidy rather than the investment; the underlying dwelling count and rent are not here. NRAS entitlements held directly rather than through a partnership or trust are claimed elsewhere on the return, so this column undercounts scheme participation.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0910 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0910_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920_16m","and 5 more"]},{"n":"SHARECRTFNAMTWHELDPMT_CHTS_AMT","d":"A credit for tax a closely held trust withheld from a beneficiary's payment because the beneficiary's tax file number was not held.","full":"A credit for tax a closely held trust withheld from a beneficiary's payment because the beneficiary's tax file number was not held. The ATO puts it at its own label: for \"payments from a closely held trust from which TFN amounts are withheld\", write \"the total of your credits for those amounts withheld at question 13 - label M (show cents)\". It is distinct from label R on the same row, which carries TFN credits from interest, dividends and unit trust distributions.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 13 Partnerships and trusts","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Share of credit for tfn amounts withheld from payments from closely held trusts","k":"Dollar amount at item 13 label M, credit for TFN amounts withheld from closely held trust payments","def":"A dollars and cents credit against tax payable, reported to the cent. It is present only where a trustee actually withheld under the closely held trust reporting rules.","p":"2010-2011 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 13 Partnerships and trusts","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2025","lim":"It marks an administrative failure rather than an income source, so its presence says that a tax file number was missing at the time of payment, not that the beneficiary was untraced or non-compliant afterwards. The ATO defines it as \"salary, wages and other labour costs actually paid or payable to persons employed in your business (excluding those forming part of capital expenditure or paid for private or domestic assistance)\", including holiday pay, overtime, bonuses and retiring allowances, and excluding contract, agency, consultant and superannuation payments. It is the closest thing in the individual return to a measure of a sole trader's employment.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P15 Total salary and wage expenses","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/total-salary-and-wage-expenses-p15","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total salary and wage expenses - amount","k":"Dollar amount at P15 label G, total salary and wage expenses","def":"A whole-dollar total across all of the lodger's businesses, self-assessed. It qualifies the dollar amount in SLRY_AND_WG_EXPNSS_TOTL_AMT rather than adding to it.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2025 instructions, P15 Total salary and wage expenses","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule-2025/total-salary-and-wage-expenses-p15","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total salary and wage expenses - type","k":"Expense component code letter in the type box at P15 label G","def":"One letter from C, A, B or O, printed in the type box beside the wage total. The ATO asks for it only where a single lump sum is reported: \"Write the date of payment and your payer's ABN, in the left column at question 8.\" Where two or more lump sums were received the taxpayer completes a separate schedule instead and the instruction says \"Don't write any date of payment or payer's ABN in your tax return\", so the date goes missing precisely for the people with the most payments.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 8 Australian superannuation lump sum payments","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/8-australian-superannuation-lump-sum-payments-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Australian superannuation lump sum payments -Date of payment","k":"Date of a single Australian superannuation lump sum payment at item 8","def":"A calendar date taken from the PAYG payment summary for a superannuation lump sum. The taxpayer copies it from the payment summary rather than calculating it: \"Write the total amount of tax withheld, from your payment summary, under Tax withheld at question 8.\" It is a credit against the assessment, so it sits with the other withholding columns in the whld_debt table rather than with the income components at labels P and Q.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 8 Australian superannuation lump sum payments","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/8-australian-superannuation-lump-sum-payments-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax withheld on australian superannuation lump sum payments","k":"Dollar amount of tax withheld from superannuation lump sums at item 8","def":"A whole-dollar credit for the year, summed over payment summaries where more than one lump sum was received. The amount is reduced for a part-year claim and for shared care of a child.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2012, item T1 Spouse (without dependent child or student), child-housekeeper or housekeeper","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2012/tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t1-t6/t1-spouse-without-dependent-child-or-student-child-housekeeper-or-housekeeper-2012","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Spouse (without dependent child or student), child-housekeeper or housekeeper offset amount","k":"Dollar amount, item T1 tax offset worked out on the return","def":"A whole-dollar tax offset amount calculated on the item T1 worksheets, apportioned for days of the year and for a family tax benefit shared-care percentage.","p":"2009-2010","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2012, item T1 Spouse (without dependent child or student), child-housekeeper or housekeeper","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2012/tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t1-t6/t1-spouse-without-dependent-child-or-student-child-housekeeper-or-housekeeper-2012","lim":"Being an amount available, it overstates the benefit received wherever tax payable was smaller, and the used amount is a separate column. It also cannot be split between the three claims it pools, so without the claim type code on the same row a dependent spouse and a housekeeper look identical.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0910 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0910_16m"]},{"n":"SPS_OR_HSKPR_TAX_OFST_CLM_CD","d":"Which of the three item T1 claims produced the offset, entered as a code letter in the claim type box.","full":"Which of the three item T1 claims produced the offset, entered as a code letter in the claim type box. For a dependent spouse the ATO says \"Print S in the CLAIM TYPE box at the right of P item T1\"; for a child-housekeeper or housekeeper claim the letter is W where there was no dependent child or student and H where there was, and C marks a claim that changed type part way through the year. It qualifies the offset amount on the same row rather than adding anything to it.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2012, item T1 Spouse (without dependent child or student), child-housekeeper or housekeeper","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2012/tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t1-t6/t1-spouse-without-dependent-child-or-student-child-housekeeper-or-housekeeper-2012","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Spouse (without dependent child or student), child-housekeeper or housekeeper offset - claim type","k":"ATO item T1 claim type code (S, W, H, C)","def":"A single letter. The ATO defines them as the sum of two things: \"Reportable super contributions are the sum of reportable employer super contributions and deductible personal super contributions\", taken from the spouse's own IT2 and D12 entries. They are collected because the income tests add them back to the spouse's taxable income.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Spouse details - married or de facto","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/spouse-details-married-or-defacto-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Amount of your spouse's reportable superannuation contributions","k":"Dollar amount, spouse's reportable superannuation contributions","def":"A whole-dollar annual amount covering employer contributions above the compulsory rate, chiefly salary sacrifice, plus personal contributions the spouse claims as a deduction.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Spouse details - married or de facto","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/spouse-details-married-or-defacto-2025","lim":"This is one person's statement about another's superannuation, and the ATO allows a \"reasonable estimate\" where the figure cannot be obtained, so it is weaker evidence than the spouse's own return. The ATO counts it in the couple's income test as \"their share of the net income of a trust on which the trustee must pay tax (under section 98 of the Income Tax Assessment Act 1936) and which hasn't been included in their taxable income\". The return names the disabilities: bankruptcy, being declared legally incapable because of a mental condition, and being under 18 at 30 June.","dsrc":"ATO, Medicare levy surcharge income, thresholds and rates","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy-surcharge/medicare-levy-surcharge-income-thresholds-and-rates","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Your spouse's share of trust income","k":"Dollar amount, spouse's section 98 trust income outside taxable income","def":"A whole-dollar annual amount that sits outside the spouse's taxable income and is added to it for the income tests, taken from the trust's distribution statement.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Medicare levy surcharge income, thresholds and rates","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy-surcharge/medicare-levy-surcharge-income-thresholds-and-rates","lim":"It identifies neither the trust nor the disability, so it cannot be used to find minors with trust distributions in any reliable way. The offset is capped at $540 and the ATO works it out as \"18% of the lesser of\" $3,000, reduced by every dollar the spouse's income exceeds the lower threshold, and the contributions actually paid. The contributions themselves sit on the same row as SPNTNCNTRBTNSPDONBHLFOFSPS_AMT.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question T3 Super contributions on behalf of your spouse","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/tax-offset-questions-t3-t9-supplementary-tax-return-2025/t3-super-contributions-on-behalf-of-your-spouse-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Superannuation contributions on behalf of your spouse tax offset - used","k":"Dollar amount, spouse super contributions tax offset applied in the assessment","def":"A whole-dollar amount, non-refundable and therefore bounded by both the $540 maximum and the tax otherwise payable.","p":"2014-2015 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question T3 Super contributions on behalf of your spouse","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/tax-offset-questions-t3-t9-supplementary-tax-return-2025/t3-super-contributions-on-behalf-of-your-spouse-2025","lim":"It cannot measure contributions made for a low-income spouse: the calculation ignores contributions above $3,000 and cuts out entirely once the spouse's income reaches the upper threshold, so generous contributions and contributions for a working spouse both leave nothing here. Exempt pension income such as the disability support pension belongs in a different box on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Spouse details - married or de facto","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/spouse-details-married-or-defacto-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Your spouse's amount of any tax free government pensions paid","k":"Dollar amount, spouse's tax-free government pensions","def":"A whole-dollar annual total of veterans' and military compensation payments that carry no income tax.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Spouse details - married or de facto","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/spouse-details-married-or-defacto-2025","lim":"It is not all of the spouse's untaxed income: the disability support pension, carer payment and invalidity service pension are reported at the exempt pension income box instead, so treating this column as the couple's non-taxable support understates it. From the 2016-17 return IT1 is split between exempt employers and other employers, and the spouse section carries both parts.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Spouse details - married or de facto","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/spouse-details-married-or-defacto-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Your spouse's total reportable fringe benefits amounts","k":"Dollar amount, spouse's total reportable fringe benefits","def":"A whole-dollar grossed-up annual amount that an employer must report once a person's benefits pass the reporting threshold.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Spouse details - married or de facto","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/spouse-details-married-or-defacto-2025","lim":"The amount is grossed up, so it is not the cash value of the benefits and cannot be added to wages as if it were salary. The instruction is arithmetic: \"Your spouse's total net investment loss is the sum of any net financial investment loss and any net rental property loss\", taken from their IT5 and IT6 entries. A negatively geared rental property and a geared share portfolio both end up in this one number.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Spouse details - married or de facto","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/spouse-details-married-or-defacto-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Your spouse's total net investment loss","k":"Dollar amount, spouse's total net investment loss","def":"A whole-dollar annual amount written as a positive number although it represents a loss: the excess of deductions over income, measured separately for financial investments and for rental property and then added.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Spouse details - married or de facto","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/spouse-details-married-or-defacto-2025","lim":"It cannot say which of the two losses it is, and it does not scale with the investment behind it, since a large loss can come from a small holding in a high interest year. The ATO defines target foreign income as income from sources outside Australia, or \"a periodical payment by way of gifts or allowances from a source outside Australia\", that is neither in taxable income nor a fringe benefit, and it must be converted to Australian dollars before it is written down. Exempt foreign employment income the spouse shows at item 20 is included in it.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question IT4 Target foreign income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-test-it1-it8-individual-tax-return-2025/it4-target-foreign-income-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Your spouse's target foreign income","k":"Dollar amount, spouse's target foreign income","def":"A whole-dollar annual amount in Australian dollars, gross, covering money and periodic benefits from outside Australia that sit outside the Australian tax base.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question IT4 Target foreign income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-test-it1-it8-individual-tax-return-2025/it4-target-foreign-income-2025","lim":"It is self-reported about a third party with no statement behind it, which makes it the weakest income figure on the row. The ATO allowed a taxpayer to \"reduce your income for MLS purposes by any taxed element of the super lump sum, other than a death benefit, that does not exceed your (or your spouse's) low rate cap\" where the person was aged from preservation age to under 60. The concession applies to \"2023-24 and prior income years\", so the label belongs to the older returns.","dsrc":"ATO, Medicare levy surcharge income, thresholds and rates","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy-surcharge/medicare-levy-surcharge-income-thresholds-and-rates","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Your spouse's taxed element of a superannuation lump sum","k":"Dollar amount, spouse's taxed element of a super lump sum taxed at zero","def":"A whole-dollar annual amount, effective only up to the low rate cap and only for a spouse between preservation age and 60.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Medicare levy surcharge income, thresholds and rates","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy-surcharge/medicare-levy-surcharge-income-thresholds-and-rates","lim":"It is not the size of the lump sum: only the taxed element within the low rate cap belongs here, so a large withdrawal can show a small figure and a withdrawal at 60 or over shows nothing at all.
