The ATO builds it up: \"Your income for MLS purposes is the sum of the following items for you (and your spouse, if you have one)\" - taxable income, reportable fringe benefits, total net investment losses and reportable super contributions, with exempt foreign employment income added where taxable income is $1 or more. It is worked out at assessment, so no one writes it on the return.","dsrc":"ATO, Medicare levy surcharge income, thresholds and rates","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy-surcharge/medicare-levy-surcharge-income-thresholds-and-rates","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Income for surcharge purposes","k":"Dollar amount, income for surcharge purposes","def":"A whole-dollar annual amount for the individual that adds back salary sacrifice, grossed-up fringe benefits and negative gearing losses that taxable income removes.","p":"2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Medicare levy surcharge income, thresholds and rates","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy-surcharge/medicare-levy-surcharge-income-thresholds-and-rates","lim":"It is an individual figure while the surcharge and rebate are tested on family income, so on its own it cannot place a couple against a threshold and the spouse column on the same row has to be added. It also says nothing about whether the surcharge was payable, because private patient hospital cover exempts the taxpayer at any income.","where":["madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2223 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2324 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2324_12m"]},{"n":"SSL_CMPLSRY_RPMT_DUE_AMT","d":"The Student Start-up Loan repayment the ATO raised on this year's assessment.","full":"The Student Start-up Loan repayment the ATO raised on this year's assessment. Nothing is claimed by the taxpayer: \"If you have a loan when you lodge your tax return and your repayment income is above the minimum repayment threshold, we will work out your compulsory repayment and include it on your notice of assessment.\" The scheme began on 1 January 2016, so the column has nothing in it for earlier income years.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans - compulsory repayments","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/compulsory-repayments","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Student support loan (SSL) compulsory repayment due","k":"Dollar amount, Student Start-up Loan compulsory repayment raised","def":"A whole-dollar amount for one income year, worked out from repayment income against that year's thresholds and rates and added to the assessment.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans - compulsory repayments","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/compulsory-repayments","lim":"It is the amount raised, not the amount paid, and it excludes both voluntary repayments and the extra amounts an employer withheld through PAYG during the year. A zero means repayment income sat below the threshold, not that the loan was cleared.","where":["madip-ge-020130d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1516","madip-ge-020135d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1617","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1718","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1819","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy1920 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"SSL_DEBT_OUTSTG_RPYBL_AMT","d":"The Student Start-up Loan balance still owing at the assessment, a stock rather than the year's flow.","full":"The Student Start-up Loan balance still owing at the assessment, a stock rather than the year's flow. The ATO describes the loan as \"a voluntary loan available to eligible students in higher education\" who receive Youth Allowance, Austudy or the ABSTUDY Living Allowance, with Services Australia making the payments. The ABSTUDY version of the loan is carried in its own columns on the same row, so the two must be added to get a student's total start-up borrowing.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans - types of loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"AUSTUDY Student Start-Up Loan Outstanding Repayable Debt","k":"Dollar amount, Student Start-up Loan balance outstanding","def":"A whole-dollar accumulated balance at the time of assessment, indexed each year and reduced by compulsory and voluntary repayments.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans - types of loans","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","lim":"Because it is a balance at one moment, differencing it across years does not give repayments: indexation moves it too. It also covers this loan only, so someone with a HELP debt as well looks far less indebted here than they are.","where":["madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"SSL_RPYBL_AMT","d":"The part of the Student Start-up Loan account treated as repayable when the year's compulsory repayment was worked out.","full":"The part of the Student Start-up Loan account treated as repayable when the year's compulsory repayment was worked out. It sits between the outstanding balance and the repayment raised, and the three loan columns on the row are nested rather than additive. HELP, VET Student Loans, trade support loans and the ABSTUDY start-up loan each repeat the same three-column pattern, which is what identifies this one as the middle step.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans - compulsory repayments","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/compulsory-repayments","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"AUSTUDY Student Start-Up Loan Repayable Debt","k":"Dollar amount, Student Start-up Loan debt treated as repayable at assessment","def":"A whole-dollar amount attached to one assessment, smaller than or equal to the accumulated balance on the same row.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans - compulsory repayments","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/compulsory-repayments","lim":"Do not add it to the outstanding balance or to the compulsory repayment beside it, because the three overlap. The ATO does not publish a definition of a repayable debt distinct from the outstanding balance, so the boundary between the two columns cannot be checked against guidance and the reading here is inferred from the sibling loan columns.","where":["madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"STAC_TOTL_EXPNS_AMT","d":"A total expenses figure carried on individual returns from 1999-2000 to 2005-06 under an acronym the data item list does not expand.","full":"A total expenses figure carried on individual returns from 1999-2000 to 2005-06 under an acronym the data item list does not expand. It sits among the business expense totals in the same table - total expenses, all other expenses, motor vehicle expenses - which points to the business and professional items section of the return rather than to work related deductions. Read it against EXPNSS_TOTL_AMT on the same row, which is the plain total expenses label, before assuming what it covers.","dsrc":"ATO, Forms and instructions","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"STAC Total Expenses Amount","k":"Dollar amount, total expenses on an early individual return","def":"A whole-dollar annual expense total attached to an individual's return, on the same footing as the other expense totals in that table.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Forms and instructions","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions","lim":"The column cannot be treated as the business total expenses without confirmation, because STAC is not expanded anywhere in the metadata and the ATO does not publish the acronym, so its relationship to EXPNSS_TOTL_AMT is unresolved. It also stops after 2005-06, so any series that uses it ends there rather than continuing at zero.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0001 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0001","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0102 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0102","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0203 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0203","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0304 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0304","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0405 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0405","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0506 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0506","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy9900 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_9900"]},{"n":"STATE_CODE_2021","d":"The state or territory the taxpayer's address falls in, at the 2021 boundaries.","full":"The state or territory the taxpayer's address falls in, at the 2021 boundaries. It is the coarsest of the geography columns on the row and the one that survives every boundary revision, which makes it the safe level for a long series where the SA codes below it change between editions. It is also the leading digit of every other ASGS code on the row, so a disagreement between them is a data problem rather than a real difference.","dsrc":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard Edition 3, States and Territories","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/states-and-territories","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","k":"ASGS 2021 state and territory code","def":"A single digit, 1 to 8 for the states and territories in ABS order and 9 for other territories, with a further code for migratory, offshore and no-usual-address records.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Australian Statistical Geography Standard Edition 3, States and Territories","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/states-and-territories","lim":"State of address is not state of economic activity: someone living near a border, or working in one state and living in another, is counted where they live. The code says nothing about metropolitan against regional, which the SA4 or the remoteness columns carry.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy2324 / ato_itr_context_2324_12m","madipge-ato-d-pay-sum-fy2324 / plida_ps_2324_12m_bn"]},{"n":"STDNT_FINCL_SPLMT_DEBT_TX_AMT","d":"The Student Financial Supplement Scheme debt still owing at assessment, from a scheme that has been closed for two decades.","full":"The Student Financial Supplement Scheme debt still owing at assessment, from a scheme that has been closed for two decades. The ATO says the SFSS \"was a voluntary loan scheme to help tertiary students cover their expenses while they studied\", that it \"closed on 31 December 2003\", and that \"all existing SFSS loans continue to be collected through the tax system\". A balance here therefore marks someone who borrowed before 2004.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans - types of loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Student Financial Supplement Scheme Outstanding Repayable Debt","k":"Dollar amount, Student Financial Supplement Scheme balance outstanding","def":"A whole-dollar balance owing at assessment on a scheme closed to new borrowing, so it moves only with indexation and with repayments and never with fresh lending.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans - types of loans","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","lim":"The column dates a person's study rather than measuring current borrowing, and it cannot be pooled with HELP as one student debt: the scheme had its own repayment thresholds for most of its life and it is repaid after other study loans. A zero also cannot separate someone who never borrowed from someone who has paid the loan off.","where":["madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"STE","d":"The state or territory of the address the ATO held for the taxpayer for that income year, coded to the ABS geographic standard.","full":"The state or territory of the address the ATO held for the taxpayer for that income year, coded to the ABS geographic standard. The geography table it sits in carries SA1, SA2 and LGA for the same address, all on the 2021 edition of the standard even though the return year is 2015-16, so the columns are comparable across return years by design. It is where the taxpayer was, not where the income was earned or the employer sat.","dsrc":"ABS, Census geography glossary","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/census/guide-census-data/geography/census-geography-glossary","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"State and territory","k":"ASGS state and territory","def":"A state and territory identifier from the ABS standard: the six states, the two internal territories, and a further category covering the external territories.","p":"2015-2016 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Census geography glossary","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/census/guide-census-data/geography/census-geography-glossary","lim":"An address on a return is not a residence for the whole year, and the ATO holds one address rather than a history, so a person who moved is placed where they finished rather than where they lived while earning. Coding an old return to current boundaries also means the geography is consistent across years while the underlying address is not.","where":["madip-ge-020127d-ato-atoitrcontext1516-fy2015-16 / itr_geo2021_1516","madip-ge-020132d-ato-atoitrcontext1617-fy2016-17 / itr_geo2021_1617","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1718-fy2017-18 / itr_geo2021_1718","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_context_1819","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / itr_geo2021_1819","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920","madipge-ato-d-context-fy1920 / ato_itr_context_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_context_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2223 / ato_itr_context_2223_12m"]},{"n":"STS_GRP_TNOVR_AMT","d":"The aggregated turnover of the taxpayer's business, the test that decides whether it counts as a small business entity.","full":"The aggregated turnover of the taxpayer's business, the test that decides whether it counts as a small business entity. The ATO defines it as \"your annual turnover for the income year plus the annual turnover of any entity connected or affiliated with you at any time during the income year less income derived from dealings between you and any entity connected or affiliated with you\". The variable name preserves the older Simplified Tax System wording, STS group turnover, which the small business entity rules later replaced.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2012, question T13 Entrepreneurs tax offset","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2012/supplementary-tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t7-t14/t13-entrepreneurs-tax-offset-2012","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business entity aggregated turnover","k":"Dollar amount, aggregated turnover of the taxpayer and connected entities","def":"A whole-dollar annual turnover figure, excluding GST charged on transactions and ordinary income from retail fuel sales, covering the taxpayer plus every connected or affiliated entity.","p":"2009-2010","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2012, question T13 Entrepreneurs tax offset","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2012/supplementary-tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t7-t14/t13-entrepreneurs-tax-offset-2012","lim":"It is not the taxpayer's own business income, because turnover of connected entities is inside it, so it can be far larger than anything else on the row. It is also a self-assessed threshold test rather than an accounting figure, so a taxpayer with no threshold to test may leave it blank instead of writing a real turnover.","where":["madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0910 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0910_16m"]},{"n":"STS_INCM_NET_AMT","d":"Net small business income, the base the entrepreneurs tax offset was worked out on.","full":"Net small business income, the base the entrepreneurs tax offset was worked out on. The ATO puts it plainly: \"Your net small business income is your small business entity turnover less the deductions that directly relate to that turnover.\" Prior year tax losses, personal superannuation contributions, gifts, the cost of managing tax affairs and deferred non-commercial losses are named as amounts that cannot reduce it.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2012, question T13 Entrepreneurs tax offset","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2012/supplementary-tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t7-t14/t13-entrepreneurs-tax-offset-2012","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net small business entity income","k":"Dollar amount, net small business income","def":"A whole-dollar annual net figure - turnover less directly related deductions - taken at the taxpayer's share where the business is carried on through a partnership or trust.","p":"2009-2010","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2012, question T13 Entrepreneurs tax offset","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2012/supplementary-tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t7-t14/t13-entrepreneurs-tax-offset-2012","lim":"It is not net business income as reported elsewhere on the return, because the deductions allowed against it are narrower, so it will usually be the larger of the two. The offset it supported was later repealed, so a zero in the years after that means the question was no longer asked rather than that the business made nothing.","where":["madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0910 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0910_16m"]},{"n":"STS_INCM_NET_CD","d":"The loss marker on the taxpayer's net simplified tax system income, saying whether the amount beside it is negative.","full":"The loss marker on the taxpayer's net simplified tax system income, saying whether the amount beside it is negative. The individual return carries no minus sign, so any amount that can be negative is written as a positive figure with a separate box filled in when it is a loss. The simplified tax system ran from 2001-02 to 2008-09 for small businesses that elected into it, which is why the column appears only in the earlier return context tables. It qualifies the net income amount on the same row and holds no value of its own.","dsrc":"ATO, TaxPack 2010 (NAT 0976-6.2010), the individual tax return's loss box convention","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2010","dp":"ai","vp":"official","od":"Net simplified tax system income - code","k":"ato_itr_loss_code","def":"A single letter box that is either L, marking the amount as a loss, or empty, marking it as not a loss.","p":"2009-2010","s":"guessed","src":"ATO TaxPack 2010 (NAT 0976-6.2010) - the tax return's standard convention for a net income amount that can be negative","lim":"A blank is ambiguous. It is left empty both by a taxpayer with a positive amount and by one who was never in the simplified tax system, so the column cannot on its own identify who elected into that system.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy0910 / ato_itr_context_0910_16m"],"dom":13},{"n":"STSDPRTGASTSDDCTNGNRLPOOL_AMT","d":"The depreciation a small business claimed on its general pool for the year, at label B of the simplified depreciation item.","full":"The depreciation a small business claimed on its general pool for the year, at label B of the simplified depreciation item. The ATO instruction is to \"Show the total amount you claimed at Depreciation expenses relating to the general small business pool\", so the label carries the year's deduction and not the closing pool balance. Assets above the write-off threshold go into the pool and are deducted at a set rate rather than in full.","dsrc":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business entity simplified depreciation - deduction for general pool","k":"Dollar amount, small business general pool depreciation deduction","def":"A whole-dollar deduction that is already inside the business depreciation expense on the same return, not an addition to it.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","lim":"It cannot be read as capital spending, because a pool deduction is a percentage of a running balance and so reflects assets bought in earlier years as much as this year's. For 2020-21 to 2022-23 the pool balance itself was written off under temporary full expensing, which inflates the amount without any change in investment.","where":["madip-ge-020103d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1011","madip-ge-020108d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1112","madip-ge-020113d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1213","madip-ge-020118d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1314","madip-ge-020123d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1415","madip-ge-020128d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1516","madip-ge-020133d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1617","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1718","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1819","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0607 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0708 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0809 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0809_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"STSDPRTGASTSDDCTNLOWCSTASTSAMT","d":"The immediate write-off a small business claimed for assets costing less than the year's threshold, at label A of the simplified depreciation item.","full":"The immediate write-off a small business claimed for assets costing less than the year's threshold, at label A of the simplified depreciation item. This is the instant asset write-off: the whole cost comes off in the year the asset is first used rather than being pooled and depreciated. For the 2021, 2022 and 2023 income years the ATO told small businesses using simplified depreciation that they \"cannot claim instant asset write-off\" and to \"insert 0 at this label\", because temporary full expensing replaced it.","dsrc":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business entity simplified depreciation - deduction for certain assets","k":"Dollar amount, small business immediate write-off deduction for low cost assets","def":"A whole-dollar deduction for assets below the year's cost threshold, already counted in the business depreciation expense on the same return.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","lim":"The cost threshold behind the label has moved repeatedly, so the number of assets behind a given amount is not comparable across years. The instructed zeros for 2020-21 to 2022-23 also mean an empty claim in those years says nothing at all about asset purchases.","where":["madip-ge-020103d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1011","madip-ge-020108d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1112","madip-ge-020113d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1213","madip-ge-020118d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1314","madip-ge-020123d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1415","madip-ge-020128d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1516","madip-ge-020133d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1617","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1718","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1819","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0607 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0708 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0809 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0809_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"SUB_OCPTN_GRP_CD","d":"A grouping of the occupation the taxpayer nominated as the source of most of their salary and wages.","full":"A grouping of the occupation the taxpayer nominated as the source of most of their salary and wages. The return itself carries a six-digit code: the ATO says to \"insert the appropriate 6-digit code from the list at question 1 - label X\", chosen for the activity that produces the greatest amount of salary and wage income. This column holds a coarser grouping of that code, and the full code appears in later return years as IDV_OCPTN_CD.","dsrc":"ATO, Salary and wage occupation codes","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/salary-and-wage-occupation-codes","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Sub occupation group code","k":"ATO salary and wage occupation grouping","def":"A short code standing for a group of the ATO's six-digit occupation codes, which follow the structure of the occupation classification.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Salary and wage occupation codes","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/salary-and-wage-occupation-codes","lim":"The ATO publishes the six-digit code list but no sub occupation grouping, so the grouping cannot be mapped to the classification with certainty and should not be treated as an ANZSCO major or sub-major group without checking. The ATO separates the two sources: annuities are \"a series of regular payments you receive from a life insurance company or friendly society in return for a lump sum payment\", while super income streams are payments from super funds, retirement savings account providers and life companies. From 1 July 2007 most benefits paid to people aged 60 and over stopped being assessable, so the same item covers a much smaller population afterwards.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuity and superannuation income streams","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Super annuity and pension","k":"Dollar amount, annuity and superannuation pension income","def":"A whole-dollar gross annual amount taken from the payer's PAYG payment summaries, before the undeducted purchase price of an annuity is deducted.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 7 Australian annuity and superannuation income streams","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/7-australian-annuity-and-superannuation-income-streams-2025","lim":"It is not retirement income: a tax-free superannuation pension paid to someone 60 or over never appears here from 2007-08, so the column follows the taxable part of the market rather than the whole of it. TaxPack 2000 sets it out: \"If you are claiming the superannuation contributions rebate only, print the letter S in the CLAIM TYPE box at the right of S item R4. If you are claiming the annuity or pension rebate only, print A. If you are claiming both, print C.\" One dollar amount sits at that item, so without this letter two very different rebates cannot be told apart. The table calls it an action code; the return calls it a claim type.","dsrc":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976-6.2000), question R4 Superannuation contributions, annuity and pension","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","dp":"official","vp":"official","od":"Super contribution action code","k":"ato_itr_r4_claim_type","def":"A single letter: S for the superannuation contributions rebate alone, A for the annuity or pension rebate alone, and C where both were claimed.","p":"1999-2000 to 2003-2004","s":"guessed","src":"ATO TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976-6.2000), question R4 'Superannuation contributions, annuity and pension', CLAIM TYPE box, page 83","lim":"It does not split the money. Where the letter is C the row carries one combined figure, so the superannuation contributions rebate cannot be separated from the annuity and pension rebate for those taxpayers.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy0001 / ato_itr_context_0001","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0102 / ato_itr_context_0102","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0203 / ato_itr_context_0203","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0304 / ato_itr_context_0304","madipge-ato-d-context-fy9900 / ato_itr_context_9900"],"dom":14},{"n":"SUPER_CONTRB_AMT","d":"A superannuation contributions figure recorded against the 1999-2000 and 2000-01 returns, paired with a super contribution action code in the context table for the same year.","full":"A superannuation contributions figure recorded against the 1999-2000 and 2000-01 returns, paired with a super contribution action code in the context table for the same year. It is not the deduction for personal contributions, which the deductions table of the same year carries separately as personal superannuation contributions, so it records contributions captured for some other purpose - most plausibly a contributions rebate or surcharge decision. The modern equivalent of the deductible amount is question D12.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question D12 Personal superannuation contributions","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d11-d15-supplementary-tax-return-2025/d12-personal-superannuation-contributions-2025","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Super Contribution Amount","k":"Dollar amount, superannuation contributions on an early individual return","def":"A whole-dollar annual contributions figure attached to an individual's return for one income year.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question D12 Personal superannuation contributions","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d11-d15-supplementary-tax-return-2025/d12-personal-superannuation-contributions-2025","lim":"The column cannot be assumed to be either contributions the taxpayer deducted or contributions an employer made: the data item list does not name the label and the paired action code has no published code list, so it should be treated as unresolved rather than used as a contributions measure. The wages table holds one row per payer, with that payer's hashed ABN beside it, which mirrors how item 1 is completed: for each income statement the taxpayer writes the payer's ABN, the tax withheld and \"the gross payment amounts under Income\". Allowances are not in it, because they belong at item 2.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 1 Salary or wages","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/1-salary-or-wages-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Income","k":"Dollar amount, gross salary and wages from one payer","def":"A whole-dollar gross annual amount per payer, covering salary, wages, commissions, bonuses, casual and part-time earnings, parental leave pay and payments for lost wages under an income protection or workers compensation policy.","p":"2018-2019 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 1 Salary or wages","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/1-salary-or-wages-2025","lim":"It is not total employment income: allowances, employment termination payments, lump sums and salary sacrificed amounts sit in other items or never appear at all, so adding this column across payers understates what employers paid. It sits beside that payer's gross payment in the same row of the wages table, so the pair gives a withholding rate per job rather than per person. The figure is the employer's own calculation under PAYG - the instruction to the payer is to \"Show the total tax withheld in whole dollars\" - and it is a credit in the assessment rather than tax finally borne.","dsrc":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: Payment details","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax withheld","k":"Dollar amount, tax withheld by one payer from salary and wages","def":"A whole-dollar annual amount withheld by one payer and reported by that payer on the income statement or payment summary.","p":"2018-2019 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: Payment details","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","lim":"It is not the tax paid on that job's income, because the liability is worked out across all income at assessment and much of a large withholding can come back as a refund. Where SW_TW_AMT is one payer's withholding in the wages table, this is the single figure the return works with, and it sits with the other withholding columns - allowances, government payments, termination payments, superannuation lump sums - that add up to total tax withheld. Item 1 is the source, and the taxpayer with more than five payers is instructed to combine them.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 1 Salary or wages","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/1-salary-or-wages-2025","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Tax withheld from salary and wages","k":"Dollar amount, total tax withheld from salary and wages","def":"A whole-dollar annual total summed across income statements and payment summaries, covering salary and wage income only.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 1 Salary or wages","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/1-salary-or-wages-2025","lim":"It is a credit, not a liability: it says what employers remitted during the year, so a large figure can end in a refund and a small one in a bill. Every table for a return year carries it - context, income and loss, deductions and offsets, withholding and debt, geography, wages by payer - so a person's income, claims and assessment are assembled by joining on this column and the income year. ABS keeps the identifying information away from the data through the person linkage spine, so the value itself carries no meaning.","dsrc":"ABS, Person Linkage Spine","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/person-linkage-spine","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Synthetic id of individual person on dataset","k":"PLIDA person linkage key (synthetic)","def":"An opaque integer that is stable within the asset and meaningless outside it; in fplida it is generated rather than a real key.","p":"1999-2000 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Person Linkage Spine","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/person-linkage-spine","lim":"One value is one tax entity, not one household: a couple appear as two unlinked keys, and the spouse income columns are the only bridge between them. The ATO tells the taxpayer to \"Separate the costs of managing your tax affairs into the following 3 components: interest charged by the ATO, litigation costs, other expenses incurred in managing your tax affairs\", written at labels N, L and M. Tax agent fees are the bulk of it for most people, and they are deductible in the year the fee is incurred.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question D10 Cost of managing tax affairs","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d1-d10-individual-tax-return-2025/d10-cost-of-managing-tax-affairs-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Cost of managing tax affairs","k":"Dollar amount, item D10 deduction for managing tax affairs","def":"A whole-dollar annual deduction equal to the sum of the interest, litigation and other-expenses components carried on the same row.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2009-2010, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question D10 Cost of managing tax affairs","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d1-d10-individual-tax-return-2025/d10-cost-of-managing-tax-affairs-2025","lim":"It cannot be read as the price of a tax agent, because ATO interest charges and legal costs sit inside it, and because the fee falls in the year it is incurred rather than the year the return it relates to covers, so it lags the work. The ATO splits the item three ways - \"interest charged by the ATO at label N\", \"litigation costs at label L\", \"other expenses incurred in managing your tax affairs at label M\" - and this column is the third of them. It is a component, not the item total.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question D10 Cost of managing tax affairs","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d1-d10-individual-tax-return-2025/d10-cost-of-managing-tax-affairs-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Cost of managing tax affairs - other expenses incurred in managing your tax affairs","k":"Dollar amount, item D10 other expenses component","def":"A whole-dollar annual deduction for one of the three D10 components, excluding ATO interest charges and litigation costs.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question D10 Cost of managing tax affairs","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/deduction-questions-d1-d10-individual-tax-return-2025/d10-cost-of-managing-tax-affairs-2025","lim":"Do not add it to the D10 total on the same row, because it is already inside that total. Gross payments on the same row are what it was withheld from, and the payment summary type column says what kind of payment it was.","dsrc":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: Payment details","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax withheld amount","k":"Dollar amount, total tax withheld on a payment summary","def":"A whole-dollar amount for one payment summary and one reporting period, covering all withholding on that summary, including amounts withheld from lump sum payments.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: Payment details","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","lim":"It is per summary rather than per person or per year: someone with several jobs has several rows, and a summary can cover only part of a year. This is the ATO's own two-way split of individual returns, the classification it uses to report taxable and non-taxable individuals in Taxation statistics. A return can show substantial taxable income and still be non-taxable, because offsets such as the low income tax offset and the seniors and pensioners tax offset can reduce net tax to zero. The column runs in the context tables from 2010-11 onwards, the same span as the published series.","dsrc":"ATO, Taxation statistics 2023-24, Individuals Table 3, column 'Taxable status'","durl":"https://data.gov.au/data/dataset/faea4485-f407-457d-97f8-3f0822ccd654/resource/fa246a26-1317-443d-8f6e-6d7521453861/download/ts24individual03sextaxablestatusagerangetaxableincomerange.xlsx","dp":"ai","vp":"official","od":"Taxable status","k":"ato_taxable_status","def":"Two values, Taxable and Non Taxable, attached to the return rather than to the person.","p":"2010-2011 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO Taxation statistics 2023-24, Individuals Table 3 ('Selected items, by sex, taxable status, age range and taxable income range, 2010-11 to 2023-24 income years'), column 'Taxable status'","url":"https://data.gov.au/data/dataset/faea4485-f407-457d-97f8-3f0822ccd654/resource/fa246a26-1317-443d-8f6e-6d7521453861/download/ts24individual03sextaxablestatusagerangetaxableincomerange.xlsx","lim":"Non-taxable does not mean no income and does not mean no tax was paid during the year. AGE_FY_START is described as age at the start of the reference period and AGE_RANGE is a banded version, which leaves this column as the second point-in-time measure, most plausibly age at the end of the income year. Age is not asked on the return: the ATO holds a date of birth from registration and derives an age from it.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Completing individual information in your tax return","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/completing-the-individual-tax-return-2025/completing-individual-information-in-your-tax-return-2025","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"TAXPER AGE","k":"Age in completed years","def":"A whole number of completed years for one income year.","p":"2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, Completing individual information in your tax return","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/completing-the-individual-tax-return-2025/completing-individual-information-in-your-tax-return-2025","lim":"The reference date is not published, so this column cannot be assumed to agree with AGE_FY_START on the same row, and for anyone with a birthday inside the income year the two differ by a year. The ATO records that the levy \"is payable at a rate of 2% for taxable incomes over $180,000\" and that it \"ceased applying from 1 July 2017\", so it can only be positive for 2014-15, 2015-16 and 2016-17. It is separate from the Medicare levy and the Medicare levy surcharge, which have their own columns on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Tax rates - Australian resident","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-rates-australian-residents","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total temporary budget repair levy payable","k":"Dollar amount, temporary budget repair levy payable","def":"A whole-dollar amount equal to 2 per cent of the part of taxable income above $180,000 in the years the levy applied.","p":"2010-2011 to 2020-2021","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Tax rates - Australian resident","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-rates-australian-residents","lim":"A zero means different things in different years: income at or below the threshold while the levy ran, and no levy at all outside those years, so the column cannot be used to compare high-income tax burdens across the period. The measure let an eligible business write off the whole business portion of an asset in the year it was first used, and it applied for the 2020-21 to 2022-23 income years only.","dsrc":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Temporary full expensing - Temporary full expensing deductions","k":"Dollar amount, temporary full expensing deduction","def":"A whole-dollar annual deduction covering eligible new assets, second-hand assets for smaller businesses, and improvements to existing assets.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","lim":"It is a deduction rather than investment: only the business portion of a cost appears, so a car used half privately shows half its price, and improvements are mixed in with purchases. Outside 2020-21 to 2022-23 the column is empty because the measure did not exist, which breaks any series that treats a blank as no capital spending.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2223 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2324 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2324_12m"]},{"n":"TFE_ELGBL_AST_CLM_NUM","d":"How many assets the temporary full expensing claim covered, a count rather than a dollar amount.","full":"How many assets the temporary full expensing claim covered, a count rather than a dollar amount. The ATO instruction at label G of item P11 is to \"Show the total number of assets for which you are claiming temporary full expensing\", which lets the deduction on the same row be read as an average cost per asset. Counts of this kind are rare on the individual return, which makes the pair unusually informative about business investment.","dsrc":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Temporary full expensing - Number of assets you are claiming for","k":"Count of assets claimed under temporary full expensing","def":"A whole number of assets for one income year and one taxpayer, counted from the claim rather than from an asset register.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","lim":"The count includes improvements to existing assets as well as purchases, and an asset used partly privately counts once whatever the business share, so it is not a count of things bought. On its own it says nothing about scale either, because a single asset can be worth more than fifty.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2223 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2324 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2324_12m"]},{"n":"TFE_ELGBL_AST_OPT_OUT_CD","d":"Whether the taxpayer chose to opt out of temporary full expensing, and whether for some assets or for all of them.","full":"Whether the taxpayer chose to opt out of temporary full expensing, and whether for some assets or for all of them. The ATO sets two values at label C of item P11: \"A if you are opting out for some of your assets\" and \"B if you are opting out for all of your assets\". Opting out was open only to businesses not using the simplified depreciation rules, and the choice cannot be changed once the return is lodged.","dsrc":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","dp":"official","vp":"official","od":"Temporary full expensing - Are you making a choice to opt out of temporary full expensing for some or all of your eligible assets?","t":"categorical","k":"Temporary full expensing opt-out code (A, B)","def":"A single letter: A for a partial opt-out and B for a complete one, left blank where no choice was made.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","lim":"A blank is not a decision to use the measure: a small business using simplified depreciation was instructed to leave the label empty, and a business with no eligible assets leaves it empty too. The code also does not say which assets were opted out or what was deducted for them instead under the general depreciation rules.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_context_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2223 / ato_itr_context_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2324 / ato_itr_context_2324_12m"],"dom":2},{"n":"TFE_ELGBL_AST_OPT_OUT_NUM","d":"How many assets the taxpayer opted out of temporary full expensing for, at label D of item P11.","full":"How many assets the taxpayer opted out of temporary full expensing for, at label D of item P11. The instruction is to \"Show the number of assets for which you made the choice to opt out of temporary full expensing\", so it counts choices rather than the business's assets. It belongs with the opt-out code and the opted-out value on the same row, which together describe one decision.","dsrc":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Temporary full expensing - Number of assets you are opting out for","k":"Count of assets opted out of temporary full expensing","def":"A whole number of assets for one income year, counted from the opt-out choice made in the return.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","lim":"It does not say how large the opted-out assets were, since one expensive asset and ten cheap ones give the same number, and the value column on the same row is needed for that. It also cannot be netted against the count of assets claimed, because an asset falls into one count or the other by choice rather than by eligibility.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021 / ato_itr_context_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_context_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2223 / ato_itr_context_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy2324 / ato_itr_context_2324_12m"]},{"n":"TFE_ELGBL_AST_OPT_OUT_VAL_AMT","d":"The value of the assets the taxpayer opted out of temporary full expensing for, measured by the deduction forgone.","full":"The value of the assets the taxpayer opted out of temporary full expensing for, measured by the deduction forgone. The ATO defines it at label E of item P11: \"The value is the amount you would have otherwise claimed for these assets under temporary full expensing if you had not made the choice to opt out.\" It is therefore a deduction not taken, not a purchase price.","dsrc":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Temporary full expensing - Value of assets you are opting out for","k":"Dollar amount, value of assets opted out of temporary full expensing","def":"A whole-dollar amount equal to the temporary full expensing deduction the taxpayer chose not to claim for those assets in that year.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Temporary full expensing tax return label guide","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/depreciation-and-capital-expenses-and-allowances/temporary-full-expensing/temporary-full-expensing-tax-return-label-guide","lim":"It is neither capital expenditure nor a deduction: the assets were still written off, only under the general depreciation rules, so the amount overlaps with depreciation claimed in this and later years. Nothing on the row records how much of it came back as ordinary depreciation in the same year.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2223 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2324 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2324_12m"]},{"n":"TFN_AMTS_WHELD_FRM_DSCNTS_AMT","d":"Tax an employer withheld from an employee share scheme discount because the employee did not quote a tax file number.","full":"Tax an employer withheld from an employee share scheme discount because the employee did not quote a tax file number. The instruction is to \"Add up all the TFN amounts withheld from discounts from your Employee share scheme statements\" and write the total at label C of item 12. The discount itself is reported at the other item 12 labels, split by whether the scheme is taxed upfront or deferred.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 12 Employee share schemes","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/12-employee-share-schemes-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Employee share schemes tfn amounts withheld from discounts","k":"Dollar amount, TFN amounts withheld from employee share scheme discounts","def":"An annual amount taken from the employee share scheme statements the employer issues, credited against the assessment like any other withholding.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 12 Employee share schemes","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/12-employee-share-schemes-2025","lim":"It is not tax on share scheme income in general: withholding happens only where a TFN or ABN was not quoted, so most employees who receive a discount show zero here while still being taxed on it. The ATO says what to look for on a statement: \"TFN amounts are amounts of tax withheld by financial institutions because you didn't give them your TFN or ABN. TFN amounts show on your statement or document as 'Commonwealth tax' or 'TFN withholding tax'.\" The interest it was taken from is reported gross at label L on the same return.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 10 Gross interest","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/10-gross-interest-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax file number amounts withheld from gross interest","k":"Dollar amount, TFN amounts withheld from gross interest","def":"An annual amount reported including cents at label M, summed across accounts and excluding amounts the ATO has already refunded.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2025, question 10 Gross interest","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-1-12-individual-tax-return-2025/10-gross-interest-2025","lim":"It cannot be used to measure interest income, because withholding happens at a penalty rate and only on accounts where no TFN was quoted. A child's account or a dormant account is the usual source, so a value here signals an unquoted TFN rather than wealth.","where":["madip-ge-020105d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1011","madip-ge-020110d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1112","madip-ge-020115d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1213","madip-ge-020120d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1314","madip-ge-020125d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1415","madip-ge-020130d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1516","madip-ge-020135d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1617","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1718","madip-ge-020140d-ato-atoitrwhlddebt1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_whld_debt_1819","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0607 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0708 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy0809 / ato_itr_whld_debt_0809_16m","and 8 more"]},{"n":"TFNWHELDINTSTDIVS_UTSSHARE_AMT","d":"The taxpayer's share of credits for tax file number amounts withheld from a partnership's or trust's interest, dividends and unit trust distributions.","full":"The taxpayer's share of credits for tax file number amounts withheld from a partnership's or trust's interest, dividends and unit trust distributions. The withholding happened to the entity, not to the person: the instruction is to write \"the total of your share of credits for TFN amounts withheld at question 13 - label R (show cents)\". Credit for amounts a closely held trust withheld is a separate label on the same question.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 13 Partnerships and trusts","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Share of credit for tfn amounts withheld from interest dividends and franked unit trust distributions","k":"Dollar amount, share of credit for TFN amounts withheld inside a partnership or trust","def":"An annual amount including cents, the taxpayer's proportionate share of amounts withheld from investment income earned inside a partnership or trust.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 13 Partnerships and trusts","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2025","lim":"It is a credit share, not income: the distributions behind it are reported at other item 13 labels, so it cannot be used to size a person's trust or partnership income. It also pools interest, dividends and unit trust distributions into one figure, so the source of the withheld amount cannot be recovered.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","and 8 more"]},{"n":"TFR_PRPTY_NON_RSDNT_TRST_IND","d":"A yes or no box at item 19 recording whether the taxpayer transferred property or services to a non-resident trust.","full":"A yes or no box at item 19 recording whether the taxpayer transferred property or services to a non-resident trust. The ATO asks it directly - \"Do you, at any time, directly or indirectly transfer or cause the transfer of money, property or services to a non-resident trust?\" - and the answer goes at label W, with any attributed foreign income from transferor trusts written at label B. The data item list labels this column 'FIF indicator', which belongs to the foreign investment fund questions that shared item 19 before those rules were repealed, so the column name and the custodian's description disagree.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 19 Foreign entities","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/19-foreign-entities-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"FIF indicator","k":"Yes or no indicator, item 19 transfer to a non-resident trust","def":"A flag with a yes state, a no state and an unanswered state; the amount attributed under the transferor trust rules is held in a separate column.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual supplementary tax return instructions 2025, question 19 Foreign entities","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-supplementary-tax-return-2025-instructions/income-questions-13-24-supplementary-tax-return-2025/19-foreign-entities-2025","lim":"A yes says a transfer happened at some time, not that income was attributed or that any tax followed, and the question reaches back over the taxpayer's whole history rather than the income year. The mismatch with the custodian's 'FIF indicator' wording also means the year's form has to be checked before the column is used, because item 19 carried both questions in the earlier years.","where":["madipge-ato-d-context-fy0607 / ato_itr_context_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0708 / ato_itr_context_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0809 / ato_itr_context_0809_16m"]},{"n":"TFRR_TRST_INCM","d":"Attributed income from a non-resident trust to which the taxpayer transferred property, money or services, reported at label B of item 19 Foreign entities.","full":"Attributed income from a non-resident trust to which the taxpayer transferred property, money or services, reported at label B of item 19 Foreign entities. The ATO says \"The transferor trust measures may apply if, at any time, you directly or indirectly transferred or caused the transfer of property (including money) or services to a non-resident trust\", and the taxpayer works out the attributable amount themselves using the Foreign income return form guide. The controlled foreign company amount sits at label K on the same item, so K and B split attributed foreign income by the structure that produced it. Because attribution does not require a distribution, a figure here can appear in a year when the taxpayer received nothing.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 19 Foreign entities, part B","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/19-foreign-entities-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Foreign entities transferor trust income","k":"Dollar amount reported at label B, item 19 Foreign entities","def":"A whole-dollar amount of attributed foreign income, self-assessed by the taxpayer from the trust's attributable income, with cents dropped. It is gross of nothing on the return itself; any foreign income tax offset is claimed separately at item 20.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 19 Foreign entities, part B","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/19-foreign-entities-2011","lim":"It does not measure money received. Attribution taxes the taxpayer on a share of an offshore trust's income whether or not it was paid out, so this column cannot be read as an overseas cash flow. A zero is also not evidence of no offshore trust: the measures only bite where the taxpayer was the transferor, and a beneficiary with no transfer reports nothing here.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","and 8 more"]},{"n":"TI_OR_LSS_AMT","d":"The taxpayer's taxable income for the year, or their loss, after tax losses of earlier years are deducted.","full":"The taxpayer's taxable income for the year, or their loss, after tax losses of earlier years are deducted. The ATO builds it in two steps: \"Transfer the amount you have shown at SUBTOTAL on page 4 of your tax return to $ TAXABLE INCOME OR LOSS\", unless earlier-year losses are being deducted, in which case those amounts are taken away from the subtotal first. It is the base for the tax scale, the Medicare levy and most income tests, and it is the figure the ATO assesses. A negative value is a tax loss and carries an L indicator on the paper form.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, Taxable income or loss","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/losses-question-l1/taxable-income-or-loss-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Taxable income or loss","k":"Dollar amount at TAXABLE INCOME OR LOSS on the individual return","def":"A signed whole-dollar amount: total income or loss, less total deductions, less any prior-year tax losses claimed at item L1. It runs across every year of the individual return in this asset, 1999-2000 to 2023-24.","p":"1999-2000 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, Taxable income or loss","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/losses-question-l1/taxable-income-or-loss-2011","lim":"It is not income received. Taxable income is net of deductions the taxpayer chose to claim, so two people with identical earnings differ here by their claiming behaviour, and negative gearing or a business loss can drive it below zero for a high earner. It also excludes reportable fringe benefits, reportable employer super contributions and exempt pensions, which is why the income tests carry their own columns.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0001 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0001","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0102 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0102","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0203 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0203","and 15 more"]},{"n":"TID_AMT","d":"Total tax the taxpayer's payers deducted from their income during the year and which is credited against the assessment.","full":"Total tax the taxpayer's payers deducted from their income during the year and which is credited against the assessment. On the returns of this era the label reads TOTAL TAX INSTALMENTS DEDUCTED, and TaxPack tells the taxpayer to build it from the deduction column of each income item: \"For items 1 to 7 add up all the amounts in the tax instalments deducted column.\" It is the ancestor of the modern TOTAL TAX WITHHELD line, and it is reported in dollars and cents rather than whole dollars. The column runs 1999-2000 to 2005-06 only, and disappears once the ATO's schema moved to withheld-amount fields.","dsrc":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), tax return for individuals 1999-2000","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total Tax Instalment Deduction Amount","k":"Dollar amount at TOTAL TAX INSTALMENTS DEDUCTED on pre-2006 individual returns","def":"A dollar-and-cents credit amount, summed by the taxpayer from group certificates and payment summaries across salary and wages, allowances, lump sums, eligible termination payments, government payments and pensions.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), tax return for individuals 1999-2000","url":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","lim":"It is a credit claimed, not tax finally borne. The assessment can reduce or refund it, so it says nothing about the taxpayer's tax liability on its own. It is also not comparable to the later withholding columns without care: the pre-2000 tax instalment deduction system and PAYG withholding cover different payment types, and the change happened partway through the column's own life.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0001 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0001","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0102 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0102","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0203 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0203","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0304 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0304","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0405 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0405","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0506 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0506","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy9900 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_9900"]},{"n":"TID_RFND_AMT","d":"The part of a taxpayer's tax instalment deductions that was refunded rather than credited in the assessment, on returns from 1999-2000 to 2005-06.","full":"The part of a taxpayer's tax instalment deductions that was refunded rather than credited in the assessment, on returns from 1999-2000 to 2005-06. It sits directly beside TID_AMT, which is the total instalment credit claimed, so the pair separates the credit from the money returned to the taxpayer on account of that credit. TaxPack for this era names the credit total but does not print a matching refund label, which points to the field being an ATO processing amount rather than something the taxpayer wrote on the form. Treat it as an accounting movement on the income tax account for the year.","dsrc":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), tax return for individuals 1999-2000","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Tax Instalment Deduction Refunded Amount","k":"Dollar amount of tax instalment deductions refunded, pre-2006 individual returns","def":"A dollar-and-cents amount attached to the instalment credit for the same income year, present only in the pre-2006 deductions and offsets tables.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), tax return for individuals 1999-2000","url":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","lim":"It is not the taxpayer's tax refund. A refund of income tax after assessment is a different quantity and is carried by the assessment balance columns, so summing this field across taxpayers does not give total refunds paid. Because no published label matches it, its exact trigger is unconfirmed, and a zero cannot be read as evidence that nothing was refunded.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0001 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0001","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0102 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0102","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0203 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0203","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0304 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0304","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0405 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0405","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0506 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0506","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy9900 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_9900"]},{"n":"TO_INVLD_AND_CRER_USED_AMT","d":"The part of the dependant (invalid and carer) tax offset that was actually used to reduce tax payable, not the amount the taxpayer was entitled to claim.","full":"The part of the dependant (invalid and carer) tax offset that was actually used to reduce tax payable, not the amount the taxpayer was entitled to claim. The offset is tightly gated: the ATO requires that the invalid received \"a disability support pension under the Social Security Act 1991\", a special needs disability support pension, or an invalidity service pension under the Veterans' Entitlements Act 1986. The available amount is carried in a separate column, so the difference between the two shows where a taxpayer's tax liability was too small to absorb the offset. The single dependant (invalid and carer) offset replaced a family of older dependant offsets in 2012-13, and this column runs from 2014-15 to 2023-24.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2015, question T6 Invalid and invalid carer","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2015/supplementary-tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t3-t9/t6-invalid-and-invalid-carer-2015","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Dependant (invalid and carer) tax offset - used","k":"Dollar amount of the dependant (invalid and carer) tax offset applied in the assessment","def":"A whole-dollar non-refundable offset amount worked out in the assessment, capped by the taxpayer's tax on taxable income and reduced by the dependant's adjusted taxable income above the threshold.","p":"2014-2015 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2015, question T6 Invalid and invalid carer","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2015/supplementary-tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t3-t9/t6-invalid-and-invalid-carer-2015","lim":"A zero here does not mean no caring relationship, and it does not even mean no entitlement: a taxpayer with little or no tax payable has nothing for the offset to reduce, so the used amount falls to zero while the available amount stands. The column is also a poor proxy for disability in the household, because it only counts invalids on the three named pensions and only where the taxpayer maintained them.","where":["madip-ge-020123d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1415","madip-ge-020128d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1516","madip-ge-020133d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1617","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1718","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1819","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy1920 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1920","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy1920 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2223 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy2324 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_2324_12m"]},{"n":"TOTL_ALWNC_AMT","d":"Total allowances the employer paid the payee to cover work-related costs, reported by the employer and kept apart from gross payments.","full":"Total allowances the employer paid the payee to cover work-related costs, reported by the employer and kept apart from gross payments. The ATO says \"Allowances are payments you made to cover your payee's work-related expenses. For example, tool allowances and motor vehicle allowances\", and is explicit that \"You must show the total amount of all allowances you paid in the Total allowances field.
