Do not include these amounts in gross payments.\" Living-away-from-home allowance is excluded because it is not assessable to the payee. The figure is third-party reported, so it is independent of anything the payee later claims as a deduction.","dsrc":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: payment details","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total allowances","k":"Dollar amount in the Total allowances field of a PAYG payment summary","def":"A dollar total for the payment period on the row, covering every allowance the payer paid that payee, with individual allowance types named separately on the form and collapsed to VARIOUS where there were more than two.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - individual non-business, Section B: payment details","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-individual-non-business/section-b-payment-details","lim":"It is not extra pay on top of the gross figure that a reader can simply add: an allowance is separate from gross payments here but is still assessable to the payee, and some award transport and cents-per-kilometre payments are reported differently again. The column also cannot tell you what the allowance was for once more than two were paid, since the types collapse to a single label, and by 2023-24 most of these rows originate from Single Touch Payroll reporting rather than a paper payment summary.","where":["madipge-ato-d-pay-sum-fy2324 / plida_ps_2324_12m_bn"]},{"n":"TOTL_ASSBL_DSCNT_AMT","d":"The employee share scheme discount that is assessable this year, written at label B of item 12 after the up-to-$1,000 reduction is applied.","full":"The employee share scheme discount that is assessable this year, written at label B of item 12 after the up-to-$1,000 reduction is applied. The ATO defines the underlying quantity plainly: \"The discount is the difference between the market value of the ESS interests and the amount you or one of your associates paid to acquire them.\" Label B is a net total of the four component labels on the same item - taxed-upfront eligible for reduction, taxed-upfront not eligible, deferral schemes and pre-1 July 2009 interests at cessation time - so those columns explain B rather than adding to it. The reduction only applies where the taxpayer's income test total is $180,000 or less.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 12 Employee share schemes, steps 5 and 6","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/income/12-employee-share-schemes-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Employee share schemes total assessable discount","k":"Dollar amount at label B, item 12 Employee share schemes","def":"A whole-dollar assessable amount: the sum of the discount labels D, E, F and G at item 12, less $1,000 where the taxpayer satisfies the income test and label D exceeds $1,000.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 12 Employee share schemes, steps 5 and 6","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/income/12-employee-share-schemes-2011","lim":"It is not the value of shares received and not a realised gain. A discount is taxed when the interest is acquired or when the deferred taxing point arrives, which can be years before the taxpayer sells anything and can fall in a year when the shares later lose value. Adding this column to the four component columns double counts, because B is their total.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0910 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0910_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920_16m","and 5 more"]},{"n":"TOTL_CREDIT_CLAIMED_AMT","d":"Total credits for tax already paid that the taxpayer claimed on the return, held for the three income years 2006-07 to 2008-09 only.","full":"Total credits for tax already paid that the taxpayer claimed on the return, held for the three income years 2006-07 to 2008-09 only. The ATO describes the assessment as showing \"credit you have for tax already paid during the income year\" alongside the tax owed on taxable income, and this column is that credit side as claimed rather than as allowed. Credits of this kind include amounts withheld from wages, franking credits, tax file number amounts withheld and credits distributed through partnerships and trusts. Its short life reflects a change in the ATO's own extract structure rather than any change in the return.","dsrc":"ATO, Your notice of assessment","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/your-notice-of-assessment","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total credits claimed","k":"Dollar amount of tax credits claimed in the assessment, 2006-07 to 2008-09","def":"A dollar amount aggregating the credit labels on the return for the year, distinct from the tax offsets aggregate carried in the deductions and offsets table for the same three years.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Your notice of assessment","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/your-notice-of-assessment","lim":"It cannot be treated as tax paid by the taxpayer. Franking credits are company tax already paid on the taxpayer's behalf, and a credit claimed can be reduced on assessment, so the column mixes withheld tax with imputed tax and states the claim rather than the outcome. Because it exists for only three years, any series built from it breaks at both ends.","where":["madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m"]},{"n":"TOTL_INCMORLSS_LESS_DDCTNS_AMT","d":"Total income or loss less total deductions, the line the return prints as SUBTOTAL.","full":"Total income or loss less total deductions, the line the return prints as SUBTOTAL. The ATO's rule is arithmetic: \"take away the amount at TOTAL DEDUCTIONS from the amount at TOTAL INCOME OR LOSS; write the result at SUBTOTAL\", and where total income is itself a loss the deductions are added to it instead. It is taxable income before any tax losses of earlier years are deducted at item L1, so it sits one step above TI_OR_LSS_AMT on the same row. Comparing the two isolates how much of a year's taxable income was absorbed by carried-forward losses.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, Subtotal","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/deduction-questions-d1-d10/subtotal-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total income or loss less total deductions","k":"Dollar amount at SUBTOTAL on the individual return","def":"A signed whole-dollar amount, the difference between the return's total income or loss and its total deductions, with a loss indicator on the paper form where it falls below zero.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, Subtotal","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/deduction-questions-d1-d10/subtotal-2011","lim":"It is not the taxpayer's assessed taxable income, and using it as such overstates the base for anyone deducting earlier-year losses. It also cannot be compared with total income to measure deduction intensity in a loss year, because the sign convention changes: where total income is negative, deductions are added rather than subtracted.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0910 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0910_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920_16m","and 5 more"]},{"n":"TOTL_OFFSET_CLAIMED_AMT","d":"Total tax offsets the taxpayer claimed, before the ATO worked out how much of them could be used, held for 2006-07 to 2008-09 only.","full":"Total tax offsets the taxpayer claimed, before the ATO worked out how much of them could be used, held for 2006-07 to 2008-09 only. The claimed total is built the way the ATO describes the return's own offsets line, by adding \"all the tax offset amounts you claimed\" at the individual offset items, with the seniors and pensioner offsets calculated by the ATO rather than written by the taxpayer. It pairs with the used and available offset columns elsewhere in the deductions and offsets table for the same years. Its three-year span reflects the ATO extract structure of that period.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, Total tax offsets","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t1-t5/total-tax-offsets-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total offsets claimed","k":"Dollar amount of tax offsets claimed, 2006-07 to 2008-09","def":"A dollar aggregate of the non-refundable offset amounts claimed at the tax offset items on the front and supplementary sections of the return for the year.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, Total tax offsets","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t1-t5/total-tax-offsets-2011","lim":"A claimed offset is not a tax reduction. Non-refundable offsets are capped by tax payable, so a taxpayer with a large claim and a small liability shows a big number here and gets little benefit, and the used-amount columns rather than this one measure the effect on tax. The column also does not separate refundable from non-refundable offsets.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0607 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0708 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0809 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0809_16m"]},{"n":"TOTL_OI_CTGRY_1_AMT","d":"Category 1 other income at label Y of item 24, a named list of one-off assessable amounts rather than a residual.","full":"Category 1 other income at label Y of item 24, a named list of one-off assessable amounts rather than a residual. The ATO's category 1 list covers \"Lump sum payments in arrears except lump sum payments in arrears relating to superannuation income streams\", BSWAT lump sums in arrears, foreign exchange gains, lottery and game-show benefits, reimbursements of tax-related or election expenses, assessable balancing adjustments, gains on traditional securities and work-in-progress amounts. This column carries the category 1 total from 2018-19 onwards; the earlier column TOTL_OTHR_INCM_CTGRY_1_AMT carries the same label up to 2017-18. Category 1 exists as a separate label because several of its items attract a lump sum in arrears tax offset.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2019, question 24 Other income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2019/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2019","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other income category 1","k":"Dollar amount at label Y, item 24 Other income (category 1)","def":"A whole-dollar total, self-assessed, summing every category 1 amount the taxpayer received. Tax withheld from lump sums in arrears is reported separately at label E of the same item.","p":"2018-2019 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2019, question 24 Other income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2019/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2019","lim":"It is a bucket, not a measure of any one thing. A back payment of wages, a game-show prize and a depreciation balancing adjustment all land in the same figure, so it cannot be used to count arrears payments or windfalls without the type description that only exists as free text on the form. It also breaks in series against the 2006-07 to 2017-18 column, since the ATO renumbered the item 24 categories when the FHSS category was added.","where":["madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2223 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2324 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2324_12m"]},{"n":"TOTL_OI_CTGRY_2_AMT","d":"ATO interest the taxpayer must bring back to income at item 24, reported at label X as category 2.","full":"ATO interest the taxpayer must bring back to income at item 24, reported at label X as category 2. The ATO defines the category in one line, \"Remissions of the ATO interest charge that you can claim or have claimed as a deduction\". The amount arises when the ATO forgives interest the taxpayer had already deducted at item D10, so it is a reversal of an earlier deduction rather than money received. The ATO-interest category first appears in the instructions for the 2017-18 return, while this column starts in 2015-16, so the first two years are likely to be empty.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2019, question 24 Other income, category 2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2019/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2019","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other income - category 2 (ato interest) - total","k":"Dollar amount at label X, item 24 Other income (category 2, ATO interest)","def":"A whole-dollar total of remitted general interest charge, shortfall interest charge and similar amounts that were, or will be, claimed as a deduction.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2019, question 24 Other income, category 2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2019/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2019","lim":"It is not interest the taxpayer earned or paid. A figure here means a charge was remitted, so it is a marker of a debt that was forgiven rather than of investment income, and reading it as an interest receipt inverts its meaning. A zero is also uninformative in 2015-16 and 2016-17, where the separate ATO-interest label was not yet in use on the paper return.","where":["madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2223 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2324 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2324_12m"]},{"n":"TOTL_OI_CTGRY_3_AMT","d":"Assessable First Home Super Saver amounts released to the taxpayer, reported as category 3 other income at label R of item 24 from 2018-19.","full":"Assessable First Home Super Saver amounts released to the taxpayer, reported as category 3 other income at label R of item 24 from 2018-19. The ATO's category 3 list for that year is one item, \"Assessable FHSS released amounts\", and the tax withheld from the release goes to label S on the same item. The number therefore identifies people who withdrew voluntary super contributions to buy a first home, the first releases being possible from 1 July 2018. In 2017-18 the same category number carried the item's residual income instead, and in 2015-16 and 2016-17 the ATO ran item 24 with only two categories, so the column changes meaning partway through.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2019 and 2018, question 24 Other income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2019/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2019","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total other income category 3 amount","k":"Dollar amount at label R, item 24 Other income (category 3)","def":"A whole-dollar assessable amount from 2018-19 onwards, being the released FHSS contributions and associated earnings that are included in assessable income and then reduced by a tax offset.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2019 and 2018, question 24 Other income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2019/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2019","lim":"The column is not a consistent series. In 2017-18 the ATO's category 3 was the residual bucket, \"Any income not described in category 1 or 2\", and from 2018-19 it is the FHSS release, while in 2015-16 and 2016-17 the item had no category 3 at all, so a taxpayer-level trend across those boundaries compares different quantities. It also does not measure home purchases: a release can be made and the purchase not proceed.","where":["madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2223 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2324 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2324_12m"]},{"n":"TOTL_OI_CTGRY_4_AMT","d":"Residual other income at label V of item 24 from 2018-19, defined by the ATO as \"Any income not described in category 1, 2 or 3\".","full":"Residual other income at label V of item 24 from 2018-19, defined by the ATO as \"Any income not described in category 1, 2 or 3\". It is the item's catch-all, and the ATO notes that \"Category 4 income shown at this item and certain amounts of income from some other items are used to work out whether you have to pay PAYG instalments and, if so, your instalment rate\", which gives the label an administrative consequence the other categories do not have. Taxable professional income written at label Z is added into this total unless it was already reported at items 1, 2, 13, 14 or 15. Before 2018-19 the residual sat at the same label V but under a different category number.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2019, question 24 Other income, category 4","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2019/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2019","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other income category 4","k":"Dollar amount at label V, item 24 Other income (category 4, residual)","def":"A whole-dollar self-assessed total covering royalties, taxable scholarships, jury fees, income protection payments, other Centrelink taxable payments and anything else assessable with no item of its own.","p":"2018-2019 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2019, question 24 Other income, category 4","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2019/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2019","lim":"It is the least interpretable income column on the return, because it is defined by exclusion: the same figure can be a scholarship for one taxpayer and an insurance payout for another, and the type description exists only as free text on the form. It also cannot be compared straight against the pre-2018-19 residual column, which carried a different category number and, until 2017-18, also absorbed the ATO interest and FHSS amounts that later moved out.","where":["madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2223 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2324 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2324_12m"]},{"n":"TOTL_OTHR_DDCTNS_AMT","d":"Deductions claimed at item D15 for expenses that have no other place on the return, held only for the 2009-10 income year in this asset.","full":"Deductions claimed at item D15 for expenses that have no other place on the return, held only for the 2009-10 income year in this asset. The ATO's list for the item includes \"election expenses for local, territory, state or federal candidates\", income protection, sickness and accident insurance premiums, foreign exchange losses, section 40-880 business capital expenditure not fully claimed, United Medical Protection support payments and expenses incurred in actively seeking paid work while on Newstart or Youth Allowance. Election expenses sit at label E and everything else at label J, so the item is really two claims under one heading. Every other year of the asset carries item D15 under OTHR_DDCTNS_TOTL_AMT, so this column is a one-year renaming rather than a separate field.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question D15 Other deductions","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/deduction-questions-d11-d15/d15-other-deductions-not-claimable-at-questions-d1-to-d14-or-elsewhere-in-your-tax-return-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other deductions","k":"Dollar amount at item D15 Other deductions","def":"A whole-dollar self-assessed deduction total for the year, combining the election-expense label and the other-expenses label at item D15.","p":"2009-2010","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question D15 Other deductions","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/deduction-questions-d11-d15/d15-other-deductions-not-claimable-at-questions-d1-to-d14-or-elsewhere-in-your-tax-return-2011","lim":"One year of data cannot support a trend, and the single-year presence is the main trap: a reader joining this column across the ATO's yearly tables will find it empty for every year but 2009-10, when the deduction itself continued to be claimed under a differently named column. The figure is also a claim rather than an allowed amount, and it does not say which of the item's very mixed expense types produced it.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0910 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0910_16m"]},{"n":"TOTL_OTHR_INCM_CTGRY_1_AMT","d":"Category 1 other income at label Y of item 24, on the form the ATO ran with just two income categories until 2016-17; this column covers 2006-07 to 2017-18.","full":"Category 1 other income at label Y of item 24, on the form the ATO ran with just two income categories until 2016-17; this column covers 2006-07 to 2017-18. On this form category 1 is a closed list of one-off amounts: lump sum payments in arrears other than super income stream arrears, jury attendance fees, foreign exchange gains, investment lottery and game-show benefits, reimbursements of tax-related or election expenses, assessable balancing adjustments, traditional securities gains and work-in-progress amounts. The ATO instructs the taxpayer to \"Add up all your category 1 income and write the total at Y item 24\". From 2018-19 the same label is carried by TOTL_OI_CTGRY_1_AMT after the ATO renumbered the categories.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 24 Other income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other income category 1","k":"Dollar amount at label Y, item 24 Other income (category 1, pre-2018-19 form)","def":"A whole-dollar total, self-assessed, of every category 1 amount received in the year. Tax withheld from any lump sum in arrears within it is reported separately at label E of item 24.","p":"2006-2007 to 2017-2018","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 24 Other income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2011","lim":"It cannot separate the kinds of income inside it, so a jury fee and a several-year salary back payment are indistinguishable in the number. Nor can the column be read continuously past 2017-18: the ATO stopped populating it when the item gained the ATO interest and FHSS categories, and a naive join makes the drop look like behaviour rather than a schema change.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0910 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0910_16m"]},{"n":"TOTL_OTHR_INCM_CTGRY_2_AMT","d":"Category 2 other income at label V of item 24, the item's residual income; the ATO ran item 24 with just two categories until 2016-17, and this column covers 2006-07 to 2017-18.","full":"Category 2 other income at label V of item 24, the item's residual income; the ATO ran item 24 with just two categories until 2016-17, and this column covers 2006-07 to 2017-18. The ATO defines it by exclusion, \"Any income not described in category 1\", and notes that \"Category 2 income shown at this item and certain amounts of income from some other items are used in working out whether you have to pay PAYG instalments and, if so, your instalment rate.\" It absorbs royalties, taxable scholarships, bonuses from friendly society income bonds, income protection payments and other taxable Centrelink amounts not shown at items 5 or 6. Taxable professional income at label Z is added into this total unless already declared at another item.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 24 Other income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other income category 2","k":"Dollar amount at label V, item 24 Other income (category 2, pre-2018-19 form)","def":"A whole-dollar self-assessed residual total for the year, defined as everything assessable at item 24 that does not fall in category 1.","p":"2006-2007 to 2017-2018","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 24 Other income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2011","lim":"Its content is not fixed even within its own span: in 2017-18 the ATO gave ATO interest its own category and renumbered the residual to category 3, so the residual at label V quietly narrows in the last year of the series. The column also does not reveal what the income was, since the type description sits in a free-text box on the form and collapses to a schedule reference when more than one type is present.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0910 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0910_16m"]},{"n":"TOTL_RBTS_AMT","d":"Total rebates and tax offsets the taxpayer claimed, the line the returns of this era print as TOTAL REBATES/TAX OFFSETS.","full":"Total rebates and tax offsets the taxpayer claimed, the line the returns of this era print as TOTAL REBATES/TAX OFFSETS. TaxPack's checklist for the year asks the taxpayer to have \"written totals at TOTAL TAX INSTALMENTS DEDUCTED, TOTAL INCOME OR LOSS, TOTAL DEDUCTIONS, SUBTOTAL, TAXABLE INCOME OR LOSS and TOTAL REBATES/TAX OFFSETS\", which is where this column comes from. Rebate is the older word for what the law now calls a tax offset, and the return of this period used both, which is why the column carries the older name. It runs 1999-2000 to 2005-06 and is replaced from 2006-07 by the total tax offsets columns.","dsrc":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), tax return for individuals 1999-2000","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total Rebates Amount","k":"Dollar amount at TOTAL REBATES/TAX OFFSETS on pre-2006 individual returns","def":"A whole-dollar total of the rebates and offsets claimed at the rebate items of the return, including the beneficiary, pensioner, spouse, dependant and zone rebates of that period.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), tax return for individuals 1999-2000","url":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","lim":"A rebate claimed is not tax saved. Most of these rebates were non-refundable and capped by tax payable, so a taxpayer with little liability shows a claim here and no benefit. The column is also not continuous with the later offsets columns, because several of the era's rebates, including the pensioner and low income aged person rebates, were later restructured or abolished.","where":["madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0001 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0001","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0102 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0102","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0203 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0203","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0304 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0304","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0405 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0405","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0506 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0506","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy9900 / ato_itr_inc_loss_9900"]},{"n":"TOTL_TAX_OFFSETS_AMT","d":"Total non-refundable tax offsets on the front section of the return, at label U, held for 2006-07 to 2008-09.","full":"Total non-refundable tax offsets on the front section of the return, at label U, held for 2006-07 to 2008-09. The ATO instructs the taxpayer to add up the offsets claimed at the individual T items and to \"Write the total amount at U TOTAL TAX OFFSETS on page 5 of your tax return\", while noting that some offsets, including the seniors and pensioner offsets, are worked out by the ATO rather than by the taxpayer. Offsets claimed in the supplementary section are totalled separately and brought across, so this line is not the taxpayer's whole offset position on its own. TAX_OFSTS_TOTL_AMT carries the same line for the whole 2006-07 to 2023-24 span, so for these three years the two columns sit side by side.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, Total tax offsets","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t1-t5/total-tax-offsets-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total tax offsets","k":"Dollar amount at label U, TOTAL TAX OFFSETS on the individual return","def":"A whole-dollar total of the non-refundable offsets claimed at the front-section tax offset items, part self-assessed by the taxpayer and part calculated by the ATO.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, Total tax offsets","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/tax-offset-questions-t1-t5/total-tax-offsets-2011","lim":"It is a total of claims, not of benefits: non-refundable offsets can only reduce tax to zero, so this figure overstates what a low-liability taxpayer actually received. Because the column is limited to 2006-07 to 2008-09, an apparent series break at either end reflects the ATO extract structure and not a change in the offsets themselves.","where":["madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0607 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0708 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0809 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0809_16m"]},{"n":"TOTL_TXBL_AMT","d":"The taxable component of a lump sum payment summary, reported by the paying fund or employer.","full":"The taxable component of a lump sum payment summary, reported by the paying fund or employer. The ATO defines it exactly: \"The taxable component is the total of the payment, less the tax-free component. This amount is assessable income.\" For a super lump sum the taxable component splits into a taxed element and an untaxed element, and the ATO tells payers \"Do not show taxed element amounts paid to people when they have turned 60. Show the untaxed element in all cases\". The tax-free component sits in its own column on the same row, and the payment summary type column says which form the row came from.","dsrc":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - superannuation lump sum, How to complete the form","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-super-lump-sum","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Taxable component","k":"Dollar amount in the Taxable component field of a lump sum payment summary","def":"A whole-dollar amount, third-party reported, being the payment less its tax-free component. Cents are dropped, so a payment of $122.76 is reported as $122.","p":"2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, PAYG payment summary - superannuation lump sum, How to complete the form","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-super-lump-sum","lim":"It is not the size of the lump sum. Adding it to the tax-free component recovers the payment only where the payee was under 60, because a taxed element paid after age 60 is left off the form entirely, so a large withdrawal by an older member can show a small taxable component or none. It also says nothing about the tax paid, which is carried by the withheld column.","where":["madipge-ato-d-pay-sum-fy2324 / plida_ps_2324_12m_bn"]},{"n":"TOTLNOEMPLRSPNTNCNTRBTNDDCTAMT","d":"Personal super contributions the taxpayer claimed as a deduction at label H of item D12, not contributions the employer made.","full":"Personal super contributions the taxpayer claimed as a deduction at label H of item D12, not contributions the employer made. The eligible population widened sharply in 2017-18: the ATO says \"Previously, only those who earned less than 10% of their total income as an employee were eligible to claim this deduction\" and that \"This 10% rule has been removed which means most Australians under 75 years old can claim an income tax deduction for after-tax personal super contributions\". A deduction is only allowed where the taxpayer gave their fund a valid notice of intent and the fund acknowledged it. The column runs the full span of the asset, 1999-2000 to 2023-24, which makes the 2017-18 rule change the single most important thing about it.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2018, question D12 Personal superannuation contributions","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2018/supplementary-tax-return/deduction-questions-d11-d15/d12-personal-superannuation-contributions-2018","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Personal superannuation contributions","k":"Dollar amount at label H, item D12 Personal superannuation contributions","def":"A whole-dollar self-assessed deduction for after-tax contributions the taxpayer made to a complying fund or retirement savings account in the year, limited by age rules and by the amount notified to the fund.","p":"1999-2000 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2018, question D12 Personal superannuation contributions","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2018/supplementary-tax-return/deduction-questions-d11-d15/d12-personal-superannuation-contributions-2018","lim":"It measures a deduction claimed, not contributions made. A taxpayer who contributed but did not lodge a notice of intent, or who left the contribution to attract the government co-contribution instead, shows zero here while having contributed. The pre-2017-18 and post-2017-18 figures are also not comparable, because the removal of the maximum earnings condition changed who could claim rather than who could contribute.","where":["madip-ge-020103d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1011","madip-ge-020108d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1112","madip-ge-020113d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1213","madip-ge-020118d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1314","madip-ge-020123d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1415","madip-ge-020128d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1516","madip-ge-020133d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1617","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1718","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1819","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0001 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0001","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0102 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0102","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0203 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0203","and 15 more"]},{"n":"TRD_CRDTRS_AMT","d":"What the sole trader's business owed its suppliers at the end of the year, reported at label F of item P14 on the business and professional items schedule.","full":"What the sole trader's business owed its suppliers at the end of the year, reported at label F of item P14 on the business and professional items schedule. The ATO defines it as \"the total amount owed by the business at the end of the year for goods and services received\", that is, current trade and other creditors. Where the taxpayer runs more than one business the schedule requires a single combined figure. It is a balance sheet position at one instant, not a flow, which sets it apart from every expense column on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2022 instructions, P13 and P14 Trade debtors and creditors","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2022-and-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule/p13-and-p14-trade-debtors-and-creditors","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Trade creditors","k":"Dollar amount at label F, item P14 Trade creditors","def":"A whole-dollar closing balance of current trade and other creditors, self-assessed, summed across all of the taxpayer's businesses.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2022 instructions, P13 and P14 Trade debtors and creditors","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2022-and-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule/p13-and-p14-trade-debtors-and-creditors","lim":"It is not a debt total for the person. Only trade payables of the business are in scope, so business loans, tax debts and personal borrowings are absent, and a leveraged sole trader can report zero. Because the figure is a point-in-time balance, comparing it with the year's purchases or expenses to infer payment terms will mislead for any seasonal business.","where":["madip-ge-020103d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1011","madip-ge-020108d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1112","madip-ge-020113d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1213","madip-ge-020118d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1314","madip-ge-020123d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1415","madip-ge-020128d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1516","madip-ge-020133d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1617","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1718","madip-ge-020138d-ato-atoitrdedexpoff1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_1819","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0607 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0708 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-ded-exp-off-fy0809 / ato_itr_ded_exp_off_0809_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"TRD_DEBTRS_AMT","d":"What customers owed the sole trader's business at the end of the year, reported at label E of item P13 on the business and professional items schedule.","full":"What customers owed the sole trader's business at the end of the year, reported at label E of item P13 on the business and professional items schedule. The ATO defines it as \"the total amount owing to the business at the end of the year for goods and services provided\", that is, current trade and other debtors. It is the mirror of the trade creditors label on the same schedule, and like it, a taxpayer with several businesses adds them together into one figure. Reported gross, with no allowance for doubtful debts deducted at this label.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2022 instructions, P13 and P14 Trade debtors and creditors","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2022-and-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule/p13-and-p14-trade-debtors-and-creditors","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Trade debtors","k":"Dollar amount at label E, item P13 Trade debtors","def":"A whole-dollar closing balance of current trade and other debtors, self-assessed, summed across all of the taxpayer's businesses.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2022 instructions, P13 and P14 Trade debtors and creditors","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2022-and-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule/p13-and-p14-trade-debtors-and-creditors","lim":"It cannot be used to measure recoverable income. Bad debts are written off through a separate deduction label rather than netted here, so the balance includes amounts the business will never collect, and a business on a cash basis for accounting purposes may still report a debtor position that never becomes income. A zero simply means no receivables at 30 June, which is common for cash-settled trades.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"TRDG_STK_ELCTN_IND","d":"A flag that the taxpayer valued closing trading stock below every standard method and therefore had to notify the Commissioner, at label P of item P21.","full":"A flag that the taxpayer valued closing trading stock below every standard method and therefore had to notify the Commissioner, at label P of item P21. The ATO's rule is narrow: \"If you have valued trading stock on hand at the end of 2021-22 at an amount that is less than the lowest amount available using one of the valuation methods at Closing stock , you must notify the Commissioner.\" Where the notification is required the taxpayer enters Y, and otherwise the label is left blank. It sits in the context table beside the closing stock action code and the closing stock total, which are the amounts the election bears on.","dsrc":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2022 instructions, P21 Trading stock election","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2022-and-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule/p21-trading-stock-election","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Trading stock election","k":"Trading stock election flag at label P, item P21","def":"A one-character flag, Y where the taxpayer made a trading stock election and blank otherwise, so the field is effectively present-or-absent rather than yes-or-no.","p":"2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2010-2011, 2011-2012, 2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017, 2017-2018, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Business and professional items schedule 2022 instructions, P21 Trading stock election","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/business-and-professional-items-schedule-2022-and-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-bpi-schedule/p21-trading-stock-election","lim":"It does not say what the stock was written down to, or why. Obsolescence, damage and special circumstances all produce the same Y, and the amount of the write-down has to be read from the closing stock columns. A blank is also ambiguous in a way a No is not, because it covers both a taxpayer who made no election and a taxpayer with no trading stock at all.","where":["madip-ge-020102d-ato-atoitrcontext1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_context_1011","madip-ge-020107d-ato-atoitrcontext1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_context_1112","madip-ge-020112d-ato-atoitrcontext1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_context_1213","madip-ge-020117d-ato-atoitrcontext1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_context_1314","madip-ge-020122d-ato-atoitrcontext1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_context_1415","madip-ge-020127d-ato-atoitrcontext1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_context_1516","madip-ge-020132d-ato-atoitrcontext1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_context_1617","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_context_1718","madip-ge-020137d-ato-atoitrcontext1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_context_1819","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0607 / ato_itr_context_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0708 / ato_itr_context_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-context-fy0809 / ato_itr_context_0809_16m","and 7 more"]},{"n":"TRGT_FORGN_INCM_AMT","d":"Overseas income that never reaches taxable income, declared at label V of item IT4 so that the income tests can pick it up.","full":"Overseas income that never reaches taxable income, declared at label V of item IT4 so that the income tests can pick it up. The ATO defines target foreign income as \"any income earned, derived or received from sources outside Australia\", plus periodical gifts or allowances from an overseas source, \"provided that the amount has not been included in your taxable income, or received in the form of a fringe benefit\". Its examples are regular money from relatives living overseas, exempt income from foreign business interests, and foreign income received while a temporary resident. Exempt foreign employment income shown at item 20 forms part of it, so the two columns overlap by design.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question IT4 Target foreign income","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/income-tests/it4-target-foreign-income-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Target foreign income","k":"Dollar amount at label V, item IT4 Target foreign income","def":"A whole-dollar self-assessed amount converted to Australian dollars, covering foreign-sourced income and periodical gifts that are outside taxable income for the year.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question IT4 Target foreign income","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/income-tests/it4-target-foreign-income-2011","lim":"It is not a measure of foreign income. Anything taxed here in Australia is deliberately excluded, so a taxpayer with large but assessable overseas earnings reports nothing at this label, and the column understates offshore income by exactly the part the tax system already sees. Underreporting also has no direct tax cost to the taxpayer, since the amount only affects income-tested entitlements.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0910 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0910_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920_16m","and 5 more"]},{"n":"TRST_INCM_SB_SHARE_NET_AMT","d":"The taxpayer's share of a trust's net small business income, used only to work out the small business income tax offset.","full":"The taxpayer's share of a trust's net small business income, used only to work out the small business income tax offset. The ATO is explicit that the amount does not add to income: \"Amounts you show at this item are not included in your income, they are only used for the purpose of working out your small business income tax offset.\" The share is taken from the trustee's statement of distribution and is then reduced by any deductions attributable to it and by deductible farm management deposits. A partnership share is reported separately, so the two together make up the offset base. The column starts in 2015-16 with the offset itself.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2016, question 13 Partnerships and trusts, part E","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2016/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2016","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Trust share of net small business income","k":"Dollar amount, share of trust net small business income at item 13","def":"A whole-dollar amount, self-assessed from the trust's advice, being the share of net small business income less attributable deductions. A trust that made an overall loss gives a share of zero.","p":"2015-2016 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2016, question 13 Partnerships and trusts, part E","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2016/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2016","lim":"Adding it to the taxpayer's income columns double counts, because the same trust distribution is already inside the share of trust net income at item 13. The column also does not identify the offset received: the small business income tax offset is a percentage of tax on this base and is capped, so a large share here can produce a small offset.","where":["madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy1920 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1920_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2223 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy2324 / ato_itr_inc_loss_2324_12m"]},{"n":"TRSTS_NPP_LESS_CGFORGNINCM_AMT","d":"The taxpayer's share of a trust's non-primary production net income or loss, at label U of item 13, with capital gains and foreign income stripped out.","full":"The taxpayer's share of a trust's non-primary production net income or loss, at label U of item 13, with capital gains and foreign income stripped out. The ATO instructs the taxpayer to \"Write at U the total of your share of non-primary production trust net income or loss\" and then to exclude net capital gains, attributed foreign income and other foreign source income, which are reported at items 18, 19 and 20 instead. The share of any credits distributed with that income is included in the amount at U and then also shown at the credit labels of the same item. Where the trust made an overall tax loss the loss stays in the trust and the taxpayer has no share.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 13 Partnerships and trusts, part B","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Share of net income from trusts less net capital gains and foreign income non primary production","k":"Dollar amount at label U, item 13 Partnerships and trusts","def":"A signed whole-dollar amount, self-assessed from the trustee's statement of distribution, being the beneficiary's share of the trust's net income for tax purposes other than primary production, capital gains and foreign income.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 13 Partnerships and trusts, part B","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2011","lim":"It is not money received. A present entitlement at 30 June is enough to require the share to be declared even if the trust pays nothing until the following year, so the column measures entitlement rather than cash. It is also not the whole trust story for a taxpayer, because the capital gains and foreign components of the same distribution sit at other items entirely.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","and 8 more"]},{"n":"TRSTS_PP_DSTBN_AMT","d":"The taxpayer's share of a trust's primary production net income or loss, at label L of item 13.","full":"The taxpayer's share of a trust's primary production net income or loss, at label L of item 13. The ATO instructs the taxpayer to \"Write the total of your share of primary production trust net income or loss at L item 13 on your tax return\", and explains that the trustee's statement separates primary from non-primary production because \"This information is needed for averaging purposes\". The split matters for the taxpayer because primary production income feeds the income averaging calculation and the farm management deposit rules. The corresponding partnership share is at label N on the same item.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 13 Partnerships and trusts, part B","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Distribution from trusts primary production","k":"Dollar amount at label L, item 13 Partnerships and trusts","def":"A signed whole-dollar amount, self-assessed from the trustee's statement of distribution, being the beneficiary's share of the trust's primary production net income for tax purposes, with a loss indicator on the paper form.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 13 Partnerships and trusts, part B","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2011","lim":"It does not identify farmers. A discretionary trust can distribute primary production income to a beneficiary with no involvement in the farm, so the column marks an entitlement to farm income rather than an occupation. It also cannot be added to the non-primary production share to get total trust income without checking the capital gains and foreign income items, which carry the rest of the same distribution.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","and 8 more"]},{"n":"TSL_OUTSTG_RPYBL_AMT","d":"The Trade Support Loan debt still outstanding after this year's compulsory repayment, for apprentices who borrowed under the scheme.","full":"The Trade Support Loan debt still outstanding after this year's compulsory repayment, for apprentices who borrowed under the scheme. The ATO describes the programme as one where \"eligible Australian apprentices are offered loans over a 4-year period\" and notes that \"A 20% discount will be granted where an Australian Apprentice successfully completes their apprenticeship\", so the balance can fall through completion as well as through repayment. The scheme has since been renamed the Australian Apprenticeship Support Loan. On the same row the repayable debt and the compulsory repayment due columns give the amounts the assessment acted on, while this column gives what remains.","dsrc":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Types of loans","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Trade Support Loan Outstanding Repayable Debt","k":"Dollar amount of outstanding Trade Support Loan debt at assessment","def":"A whole-dollar accumulated debt balance carried by the ATO for the taxpayer, indexed annually and reduced by compulsory repayments raised through the assessment and by voluntary repayments.","p":"2020-2021 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Study and training support loans, Types of loans","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans","lim":"It is not the amount borrowed. Indexation raises the balance and the completion discount cuts it, so the figure diverges from cumulative loan payments in both directions and cannot be used to estimate what an apprentice drew down. A zero also does not distinguish an apprentice who never borrowed from one who has repaid in full.","where":["madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2021_16m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2021-22 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2122_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2223 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2223_12m","madipge-ato-d-whld-debt-fy2324 / ato_itr_whld_debt_2324_12m"]},{"n":"TW_ABN_NOT_QTD_SHARE_AMT","d":"The taxpayer's share of a credit for tax withheld from partnership or trust income because no Australian business number was quoted, at label P of item 13.","full":"The taxpayer's share of a credit for tax withheld from partnership or trust income because no Australian business number was quoted, at label P of item 13. The ATO's condition is that the distribution shown at labels N, L, O or U includes or is attributable to \"income from which an amount of tax was withheld because an Australian business number was not quoted; write your share of the distributed credit at P item 13 (show cents)\". Withholding where no ABN is quoted is at the top marginal rate, so the credit is large relative to the income behind it. It is one of seven credit and tax offset labels at item 13 in that year, each carrying a different kind of distributed credit.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 13 Partnerships and trusts, part E","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Share of credit for tax withheld where abn not quoted","k":"Dollar and cents credit at label P, item 13 Partnerships and trusts","def":"A dollar-and-cents credit amount, self-assessed from the partnership or trust statement, being the taxpayer's proportionate share of tax withheld from the entity's income under the no-ABN withholding rules.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 13 Partnerships and trusts, part E","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/13-partnerships-and-trusts-2011","lim":"It says nothing about the taxpayer's own ABN status. The failure to quote was the entity's or its customer's, not the individual's, so this column cannot be used to identify unregistered contractors. Nor does it stand alone as a withholding measure: the taxpayer's directly earned no-ABN withholding is reported at a different label in the business items.","where":["madip-ge-020104d-ato-atoitrincloss1011-fy2010-11 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1011","madip-ge-020109d-ato-atoitrincloss1112-fy2011-12 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1112","madip-ge-020114d-ato-atoitrincloss1213-fy2012-13 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1213","madip-ge-020119d-ato-atoitrincloss1314-fy2013-14 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1314","madip-ge-020124d-ato-atoitrincloss1415-fy2014-15 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1415","madip-ge-020129d-ato-atoitrincloss1516-fy2015-16 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1516","madip-ge-020134d-ato-atoitrincloss1617-fy2016-17 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1617","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1718-fy2017-18 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1718","madip-ge-020139d-ato-atoitrincloss1819-fy2018-19 / ato_itr_inc_loss_1819","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0607 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0607_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0708 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0708_16m","madipge-ato-d-inc-loss-fy0809 / ato_itr_inc_loss_0809_16m","and 8 more"]},{"n":"TW_FRM_AASIS_AMT","d":"Tax the fund or annuity provider withheld from the taxpayer's superannuation income stream and annuity payments, totalled at item 7.","full":"Tax the fund or annuity provider withheld from the taxpayer's superannuation income stream and annuity payments, totalled at item 7. The ATO's step is a simple aggregation: \"Add up the tax withheld amounts on your payment summaries for your superannuation income streams and annuities. Write the total in the left column under Tax withheld at item 7 on your tax return.\" It is third-party reported and pre-filled from payment summaries, so it is one of the more reliable numbers on the return. The ATO's own status wording for that point is \"We've completed processing your tax return and your notice of assessment has issued\". Processing usually takes about two weeks for an electronically lodged return, and longer where the return is under review, amended, or lodged with several years at once. It sits in the context table beside the lodgment source and the amendment code, which say how the return arrived and whether the row is an original or a later version of the assessment.","dsrc":"ATO, Status of your tax return","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/check-the-progress-of-your-tax-return/status-of-your-tax-return","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Processed date","k":"Date the ATO finished processing the return","def":"A calendar date on the ATO's income tax account for the taxpayer and income year, falling after lodgment and on or about the notice of assessment date.","p":"1999-2000, 2000-2001, 2001-2002, 2002-2003, 2003-2004, 2004-2005, 2005-2006, 2006-2007, 2007-2008, 2008-2009, 2018-2019, 2019-2020, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Status of your tax return","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/check-the-progress-of-your-tax-return/status-of-your-tax-return","lim":"It is not a lodgment date and should never be used as one. TaxPack for the period lists the totals the taxpayer must write, among them \"TAXABLE INCOME OR LOSS\", and this column is the version the ATO carried into the assessment after processing. It sits on the same row as TI_OR_LSS_AMT, which is the taxpayer's own figure, so the pair shows where the ATO's calculation departed from the return as lodged. This column ends in 2005-06, while TI_OR_LSS_AMT runs on to 2023-24, so the two sit side by side only in the early years.","dsrc":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), tax return for individuals 1999-2000","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Taxable Income Calculated Amount","k":"Dollar amount of taxable income calculated in the assessment, pre-2006 returns","def":"A whole-dollar amount of taxable income for the income year as computed in the assessment, after total deductions and any earlier-year tax losses.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), tax return for individuals 1999-2000","url":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","lim":"It is not necessarily the same number as the taxpayer wrote, and that is the point of having both columns: a difference marks an ATO adjustment rather than a data error, so treating the two as duplicates hides the adjustments. The ATO's instruction is direct: \"If you are a special professional, write the taxable professional income you received at Z item 24 . Do not show cents. We take this amount into account for income averaging.\" A special professional is an author of a literary, dramatic, musical or artistic work, an inventor, a performing artist, a production associate or an active sportsperson. The amount may already be reported at items 1, 2, 13, 14 or 15, and the return warns that showing it at Z does not tax it twice.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 24 Other income, step 3","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other income taxable professional income","k":"Dollar amount at label Z, item 24 Other income","def":"A whole-dollar self-assessed amount identifying the professional-income part of the taxpayer's assessable income, used to set the averaging concession rather than to add income.","p":"2006-2007 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question 24 Other income, step 3","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/supplementary-tax-return/income-questions-13-24/24-other-income-2011","lim":"Adding it to income totals double counts, because the same earnings are already reported at the salary, business, partnership or personal services items. Allowances, tips and directors' fees are a separate item, so neither column includes them. This column ends in 2005-06, while the salary or wages column resumes in 2009-10, so only the early years carry both.","dsrc":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), tax return for individuals 1999-2000, item 1","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Taxable Salary and Wages Amount","k":"Dollar amount of salary and wages carried into the assessment, pre-2006 returns","def":"A whole-dollar salary and wages amount for the income year, held alongside the declared salary or wages total in the same table.","p":"1999-2000 to 2005-2006","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, TaxPack 2000 (NAT 0976), tax return for individuals 1999-2000, item 1","url":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=0976-6.2000","lim":"Whether it is gross salary or a figure net of work-related deductions is not stated in any published ATO document, so it cannot be used interchangeably with the later gross payment columns without checking against the salary or wages column on the same row. The ATO tells the minor to add up employment income, Centrelink and veterans' payments, compensation, superannuation and pension fund benefits, income from a deceased estate, income from their own business or an active partnership, and income from property transferred on a death or family breakdown, then to \"Take away the total of those deductions from the total income you worked out at step 2\". Everything else a minor receives, chiefly investment and trust income, is taxed at penalty rates. Where the minor is an excepted person the label carries zero and the type code carries A.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question A1 Under 18","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/adjustments/a1-under-18-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Under 18 income","k":"Dollar amount at label J, item A1 Under 18","def":"A whole-dollar net amount, self-assessed, being excepted income less the deductions attributable to it. It is written as zero, not left blank, when the minor has no excepted income.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question A1 Under 18","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/adjustments/a1-under-18-2011","lim":"A zero is ambiguous in a way the amount alone cannot resolve. It appears both for a minor whose whole income is at penalty rates and for an excepted person whose entire income is taxed normally, and only the type code on the same row separates the two. Code A marks an excepted person, for whom \"all your income will be taxed at normal rates\": someone working full time or intending to, a disability support or rehabilitation pensioner, a person who is permanently blind or has a lasting disability, a double orphan, or a minor unable to work full time because of a permanent disability and with little family support. Code M marks a minor who is not excepted and whose excepted income amount is written at label J instead. The code is what makes the amount column readable, since both cases can show zero.","dsrc":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question A1 Under 18, steps 1 and 5","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/adjustments/a1-under-18-2011","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Under 18 income type","k":"Type code at item A1 Under 18 (A or M)","def":"A single character, A or M, printed in the TYPE box beside label J at item A1, present only where the taxpayer was under 18 at the end of the income year.","p":"2009-2010 to 2023-2024","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Individual tax return instructions 2011, question A1 Under 18, steps 1 and 5","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/instructions-to-complete-your-tax-return/paper-tax-return-instructions/2011/tax-return/adjustments/a1-under-18-2011","lim":"It is not a disability or employment indicator. Sickness allowance and Newstart allowance were declared at question 5 of TaxPack 2000, an item with no code box of its own, and the beneficiary rebate on those payments was worked out by the ATO rather than claimed by the taxpayer.
